aberration_hunter.name: Aberration Hunter
aberration_hunter.desc_1: Aberration Hunter is a passive feature that protects against aberration attacks.
aberration_hunter.desc_2: A githyanki wearing this amulet has  Advantage on Intelligence  Saving throws. Aberrations also have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against them.

ability_drain.name: Ability Drain
ability_drain.desc_1: Ability Drain is a passive feature and Illithid Power. Once per turn while attacking, this ability reduces the target's relevant Ability score by 1.
ability_drain.desc_2: Once per turn, when you make an Attack Roll, the attack reduces that target's corresponding Ability by 1. The reduced ability score cannot be decreased lower than 1. The ability that is reduced is the same as the one used to make the Attack Roll. For melee weapons, this is usually Strength, for ranged weapons usually Dexterity, and for spells usually your Spellcasting Ability.

ablaze.name: Ablaze
ablaze.desc_1: Ablaze is a toggleable passive feature available to conjured Flaming Spheres. It allows the Flaming Sphere to deal AoE ⁠Fire damage and leave a trail of fire.
ablaze.desc_2: When the sphere is ablaze, it leaves behind a  Fire surface and deals 2d6⁠Fire to nearby creatures and objects.

absolute_night.name: Absolute Night
absolute_night.desc_1: Absolute Night is a passive feature that lets the weapon blind its targets.
absolute_night.desc_2: Blind targets that fail a  Dexterity saving throw. Deals an additional 2d6⁠Piercing to certain creatures that sport multiple sets of eyes.

absolute_s_aegis.name: Absolute's Aegis
absolute_s_aegis.desc_1: Absolute's Aegis is a passive feature that reduces damage if you are branded.
absolute_s_aegis.desc_2: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, all damage received from spells is reduced by 1.

absolute_s_bane.name: Absolute's Bane
absolute_s_bane.desc_1: Absolute's Bane is a passive feature that penalizes the user's targets with Bane for 2 turns when you hit them with a weapon attack (melee or ranged).
absolute_s_bane.desc_2: On a hit with a weapon attack, possibly inflict a   -1d4 penalty to the target's Attack rolls and  Saving throws.

absolute_s_tempest.name: Absolute's Tempest
absolute_s_tempest.desc_1: Absolute's Tempest is a passive feature that adds 1 extra damage to thunder spells and attacks.
absolute_s_tempest.desc_2: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they deal 1 additional Thunder damage with Thunder damage spells and attacks.

absolute_s_ward.name: Absolute's Ward
absolute_s_ward.desc_1: Absolute's Ward is a passive feature that grants a bonus to your defenses if you are branded with the Absolute.
absolute_s_ward.desc_2: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, they gain a +1 bonus to  Saving throws.

absolute_s_mercy.name: Absolute's Mercy
absolute_s_mercy.desc_1: Absolute's Mercy is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to survive being unconscious.
absolute_s_mercy.desc_2: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they have  Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

accursed_coins.name: Accursed Coins
accursed_coins.desc_1: Accursed Coins is a passive feature unique to the toll collector's visages.
accursed_coins.desc_2: This cursed visage controls part of the coins protecting the Toll Collector.

accursed_spectre.name: Accursed Spectre
accursed_spectre.desc_1: Accursed Spectre is a The Hexblade warlock passive feature that raises a spectre when an enemy is killed.
accursed_spectre.desc_2: When you or an ally within 18 m / 60 ft slay a creature that is afflicted with  Hexblade's Curse, you can raise an Accursed Spectre that will fight alongside you for a short period of time. Doesn't work with constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, or undead.

acolyte_of_nature.name: Acolyte of Nature
acolyte_of_nature.desc_1: Acolyte of Nature is a Nature Domain Cleric passive feature. It allows Cleric to learn one druid cantrip and get an additional proficiency.
acolyte_of_nature.desc_2: Learn one of the following Druid cantrips: Get one of the following proficiencies:

actor.name: Actor
actor.desc_1: Actor is a Feat that grants bonuses to a character's ability to act.
actor.desc_2: You have become a true thespian. Your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20 Your  Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Deception and Performance Checks.

adamantine_backlash.name: Adamantine Backlash
adamantine_backlash.desc_1: Adamantine Backlash is a passive feaure that sends a melee attacker reeling after a hit.
adamantine_backlash.desc_2: When a melee attack hits you, the attacker is sent  Reeling for 2 turns. Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack rolls for every turn remaining.

adamantine_shield.name: Adamantine Shield
adamantine_shield.desc_1: Adamantine Shield is a passive feature that sends attacks reeling.
adamantine_shield.desc_2: When a melee attack misses you, the attacker is sent  Reeling for 2 turns. Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack rolls for every turn remaining.

adamantine_skin.name: Adamantine Skin
adamantine_skin.desc_1: Adamantine Skin is a passive feature of Grym. It renders Grym invulnerable to all types of damage until weakened with intense heat.
adamantine_skin.desc_2: Made entirely from adamantine, this mass is about as heavy as a dragon, and nearly as indestructible. Only intense heat can soften the metal enough to be shaped.

adaptable_skullduggery.name: Adaptable Skullduggery
adaptable_skullduggery.desc_1: Adaptable Skullduggery is a passive feature that allows the user to perform Sneak Attacks with any weapon.
adaptable_skullduggery.desc_2: This creature can perform a Sneak Attack with any weapon, not only those marked as Finesse.

additional_spell_slot.name: Additional Spell Slot
additional_spell_slot.desc_1: Additional Spell Slot is a passive feature that gives you an extra spell slot.

additional_spell_slot_level_3.name: Additional Spell Slot Level 3
additional_spell_slot_level_3.desc_1: AdditionalSpellSlot_Level_3 is a passive feature that gives you an extra level 3 spell slot.

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline_rush.desc_1: Adrenaline Rush is a passive feature that grants a character wrath every time they dash during combat.
adrenaline_rush.desc_2: When the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action during combat, they gain  Wrath for 3 turns.

adroit_caster.name: Adroit Caster
adroit_caster.desc_1: Adroit Caster is a toggleable passive feature that allows you to cast a cantrip at a second creature at the same time, once per short rest.
adroit_caster.desc_2: Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice. Usable once per short rest. Cantrips require the targets to be close together, unless those cantrips are projectiles.

adroit_reflexes.name: Adroit Reflexes
adroit_reflexes.desc_1: Adroid Reflexes is a passive feature that enhances your counterattacks.
adroit_reflexes.desc_2: When you make an Attack roll as a  Reaction, you make it with  Advantage.

advanced_unarmoured_movement.name: Advanced Unarmoured Movement
advanced_unarmoured_movement.desc_1: Advanced Unarmoured Movement is a Monk passive feature that allows movement through Difficult Terrain without penalty. If no armour or shield is equipped, an additional  6 m / 20 ft can be Jumped.
advanced_unarmoured_movement.desc_2: Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can  Jump an additional  6 m / 20 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

aegis_palms.name: Aegis Palms
aegis_palms.desc_1: Aegis Palms is a passive feature that protects creatures you heal or revive.
aegis_palms.desc_2: When you heal a creature, it gains the effect of  Blade Ward. When you  Revive a creature it gains the effect of  Death Ward.

after_death_do_us_part.name: After Death Do Us Part
after_death_do_us_part.desc_1: After Death Do Us Part is a passive feature that can automatically revive the wearer but might drive them mad.
after_death_do_us_part.desc_2: When the wearer is  Downed, they rise once more with half their Hit Points restored, but are gripped by  Shadow Possession.

agile_chassis.name: Agile Chassis
agile_chassis.desc_1: Agile Chassis is a passive feature that grants a creature  Advantage on  Dexterity saving throw and an additional 9 m / 30 ft movement speed.
agile_chassis.desc_2: The lightweight build of this Steel Watcher grants it Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws and an additional 9 m / 30 ft movement speed.

agonising_blast.name: Agonising Blast
agonising_blast.desc_1: Agonising Blast is an Eldritch Invocation passive feature from the Warlock class. It allows the caster to increase their damage by adding their Charisma Modifier.
agonising_blast.desc_2: When you cast  Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma Modifier to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.

alert.name: Alert
alert.desc_1: Alert is a Feat. It gives you a bonus to your initiative and you can no longer be  Surprised.
alert.desc_2: You gain +5 to Initiative and can no longer be surprised.

ambusher_1.name: Ambusher (+1)
ambusher_1.desc_1: Ambusher is a passive feature that enhances the user's initiative in combat.
ambusher_1.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative Rolls.

ambusher_2.name: Ambusher (+2)
ambusher_2.desc_1: Ambusher is a passive feature that enhances the user's initiative in combat.
ambusher_2.desc_2: Gain a +2 bonus to  Initiative Rolls.

ambusher_s_streak.name: Ambusher's Streak
ambusher_s_streak.desc_1: Ambusher's Streak is a passive feature that deals more damage at the start of the battle if you act before the target does.
ambusher_s_streak.desc_2: In combat, you deal an additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

angelclocker_knuckles.name: Angelclocker Knuckles
angelclocker_knuckles.desc_1: Angelclocker Knuckles is passive feature that adds radiant damage to unarmed attacks.
angelclocker_knuckles.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Radiant damage.

antimagic_susceptibility.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
antimagic_susceptibility.desc_1: Antimagic Susceptibility is a passive feature that renders the creature incapacitated and unable to act when within an antimagic field.
antimagic_susceptibility.desc_2: Held together by the Weave itself, this armour is  Incapacitated by antimagic fields.

arcane_ashes.name: Arcane Ashes
arcane_ashes.desc_1: Arcane Ashes is a passive feature that heats up the user whenever they deal fire damage.
arcane_ashes.desc_2: Whenever you deal ⁠Fire damage, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

arcane_battery.name: Arcane Battery
arcane_battery.desc_1: Arcane Battery is a toggleable passive feature which allows the user to cast a spell without using up a spell slot.
arcane_battery.desc_2: Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a spell slot. You need to toggle this feature on in order to activate this effect.

arcane_echomalefaction.name: Arcane Echomalefaction
arcane_echomalefaction.desc_1: Arcane Echomalefaction is a passive feature which applies reverberation on enemies after applying a condition.
arcane_echomalefaction.desc_2: When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of  Reverberation.[See: Bugs]

arcane_enchantment_caitiff_staff.name: Arcane Enchantment (Caitiff Staff)
arcane_enchantment_caitiff_staff.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_caitiff_staff.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_despair_of_athkatla.name: Arcane Enchantment (Despair of Athkatla)
arcane_enchantment_despair_of_athkatla.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_despair_of_athkatla.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_markoheshkir.name: Arcane Enchantment (Markoheshkir)
arcane_enchantment_markoheshkir.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_markoheshkir.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_melf_s_first_staff.name: Arcane Enchantment (Melf's First Staff)
arcane_enchantment_melf_s_first_staff.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_melf_s_first_staff.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_staff_of_spellpower.name: Arcane Enchantment (Staff of Spellpower)
arcane_enchantment_staff_of_spellpower.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_staff_of_spellpower.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_staff_of_the_emperor.name: Arcane Enchantment (Staff of the Emperor)
arcane_enchantment_staff_of_the_emperor.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_staff_of_the_emperor.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_woe.name: Arcane Enchantment (Woe)
arcane_enchantment_woe.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_woe.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_cloak_of_the_weave.name: Arcane Enchantment (Cloak of the Weave)
arcane_enchantment_cloak_of_the_weave.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_cloak_of_the_weave.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_ketheric_s_shield.name: Arcane Enchantment (Ketheric's Shield)
arcane_enchantment_ketheric_s_shield.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_ketheric_s_shield.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_robe_of_the_weave.name: Arcane Enchantment (Robe of the Weave)
arcane_enchantment_robe_of_the_weave.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_robe_of_the_weave.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_enchantment_2.name: Arcane Enchantment (+2)
arcane_enchantment_2.desc_1: Arcane Enchantment is a passive feature that boosts a caster's spellcasting ability.
arcane_enchantment_2.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

arcane_radiance.name: Arcane Radiance
arcane_radiance.desc_1: Arcane Radiance is a passive feature that debuffs a target hit by spell damage while illuminated.
arcane_radiance.desc_2: When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source, they also inflict  Radiating Orb upon the target for 2 turns.

arcane_vampirism.name: Arcane Vampirism
arcane_vampirism.desc_1: Arcane Vampirism is a passive feature that heals the wearer whenever the wearer applies a negative effect from spells.
arcane_vampirism.desc_2: When the creatures affected by your spells fail any associated  Saving throws, you regain 1d4⁠hit points.

arcane_vehemence.name: Arcane Vehemence
arcane_vehemence.desc_1: Arcane Vehemence is a passive feature that restores a spell slot when you land a critical hit.
arcane_vehemence.desc_2: Once per Short Rest, you regain a Level 1 spell slot when you land a Critical Hit with the Spellthief.

arcane_vivaciousness.name: Arcane Vivaciousness
arcane_vivaciousness.desc_1: Arcane Vivaciousness is a passive feature that grants the wearer temporary health while casting spells in melee range.
arcane_vivaciousness.desc_2: You gain  8 temporary hit points after casting a spell while in melee. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane_ward.desc_1: Arcane Ward is a passive feature of the Abjuration School Wizard. Upon casting an Abjuration spell[See: Bugs], gain a charge in Arcane Ward which blocks incoming damage. Each time damage is taken, it is reduced by the charge count and the charge count decreases by one.
arcane_ward.desc_2: The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm. Each time you cast an Abjuration spell, the intensity of the ward increases by the amount of the spell's Level, up to a maximum of 2x your Wizard level. Each time you take damage, the ward blocks an amount of damage equal to its intensity, and its intensity decreases by 1. After each Long Rest, the ward's intensity resets, and becomes the same as your Wizard level.

archery.name: Archery
archery.desc_1: Archery is a Fighting Style passive feature.
archery.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls you make with ranged Weapons.

arctic_i.name: Arctic I
arctic_i.desc_1: Arctic is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land.
arctic_i.desc_2: You can cast  Hold Person and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Haste. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Ice Storm. You can cast  Cone of Cold and  Contagion.

arctic_ii.name: Arctic II
arctic_ii.desc_1: Arctic is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land.
arctic_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Hold Person and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Haste. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Ice Storm. You can cast  Cone of Cold and  Contagion.

arctic_iii.name: Arctic III
arctic_iii.desc_1: Arctic is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land.
arctic_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Hold Person and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Haste. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Ice Storm. You can cast  Cone of Cold and  Contagion.

arctic_iv.name: Arctic IV
arctic_iv.desc_1: Arctic is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land.
arctic_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Hold Person and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Haste. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Ice Storm. You can cast  Cone of Cold and  Contagion.

arming_enhancement.name: Arming Enhancement
arming_enhancement.desc_1: Arming Enhancement is a passive feature that adds a straight +2 enchantment to your current weapon.
arming_enhancement.desc_2: Gain a +2 Bonus to Attack roll and damage rolls with weapons.

armour_of_agathys.name: Armour of Agathys
armour_of_agathys.desc_1: Armour of Agathys is a passive feature granted by the condition and spell of the same name.
armour_of_agathys.desc_2: A spectral frost covers you and your gear. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 5 x spell level⁠Cold.

armour_of_shadows.name: Armour of Shadows
armour_of_shadows.desc_1: Armour of Shadows is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to cast Mage Armour at will.
armour_of_shadows.desc_2: You can cast  Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot. Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you are not wearing armour. Mage Armour increases your  Armour Class when you aren't wearing armour.

army_arcana.name: Army Arcana
army_arcana.desc_1: Army Arcana is a passive feature that prevents your allies from taking damage from your spells.
army_arcana.desc_2: Create pockets of safety within your spells. Allies automatically succeed their  Saving throws against these spells and take no damage from them.

artificer_s_lore.name: Artificer's Lore
artificer_s_lore.desc_1: Artificer's Lore is a passive feature available to Rock Gnomes. They add twice their Proficiency Bonus to History checks.
artificer_s_lore.desc_2: Add twice your  Proficiency Bonus to  History checks.

artificial_sight.name: Artificial Sight
artificial_sight.desc_1: Artificial Sight is a passive feature that lets the user see even when blinded.
artificial_sight.desc_2: The wearer can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft and cannot be  Blinded.

aspect_of_the_beast_bear.name: Aspect of the Beast: Bear
aspect_of_the_beast_bear.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Bear is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the strength of a bear.
aspect_of_the_beast_bear.desc_2: The Aspect of the Bear infuses you with strength. Your Carrying Capacity is doubled, and you have  Advantage on Strength Checks.

aspect_of_the_beast_chimpanzee.name: Aspect of the Beast: Chimpanzee
aspect_of_the_beast_chimpanzee.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Chimpanzee is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the nimble agility of a chimpanzee.
aspect_of_the_beast_chimpanzee.desc_2: The Aspect of the Chimpanzee grants you a nimble mischievousness. You gain Resistance to falling damage, and throwing camp supplies  Blinds targets.

aspect_of_the_beast_crocodile.name: Aspect of the Beast: Crocodile
aspect_of_the_beast_crocodile.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Crocodile is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the swimming agility of a crocodile.
aspect_of_the_beast_crocodile.desc_2: The Aspect of the Crocodile increases your agility in the water. Your Movement Speed increases by  3 m / 10 ft while standing in water-based surfaces. On slippery surfaces, you also have  Advantage on Saving Throws against being knocked  Prone

aspect_of_the_beast_eagle.name: Aspect of the Beast: Eagle
aspect_of_the_beast_eagle.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Eagle is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with eyesight of an eagle.
aspect_of_the_beast_eagle.desc_2: The Aspect of the Eagle enhances your eyesight. You can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft, and gain  Advantage on Perception Checks.

aspect_of_the_beast_elk.name: Aspect of the Beast: Elk
aspect_of_the_beast_elk.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Elk is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the agility of an elk.
aspect_of_the_beast_elk.desc_2: The Aspect of the Elk grants you astounding swiftness. You can use  Aspect of the Elk, giving yourself and nearby allies extra Movement Speed.

aspect_of_the_beast_honey_badger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger
aspect_of_the_beast_honey_badger.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger is a Wildheart Barbarian toggleable passive feature that infuses you with the resilience of a honey badger.
aspect_of_the_beast_honey_badger.desc_2: If you're  Poisoned,  Frightened, or  Charmed at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin Raging without expending a Rage Charge.

aspect_of_the_beast_stallion.name: Aspect of the Beast: Stallion
aspect_of_the_beast_stallion.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Stallion is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the steadfastness of a horse.
aspect_of_the_beast_stallion.desc_2: The Aspect of the Stallion creates safety in movement. Dashing grants you  temporary hit points equal to twice your Barbarian level. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

aspect_of_the_beast_tiger.name: Aspect of the Beast: Tiger
aspect_of_the_beast_tiger.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Tiger is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the ferociousness of a tiger.
aspect_of_the_beast_tiger.desc_2: The Aspect of the Tiger infuses you with an unrelenting ferocity. You add an additional Strength Modifier to Attack Rolls against  Bleeding or  Poisoned targets, and gain Proficiency in Survival

aspect_of_the_beast_wolf.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolf
aspect_of_the_beast_wolf.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Wolf is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the stealthiness of a wolf.
aspect_of_the_beast_wolf.desc_2: The Aspect of the Wolf boosts your stealthiness. You gain Proficiency in Stealth, and can use  Aspect of the Wolf.

aspect_of_the_beast_wolverine.name: Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine
aspect_of_the_beast_wolverine.desc_1: Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine is a Wildheart Barbarian passive feature that infuses you with the relentlessness of a wolverine.
aspect_of_the_beast_wolverine.desc_2: The Aspect of the Wolverine grants you the tools to relentlessly pursue your prey. When you attack a  Bleeding or  Poisoned target, you also  Maim it for 1 turn

assassin_s_alacrity.name: Assassin's Alacrity
assassin_s_alacrity.desc_1: Assassin's Alacrity is an Assassin Rogue passive feature that greatly enhances your first turn in combat
assassin_s_alacrity.desc_2: Quick as an alley cat in a rain-dark city, you immediately restore your  Action and  Bonus Action at the start of combat

assassinate_ambush.name: Assassinate: Ambush
assassinate_ambush.desc_1: Assassinate: Ambush is an Assassin Rogue passive feature that greatly increases damage against foes you surprise.
assassinate_ambush.desc_2: Any successful Attack Roll against a  Surprised creature is a Critical Hit.

assassinate_initiative.name: Assassinate: Initiative
assassinate_initiative.desc_1: Assassinate: Initiative is an Assassin Rogue passive feature that increases the chance of a successful attack if you act before they do.
assassinate_initiative.desc_2: You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have  Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

athlete_standing_up.name: Athlete: Standing Up
athlete_standing_up.desc_1: Athlete: Standing Up is passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. You become adept at getting up and are able to leap much further than before.
athlete_standing_up.desc_2: When you are  Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement. Your  Jump distance also increases by 50%.

aura_of_murder.name: Aura of Murder
aura_of_murder.desc_1: Aura of Murder is a toggleable passive feature. It creates an aura which makes enemies Vulnerable to Piercing damage.
aura_of_murder.desc_2: Enemies within 3 m / 10 ft become Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.

authority.name: Authority
authority.desc_1: Authority is a passive feature that grants improved intimidation and insight.
authority.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Intimidation checks and Insight checks.

aversion_of_fire.name: Aversion of Fire
aversion_of_fire.desc_1: Aversion of Fire is a Flesh passive feature that penalises him for taking ⁠Fire damage.
aversion_of_fire.desc_2: If this entity takes Fire damage, it receives  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks until the end of its next turn.

awakened.name: Awakened
awakened.desc_1: Awakened is a passive feature that makes all Illithid Powers cost a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
awakened.desc_2: You can use all of your Illithid Powers as a Bonus Action. Your resistance to the zaith'isk in the githyanki infirmary awakened this power.

balance.name: Balance
balance.desc_1: Balance is a passive feature that enhances the wearer's dexterity.
balance.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity  Saving throws and  Ability checks

balduran_s_favour.name: Balduran's Favour
balduran_s_favour.desc_1: Balduran's Favour is a passive feature that boosts the wearer's defenses.
balduran_s_favour.desc_2: You have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving throws.

balduran_s_vitality.name: Balduran's Vitality
balduran_s_vitality.desc_1: Balduran's Vitality is a passive feature that heals the wearer a little bit each turn.
balduran_s_vitality.desc_2: The helmet heals you 2⁠hit points at the beginning of every turn.

baneful_bond.name: Baneful Bond
baneful_bond.desc_1: Baneful Bond is a passive feature that diminishes your target's combat capabilities on each hit.
baneful_bond.desc_2: On a hit, possibly  Bane your target.

baneful_strike.name: Baneful Strike
baneful_strike.desc_1: Baneful Strike is a passive feature that applies a penalty to the user's targets when damaged by the user.
baneful_strike.desc_2: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, the target receives a   -1d4 penalty to its  Saving throw against your next spell.

bardic_inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
bardic_inspiration.desc_1: Bardic Inspiration is a passive feature that allows the user to bardically inspire their allies and influence the outcome of their rolls.

bardic_roll.name: Bardic Roll
bardic_roll.desc_1: Bardic Roll is a toggleable passive feature granted by having a Bardic Inspiration.
bardic_roll.desc_2: Add a   +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check. You expend your  Bardic Inspiration when the effect triggers.

battle_acuity.name: Battle Acuity
battle_acuity.desc_1: Battle Acuity is a passive feature that increases your spellcasting when you deal weapon damage.
battle_acuity.desc_2: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, you gain  Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

battlemage_s_power.name: Battlemage's Power
battlemage_s_power.desc_1: Battlemage's Power is a passive feature that enhances the user's spellcasting whenever they damage a foe with a weapon attack spell.
battlemage_s_power.desc_2: When you hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon, you gain  Arcane Acuity.

bear_heart.name: Bear Heart
bear_heart.resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, Thunder
bear_heart.desc_1: Bear Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
bear_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, you can use  Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.

beast_speech.name: Beast Speech
beast_speech.desc_1: Beast Speech is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to cast Speak with Animals at will.
beast_speech.desc_2: You can cast  Speak with Animals on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.

beast_tamer.name: Beast Tamer
beast_tamer.desc_1: Beast Tamer is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. You gain the spell  Find Familiar and can cast it at will without using a Spell Slot.
beast_tamer.desc_2: You have cultivated a strong bond with animals. You can cast  Find Familiar without expending a spell slot.

become_the_bulwark.name: Become the Bulwark
become_the_bulwark.desc_1: Become the Bulwark is a passive feature that enhances the user's defence if they are not wearing any armour.
become_the_bulwark.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to  Armour Class as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

beguiling_defences.name: Beguiling Defences
beguiling_defences.desc_1: Beguiling Defences is an Archfey Warlock passive feature that makes the Warlock immune to charm.
beguiling_defences.desc_2: You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be  Charmed.

beguiling_influence.name: Beguiling Influence
beguiling_influence.desc_1: Beguiling Influence is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You gain the ability to invoke your patron's charm improve your Deception and Persuasion.
beguiling_influence.desc_2: You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.

bend_luck.name: Bend Luck
bend_luck.desc_1: Bend Luck is a passive feature granted to Wild Magic Sorcerers.
bend_luck.desc_2: When a creature you can see makes an Attack roll, Ability Check, or a  Saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend  2 Sorcery Points to roll 1d4, applying the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc_1: Berserk is a Flesh passive feature. This passive feature allows the entity to go  Berserk if its health diminishes.
berserk.desc_2: This entity will go  Berserk if its health diminishes.

bestial_fury.name: Bestial Fury
bestial_fury.desc_1: Bestial Fury is a Beast Master Ranger passive feature that enhances your companions by granting them the ability to make a second attack along with their first attack, similar to the  Extra Attack class feature.
bestial_fury.desc_2: Grants all your companions an extra attack.

blazing_hide.name: Blazing Hide
blazing_hide.desc_1: Blazing Hide is a passive feature found on Hellsboars that causes melee attackers to start burning.
blazing_hide.desc_2: When the hellsboar is hit with a melee attack, the attacker starts  Burning for 3 turns.

blessed_healer.name: Blessed Healer
blessed_healer.desc_1: Blessed Healer is a Life Domain Cleric passive feature that heals the Cleric whenever it heals someone other than itself for 2 + the spell's level⁠hit points.
blessed_healer.desc_2: Healing others heals you as well. When you cast a healing spell of Level 1 or higher on another creature, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level⁠hit points.

blessed_mercy.name: Blessed Mercy
blessed_mercy.desc_1: Blessed Mercy is a passive feature that adds attack bonuses and saving throw bonuses when the wearer heals them.
blessed_mercy.desc_2: When you heal a creature, it gains a   +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and  Saving throws for 2 turns.

blessings_of_knowledge.name: Blessings of Knowledge
blessings_of_knowledge.desc_1: Blessings of Knowledge is a passive feature gained by the Knowledge Domain Cleric.
blessings_of_knowledge.desc_2: Gain Expertise in two of the following Skills:  Arcana,  History,  Nature, or  Religion. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Ability Checks made using these Skills.

blightbringer.name: Blightbringer
blightbringer.desc_1: Blightbringer is a passive feature that deals extra damage against gnomes or dwarves.
blightbringer.desc_2: Attacking Gnomes or Dwarves with this weapon receives a 1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

blind_immunity.name: Blind Immunity
blind_immunity.desc_1: Blind Immunity is a passive feature that prevents the wielder from being blinded.

blindsight.name: Blindsight
blindsight.desc_1: Blindsight is a passive feature that allows a creature to perceive its surroundings without sight. As an example, the Strange Ox has Blindsight.
blindsight.desc_2: This creature can perceive its surroundings without relying on sight.

blood_thirst.name: Blood Thirst
blood_thirst.desc_1: Blood Thirst is a passive feature that allows the wearer to deal extra damage if they themselves are injured.
blood_thirst.desc_2: Unarmed and melee attacks will deal an extra 2⁠Necrotic damage as long as you don't have your full health. If you don't deal any damage this turn, you will take 1d4⁠Necrotic damage at the end of your turn.

blood_curdling_emission.name: Blood-Curdling Emission
blood_curdling_emission.desc_1: Blood-Curdling Emission is a passive feature that allows the weapon to scare its target. It deals extra damage and increases chance to hit against frightened targets.
blood_curdling_emission.desc_2: On a hit, possibly inflict  Frightened. Gain a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage against Frightened creatures.

body_aid.name: Body Aid
body_aid.desc_1: Body Aid is a passive feature that improves the wearer's strength based abilities.
body_aid.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to Strength  Saving throws and  Ability checks.

bolstering_smite.name: Bolstering Smite
bolstering_smite.desc_1: Bolstering Smite is a passive feature that gives the wearer temporary hit points when they inflict a condition with a smite.
bolstering_smite.desc_2: When you apply a condition with one of your Smite spells, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

book_of_ancient_secrets.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
book_of_ancient_secrets.spells: Chromatic Orb, Ray of Sickness, Silence
book_of_ancient_secrets.desc_1: Book of Ancient Secrets is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows.
book_of_ancient_secrets.desc_2: You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Gain  Ray of Sickness,  Chromatic Orb, and  Silence spells. You can cast them once per Long Rest and they don't expend spell slots

booming_blows.name: Booming Blows
booming_blows.desc_1: Booming Blows is a passive feature that adds thunder damage to the wielder's unarmed attacks.
booming_blows.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Thunder damage.

boon_of_the_raven_queen.name: Boon of the Raven Queen
boon_of_the_raven_queen.desc_1: Boon of the Raven Queen is a passive feature that boosts the wearer's shapeshifting ability and grants the ability to float down gracefully from a tall height.
boon_of_the_raven_queen.desc_2: While wearing the amulet, the wearer's jump and flying speed increase by  1.5 m / 5 ft, and they gain the  Feather Fall condition. Feather Fall's effect will persist while the wearer is  Polymorphed or Wild-Shaped.

boooal_s_faithful.name: BOOOAL's Faithful
boooal_s_faithful.desc_1: BOOOAL's Faithful is a passive feature of the Kuo-Tua who worship BOOOAL and allows them to apply  Bleeding to their targets.
boooal_s_faithful.desc_2: Chance to apply Bleeding to targets.

booze_remedy.name: Booze Remedy
booze_remedy.desc_1: Booze Remedy is a passive feature that keeps the wearer drunk for longer and lets them regain health.
booze_remedy.desc_2: While wearing this amulet, regain 2d4⁠hit points per turn while  Drunk. Additionally, increase the duration of your inebriation by 5 rounds.

born_into_darkness.name: Born into Darkness
born_into_darkness.desc_1: Born into Darkness is a passive feature that allows this creature to see through magical and non-magical darkness, and cannot be Blinded.
born_into_darkness.desc_2: This creature can see through magical and non-magical darkness, and cannot be  Blinded.

bounty_hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bounty_hunter.desc_1: Bounty Hunter is a Ranger passive effect of Favoured Enemy. Your mastery at hunting bounties shines through. You gain proficiency in Investigation and enemies have Disadvantage on their saving throw vs Ensnaring Strike.
bounty_hunter.desc_2: Gain Proficiency in Investigation. Creatures you hit with  Ensnaring Strike (either ranged or melee) have  Disadvantage on their Saving Throw.

brand_of_the_absolute.name: Brand of the Absolute
brand_of_the_absolute.desc_1: The Brand of the Absolute is an optional permanent bonus that leads to unique dialogue options and powerful item interactions.
brand_of_the_absolute.desc_2: The Brand of the Absolute is an optional permanent bonus that leads to unique dialogue options and powerful item interactions.

brave.name: Brave
brave.desc_1: Brave is a passive feature available to all Halflings. It grants them Advantage on Saving Throws against being Frightened.
brave.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws against  Frightened.

brave_liara_portyr.name: Brave (Liara Portyr)
brave_liara_portyr.desc_1: Brave is a passive feature available to Liara Portyr.
brave_liara_portyr.desc_2: A stalwart heart grants the affected entity  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Frightened.

break_the_unbroken.name: Break the Unbroken
break_the_unbroken.desc_1: Break the Unbroken is a passive feature that increase damage against undamaged targets.
break_the_unbroken.desc_2: Deals an additional 1d8⁠Piercing to targets that still have all their hit points.

breezeswift_speed.name: Breezeswift Speed
breezeswift_speed.desc_1: Breezeswift Speed is a passive feature that increases a monk's attacks.
breezeswift_speed.desc_2: While using  Step of the Wind, your next Attack roll has  Advantage and deals an additional 1d8⁠Force damage.

browbeaten.name: Browbeaten
browbeaten.desc_1: Browbeaten is a passive feature that enhances defense against spells while threatened by a nearby enemy.
browbeaten.desc_2: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to spell save DC while  Threatened.

brutal_critical.name: Brutal Critical
brutal_critical.desc_1: Brutal Critical is a Barbarian passive feature. The barbarian makes their critical hits even deadlier.
brutal_critical.desc_2: You've trained to strike swift and true. When you land a Critical Hit, you roll an extra damage die as well as the normal additional critical die.

brute.name: Brute
brute.desc_1: Brute is a Bugbear passive feature that causes them to deal extra damage with melee weapons.
brute.desc_2: Deals an extra 1d8⁠Physical when attacking with a melee weapon.

bull_s_strength.name: Bull's Strength
bull_s_strength.desc_1: Bull's Strength is a passive feature that increases your strength.
bull_s_strength.desc_2: You gain  Bull's Strength and increase your  Strength by 2, to a maximum of 20.

burned_alive.name: Burned Alive
burned_alive.desc_1: Burned Alive is a passive feature that deals additional magical ⁠Weapon damage to targets that are Burning.
burned_alive.desc_2: Deals an additional 1d4⁠Weapon damage to  Burning targets.

callous_glow.name: Callous Glow
callous_glow.desc_1: Callous Glow is a passive feature that adds damage to targets that are illuminated.
callous_glow.desc_2: The wearer deals an additional 2 points of ⁠Radiant[See: Bugs] damage against creatures that are illuminated.

careful_veil.name: Careful Veil
careful_veil.desc_1: Careful Veil is a passive feature unique to Poltergeists.
careful_veil.desc_2: This creature has  Disadvantage on Dexterity  Saving throws while  Invisible.

caretaker_s_care.name: Caretaker's Care
caretaker_s_care.desc_1: Caretaker's Care is a passive feature that provides protection against Acid surfaces and damage.
caretaker_s_care.desc_2: Acidic surfaces don't affect you, and you are Resistant to ⁠Acid damage.

cat_s_grace.name: Cat's Grace
cat_s_grace.desc_1: Cat's Grace is a passive feature that enhances your dexterity as well as others.
cat_s_grace.desc_2: You gain  Cat's Grace and increase your  Dexterity by 2, to a maximum of 20.

caustic_reprisal.name: Caustic Reprisal
caustic_reprisal.desc_1: Caustic Reprisal is a passive feature that retaliates against an attacker that hits the wearer.
caustic_reprisal.desc_2: Whenever a creature deals melee damage to the wearer, that creature takes 1d4⁠Acid Damage.

caustic_strikes.name: Caustic Strikes
caustic_strikes.desc_1: Caustic Strikes is a feature available to the Strange Ox in Tactician difficulty and above. It significantly increases the power of its melee attacks.
caustic_strikes.desc_2: This creature's attack deals additional 4d8⁠Acid damage and may inflict Paralysed.

cauteriser.name: Cauteriser
cauteriser.desc_1: Cauteriser is a passive feature that causes the weapon to deal additional fire damage and burn targets.
cauteriser.desc_2: Deals an additional 1d4⁠Fire. On a hit, the target starts  Burning unless it succeeds a Constitution  Saving throw.

cautious_healer.name: Cautious Healer
cautious_healer.desc_1: Cautious Healer is a passive feature that lets the user automatically escape an enemy after healing.
cautious_healer.desc_2: When the wearer heals a creature, it automatically  Disengages and won't trigger  Opportunity Attacks.

channel_divinity_guided_strike.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
channel_divinity_guided_strike.desc_1: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike is a passive feature used by  Adrielle. It allows her to use her Channel Divinity Charges to grant +10 to their next attack roll.
channel_divinity_guided_strike.desc_2: Channel the guidance of your god to strike with supernatural accuracy. You gain a +10 bonus to your Attack roll.

channel_divinity_touch_of_death.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
channel_divinity_touch_of_death.desc_1: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death is a Death Domain Cleric passive feature that allows the user to deal extra Necrotic damage with your melee attack.
channel_divinity_touch_of_death.desc_2: When hitting a creature with a melee attack,  Channel Divinity Charge can be used to deal extra 5 + 2 × (Cleric level)⁠Necrotic damage.

channel_divinity_war_god_s_blessing.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
channel_divinity_war_god_s_blessing.desc_1: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing is a passive feature that enables use of the reaction  War God's Blessing.
channel_divinity_war_god_s_blessing.desc_2: Endow a nearby ally with the glory of your god to grant them a +10 bonus to their Attack Roll.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc_1: Chaos is a passive feature which heals the wielder on every hit.

charger.name: Charger
charger.desc_1: Charger is a passive feature granted to those who take a Feat of the same name. It lets the user charge forward and either push or shove a target.
charger.desc_2: Let your speed intensify your onslaught. You can  Shove or deal additional  Weapon Damage when you attack.

charm.name: Charm
charm.desc_1: Charm is a Passive feature/Reaction and Illithid Power that lets you charm an enemy that attacks you.
charm.desc_2: Channel the dark allure of the tadpole to  Charm an enemy that attacks you, preventing them from attacking you until their next turn.

cheeky_tipple.name: Cheeky Tipple
cheeky_tipple.desc_1: Cheeky Tipple is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that prevents the effects of being intoxicated.
cheeky_tipple.desc_2: You are Immune to the negative effects of being  Drunk. Once per day, when you drink alcohol, you regain half your  Ki Points (rounded down).

child_of_the_moonmaiden.name: Child of the Moonmaiden
child_of_the_moonmaiden.desc_1: Child of the Moonmaiden is a passive feature available to Dame Aylin, that prevents her from being permanently killed.
child_of_the_moonmaiden.desc_2: Blessed with the favour of a goddess, Nightsong cannot be permanently killed. When unconscious, the start of her turn she recovers 1 hit point.

chilling_counter.name: Chilling Counter
chilling_counter.desc_1: Chilling Counter is a passive feature that chills a creature that misses you with an attack.
chilling_counter.desc_2: When a creature misses you with an attack, it must succeed a DC 13  Constitution saving throw or be  Chilled for 2 turns.[See: Bugs]

chilling_strike.name: Chilling Strike
chilling_strike.desc_1: Chilling Strike is a passive feature that adds cold damage to every unarmed attack.
chilling_strike.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Cold damage.

chilling_strikes.name: Chilling Strikes
chilling_strikes.desc_1: Chilling Strikes is a passive feature that inflicts Bone Chill on targets you attack.
chilling_strikes.desc_2: Your strikes Bone Chill your target. They cannot regain hit points and if they are undead they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

cinders.name: Cinders
cinders.desc_1: Cinders is a passive feature that allows the wearer to build up heat whenever they burn an enemy.
cinders.desc_2: Whenever you  Burn an enemy, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

civil_militia.name: Civil Militia
civil_militia.desc_1: Civil Militia is a passive feature that grants Proficiency with spears, pikes, halberds, and glaives as well as with Light Armour and Shields.
civil_militia.desc_2: You have Weapon Proficiency with  Spears,  Pikes,  Halberds,  Glaives,  Light armour, and  Shields.

cleansing_touch.name: Cleansing Touch
cleansing_touch.desc_1: Cleansing Touch is a passive feature that removes poison from any character the user heals.
cleansing_touch.desc_2: If the wearer heals a  Poisoned creature, it is no longer poisoned.

cloud_of_jellyfish.name: Cloud of Jellyfish
cloud_of_jellyfish.actions: Cloud of Jellyfish: Attack, Cloud of Jellyfish: Shocking Sting, Cloud of Jellyfish: Teleport
cloud_of_jellyfish.desc_1: Cloud of Jellyfish is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers. It turns the Gathered Swarm into jellyfish that deal ⁠Lightning damage and can shock enemies. This feature can be switched out at level up.
cloud_of_jellyfish.desc_2: You gain a swarm of jellyfish that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional ⁠Lightning damage,  Shock your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location. At higher levels At level 11,  Mighty Swarm upgrades the swarm options to:

coast_i.name: Coast I
coast_i.desc_1: Coast is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
coast_i.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Call Lightning. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Confusion. You can cast  Conjure Elemental and  Greater Restoration.

coast_ii.name: Coast II
coast_ii.desc_1: Coast is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
coast_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Call Lightning. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Confusion. You can cast  Conjure Elemental and  Greater Restoration.

coast_iii.name: Coast III
coast_iii.desc_1: Coast is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
coast_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Call Lightning. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Confusion. You can cast  Conjure Elemental and  Greater Restoration.

coast_iv.name: Coast IV
coast_iv.desc_1: Coast is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
coast_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Sleet Storm and  Call Lightning. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Confusion. You can cast  Conjure Elemental and  Greater Restoration.

coin_armour.name: Coin Armour
coin_armour.desc_1: Coin Armour is a passive feature available to Gerringothe Thorm, that gives her additional health.
coin_armour.desc_2: Armoured in enchanted coins, this creature is a clinking emblem of golden greed. Could there be a method of removing the armour without destroying the coins?

coldbrim_chill.name: Coldbrim Chill
coldbrim_chill.desc_1: Coldbrim Chill is a passive feature that chills the wearer's target whenever they apply a condition.
coldbrim_chill.desc_2: Once per turn, any condition inflicted on a target, also applies 2 turns of  Encrusted with Frost.[See: Bugs]

colossus_slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossus_slayer.desc_1: Colossus Slayer is a Hunter Ranger passive feature. This ability allows them to deal extra damage to targets whose Hit Points are below the maximum value.
colossus_slayer.desc_2: Once per turn, your weapon attack deals an extra 1d8⁠PhysicalDRS damage if the target is below its hit point maximum.

combat_regeneration.name: Combat Regeneration
combat_regeneration.desc_1: Combat Regeneration is a passive feature that heals the wearer at the start of their turn
combat_regeneration.desc_2: At the beginning of your turn, the ring activates and heals you 1d4⁠hit points.

companion_s_bond.name: Companion's Bond
companion_s_bond.desc_1: Companion's Bond is a Beast Master Ranger passive feature that enhances your companion.
companion_s_bond.desc_2: Your  Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to  Armour Class and damage equal to its  Proficiency Bonus. Upgraded  hit points and abilities for your companion and a new visual look.

conductive_strikes.name: Conductive Strikes
conductive_strikes.desc_1: Conductive Strikes is a passive feature that adds lightning charges when performing an unarmed attack.
conductive_strikes.desc_2: On a hit with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains 2  Lightning Charges.

consume_life_essence.name: Consume Life Essence
consume_life_essence.desc_1: Consume Life Essence is a passive feature granted by the  Life Essence condition.
consume_life_essence.desc_2: Consume the life essence that you have collected to cast any Necromancy spell without consuming a spell slot.

consume_the_faithful.name: Consume the Faithful
consume_the_faithful.desc_1: Consume the Faithful is a Passive feature/Reaction used by the Apostle of Myrkul. This ability consumes a Necromite that is using the ability  For the Lord of Bones! on it. Grants the ability to cast  Finger of Death once per Necromite.
consume_the_faithful.desc_2: Consume a necromite's soul to gain the ability to cast  Finger of Death. Tactician and Above: Also heals the caster for 8d8⁠hit points.

consumed_shadow_weave.name: Consumed Shadow Weave
consumed_shadow_weave.desc_1: Consumed Shadow Weave is a passive feature unique to Gale Origin that grants him a  Level 3 Shadow Spell Slot.
consumed_shadow_weave.desc_2: Gale has gained a level 3 spell slot. It restores on a Long Rest.

corellon_s_guiding_hand.name: Corellon's Guiding Hand
corellon_s_guiding_hand.desc_1: Corellon's Guiding Hand is a passive feature that guides the user on how to use various bows and to be more effective with them.
corellon_s_guiding_hand.desc_2: You gain Proficiency with  Longbows and  Shortbows. In addition, your ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 2 damage.

cosmic_omen.name: Cosmic Omen
cosmic_omen.actions: Cosmic Omen of Weal: Attack Roll, Cosmic Omen of Weal: Saving Throw, Cosmic Omen of Woe: Attack Roll, Cosmic Omen of Woe: Saving Throw
cosmic_omen.desc_1: Cosmic Omen is a passive feature that allows Circle of the Stars druids to consult the stars.
cosmic_omen.desc_2: Whenever you Long Rest, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe) Attack rolls or  Saving throws, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' Ability Checks.

countershock.name: Countershock
countershock.desc_1: Countershock is a passive feature that zaps enemies while they attack the user.
countershock.desc_2: When the wearer takes damage while having  Lightning Charges, the attacker must succeed a Dexterity  Saving throw or become  Shocked.

covert_critical.name: Covert Critical
covert_critical.desc_1: Covert Critical is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to critical hit while in shadow.
covert_critical.desc_2: While obscured, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

crackling_resonance.name: Crackling Resonance
crackling_resonance.desc_1: Crackling Resonance is a passive feature that inflicts reverberation on targets whenever you do a ranged spell attack.
crackling_resonance.desc_2: When the wearer deals damage with a ranged Spell Attack, inflict 2 turns of  Reverberation on the target(s).

craterous_wounds.name: Craterous Wounds
craterous_wounds.desc_1: Craterous Wounds is a passive feature that adds additional force damage on a critical hit.
craterous_wounds.desc_2: Whenever you score a Critical Hit, deal an additional 1d6⁠ForceDRS damage.

crimson_weapon.name: Crimson Weapon
crimson_weapon.desc_1: Crimson Weapon is a passive feature that adds extra damage to your attacks.
crimson_weapon.desc_2: When you make an attack with your off-hand weapon, you can add your Ability Modifier to the damage of the attack.

critical_virtuoso.name: Critical Virtuoso
critical_virtuoso.desc_1: Critical Virtuoso is a passive feature that lets you attack again when you score a critical hit.
critical_virtuoso.desc_2: When you score a Critical Hit you can spend a  Bonus Action to make an additional attack.

crossbow_expert_point_blank.name: Crossbow Expert: Point-Blank
crossbow_expert_point_blank.desc_1: Crossbow Expert: Point-Blank is a passive feature that allows you to make crossbow attacks within melee range without having Disadvantage.
crossbow_expert_point_blank.desc_2: When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the Attack Rolls do not have  Disadvantage.

crossbow_expert_wounding.name: Crossbow Expert: Wounding
crossbow_expert_wounding.desc_1: Crossbow Expert: Wounding is a passive feature that inflicts  Gaping Wounds.
crossbow_expert_wounding.desc_2: Your  Piercing Shot inflicts  Gaping Wounds for twice as long.

crowning_glory.name: Crowning Glory
crowning_glory.desc_1: Crowning Glory is a passive feature that heals the wearer when they heal others.
crowning_glory.desc_2: When healing another, the wearer regains 1d6⁠hit points.

crude_frenzy.name: Crude Frenzy
crude_frenzy.desc_1: Crude Frenzy is a passive goblin feature that lets them attack multiple times with the second attack at Disadvantage.
crude_frenzy.desc_2: This goblin can make an additional free attack after making a Main Hand Attack, but the second attack has  Disadvantage on its Attack Roll.

crushing_blows.name: Crushing Blows
crushing_blows.desc_1: Crushing Blows is a passive feature that enhances the user's unarmed accuracy and damage.
crushing_blows.desc_2: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to unarmed Attack rolls and their unarmed attacks deal an additional 2⁠Bludgeoning damage.

cull_the_weak.name: Cull the Weak
cull_the_weak.desc_1: Cull the Weak is a toggleable passive feature and Illithid Power. When a character with this passive active brings a creature down to fewer Hit Points than the character's number of evolved Illithid Powers, the creature dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4⁠Psychic damage.
cull_the_weak.desc_2: When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4⁠Psychic damage.

cull_the_weak_drider.name: Cull the Weak (Drider)
cull_the_weak_drider.desc_1: Cull the Weak is a passive feature that causes the user to deal additional Slashing damage to seriously wounded targets.
cull_the_weak_drider.desc_2: You deal an additional 2d6⁠Slashing damage to targets below 50% of their maximum hit points.

culling_strikes.name: Culling Strikes
culling_strikes.desc_1: Culling Strikes is a passive feature unique to Ptaris' Mental Image that allows it to create new mental images.
culling_strikes.desc_2: The Mental Image creates a new Mental Image each time it hits a character with an attack.

cunning_brume.name: Cunning Brume
cunning_brume.desc_1: Cunning Brume is a passive feature that creates a  cloud at the wearer's feet when they disengage.
cunning_brume.desc_2: When the wearer  Disengages, they also create a foggy cloud with 2 m / 7 ft radius that lasts for 1 turn.

cursed_vengeance.name: Cursed Vengeance
cursed_vengeance.desc_1: Cursed Vengeance is a passive affecting Oliver's Nightdome that protects Oliver and redirects damage back to its source.
cursed_vengeance.desc_2: Oliver's Nightdome won't allow for you to hurt him. Any damage done to the dome will be reflected in twofold to its attacker.

cutting_words.name: Cutting Words
cutting_words.desc_1: Cutting Words is a passive feature available to College of Lore Bards that grants a reaction to apply a penalty die to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks.
cutting_words.desc_2: Use your wit to distract a creature and sap its confidence.

dagger_specialist.name: Dagger Specialist
dagger_specialist.desc_1: Dagger Specialist is passive feature that lets a creature throw up to three daggers per round.
dagger_specialist.desc_2: This creature can throw up to 3 daggers per round.

dagger_thrower.name: Dagger Thrower
dagger_thrower.desc_1: Dagger Thrower is passive feature that lets a creature add double their Proficiency Bonus to the damage made with ranged dagger attacks.
dagger_thrower.desc_2: This creature adds double their Proficiency Bonus to the damage they deal on ranged attacks made with daggers.

damp_aegis.name: Damp Aegis
damp_aegis.desc_1: Damp Aegis is a passive feature that applies effects similarly to being constantly wet.
damp_aegis.desc_2: During Combat, once per turn, the cloak grants the wearer  Water Layer Protection[See: Bugs] until the wearer takes damage.

danger_sense.name: Danger Sense
danger_sense.desc_1: Danger Sense is a Barbarian passive feature that gives you Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws against traps, Spells, and surfaces as long as you aren't Blinded or Incapacitated.
danger_sense.desc_2: You sense when things aren't as they should be. You have  Advantage on  Dexterity saving throws, such as against traps, Spells, and surfaces. To gain this benefit, you can't be  Blinded or  Incapacitated.

daredevil_proximity.name: Daredevil Proximity
daredevil_proximity.desc_1: Daredevil Proximity is a toggleable passive feature that allows the user to make ranged spell attack rolls without Disadvantage even when adjacent to an enemy.
daredevil_proximity.desc_2: Your Ranged Spell Attacks are made as melee spell attacks when you are adjacent to a hostile creature. This effect can be toggled off.

dark_devotion.name: Dark Devotion
dark_devotion.desc_1: Dark Devotion is a passive feature that grants the user bonuses from being Charmed or Frightened.
dark_devotion.desc_2: Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Charmed or  Frightened

dark_one_s_blessing.name: Dark One's Blessing
dark_one_s_blessing.desc_1: Dark One's Blessing is a passive feature unique to The Fiend Warlock subclass that gives the Warlock temporary Hit Points when killing hostile creatures.
dark_one_s_blessing.desc_2: Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this gift from your patron grants you  Charisma modifier + Warlock level temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

dark_one_s_own_luck.name: Dark One's Own Luck
dark_one_s_own_luck.desc_1: Dark One's Own Luck is a toggleable passive feature unique to The Fiend Warlock subclass that adds 1d10 to an Ability Check every Short Rest.
dark_one_s_own_luck.desc_2: Call on your patron to change your fate and add a  1d10 to an  Ability Check.

dark_vengeance.name: Dark Vengeance
dark_vengeance.desc_1: This feature gives the character advantage against targets standing in Darkness.
dark_vengeance.desc_2: The Justiciar has advantage against targets standing in darkness.

darkveil_precision.name: Darkveil Precision
darkveil_precision.desc_1: Darkveil Precision is a passive feature that grants a bonus chance to hit while hidden in shadow.
darkveil_precision.desc_2: While obscured in shadow, the wielder has a +1d4 bonus to their ranged weapon attacks.

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.desc_1: Darkvision is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 12 m / 40 ft, 24 m / 80 ft for  Superior Darkvision. Some creatures have darkvision with custom range.
darkvision.desc_2: Can see in the dark up to 12 m / 40 ft.

dauntless.name: Dauntless
dauntless.desc_1: Dauntless is a passive feature that prevents you from being Frightened.
dauntless.desc_2: You can't be  Frightened, and cannot be afflicted with other emotion-altering conditions.

dazing_echo.name: Dazing Echo
dazing_echo.desc_1: Dazing Echo is a passive feature that dazes enemies if a creature with Reverberation attacks the wearer.
dazing_echo.desc_2: When a creature with  Reverberation deals damage to the wearer, the creature needs to make a  Constitution saving throw or become  Dazed.

dazing_smite.name: Dazing Smite
dazing_smite.desc_1: Dazing Smite is a passive feature that dazzles targets you hit with a Smite.
dazing_smite.desc_2: On a hit infused with one of your Smites, the target must succeed a  Constitution saving throw or become  Dazed.

dazzling_blows.name: Dazzling Blows
dazzling_blows.desc_1: Dazzling Blows is a passive feature that enables attacks to potentially Blind targets. Targets must pass a DC 13  Constitution saving throw or become  Blinded.
dazzling_blows.desc_2: Attacks from this creature can possibly Blind the target.

deadly_derivation.name: Deadly Derivation
deadly_derivation.desc_1: Deadly Derivation is a passive feature that heals the wearer a little when they poison a foe.
deadly_derivation.desc_2: When you  Poison a foe, heal yourself for 1d4⁠hit points.

death_burst.name: Death Burst
death_burst.desc_1: Death Burst is a family of abilities available to mephits that causes them to explode when they die. It has both a passive component that is triggered automatically on death and an active component that lets them manually trigger the explosion, typically dealing twice the damage. Death Burst is available in several different damage types depending on the type of mephit.

death_burst_cold.name: Death Burst: Cold
death_burst_cold.desc_1: Death Burst: Cold is an Ice Mephit Passive Feature. If the Ice Mephit dies, it automatically explodes, dealing cold damage to all nearby creatures. This damage is less than if it willingly explodes with  Death Burst (Cold)
death_burst_cold.desc_2: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of ice that deals 2d6⁠Cold damage to all creatures within  2 m / 7 ft. On a successful save, the creatures still take half damage.

death_burst_fire.name: Death Burst: Fire
death_burst_fire.desc_1: Death Burst: Fire is a Magma Mephit passive feature. If the Magma Mephit dies, it automatically explodes, dealing fire damage to all nearby creatures.
death_burst_fire.desc_2: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lava that deals 2d6⁠Fire damage to all creatures within  2 m / 7 ft. On a successful save, the creatures still take half damage.

death_burst_force.name: Death Burst: Force
death_burst_force.desc_1: Death Burst: Force is a Mud Mephit Passive Feature. If the Mud Mephit dies, it automatically explodes, dealing force damage to all nearby creatures.
death_burst_force.desc_2: When the mephit dies, it explodes with a force that deals 2d6⁠Force damage to all creatures within  2 m / 7 ft. On a successful save, the creatures still take half damage.

death_s_promise.name: Death's Promise
death_s_promise.desc_1: Death's Promise is a passive feature that correct's the weapon's accuracy after a miss.
death_s_promise.desc_2: When the spear misses its target, the wielder's next Attack roll against that target gains  True Strike.

deathbringer_s_sight.name: Deathbringer's Sight
deathbringer_s_sight.desc_1: Deathbringer's Sight is a passive feature that increases the wearer's sight in darkness, as well as their chance to critically hit.
deathbringer_s_sight.desc_2: You gain  Darkvision up to a range of  3 m / 10 ft, or  15 m / 50 ft if you already have it. The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

deathly_slumber.name: Deathly Slumber
deathly_slumber.desc_1: Deathly Slumber is a passive feature that adds extra Necrotic damage to creatures that are sleeping or knocked out.
deathly_slumber.desc_2: Deals an additional 1d4⁠Necrotic to creatures that are  Knocked Out or  Sleeping.

deepen_the_wound.name: Deepen the Wound
deepen_the_wound.desc_1: Deepen the Wound is a passive feature that increase the weapon's accuracy when attacking damaged targets.
deepen_the_wound.desc_2: The wielder gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls with this weapon when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

deepened_pact.name: Deepened Pact
deepened_pact.desc_1: Deepened Pact is a passive feature that grants Warlocks additional bonuses depending on their chosen Pact Boon.
deepened_pact.desc_2: Pleased with your service, your otherworldly patron added new boons to the terms of your pact.

deepflesh_slice.name: Deepflesh Slice
deepflesh_slice.desc_1: Deepflesh Slice is a passive feature that may bleed the target with a good strike.
deepflesh_slice.desc_2: When the wielder attacks with  Advantage, the attack inflicts  Bleeding.

defence.name: Defence
defence.desc_1: Defence is a Fighting Style passive feature.
defence.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Armour Class while wearing Armour.

defensive_attack.name: Defensive Attack
defensive_attack.desc_1: Defensive Attack is a passive feature that lets the wielder of  Defender Greataxe temporarily sacrifices one Enchantment level from the axe to gain +1 bonus AC and saving throws. This choice is given when making the first attack with the axe in a round.
defensive_attack.desc_2: When making your first attack of the round, you can reduce this weapon's enchantment by 1 to increase your  Armour Class and  Saving throw bonus by 1.

defensive_duellist.name: Defensive Duellist
defensive_duellist.desc_1: Defensive Duellist is a reaction obtainable by a feat of the same name. If you are attacked while wielding a Finesse Weapon weapon, you can temporarily increases your Armour Class Armour Class. You must have at least a 13 in Dexterity in order to take this Feat.
defensive_duellist.desc_2: When attacked with a melee attack, add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armour Class Armour Class, possibly causing attacks to miss. Requires a Finesse Weapon you are Proficient in.

defier_s_rejuvenation.name: Defier's Rejuvenation
defier_s_rejuvenation.desc_1: Defier's Rejuvenation is a passive feature that heals the user whenever they pass a check.
defier_s_rejuvenation.desc_2: Whenever the wearer succeeds on a  Saving throw against a Spell, they regain 1d4⁠hit points.

deflect_missiles.name: Deflect Missiles
deflect_missiles.desc_1: Deflect Missiles is a Monk passive feature that allows them to reduce the damage of an incoming ranged attack and potentially return it to the attacker.
deflect_missiles.desc_2: Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

defy_villainy.name: Defy Villainy
defy_villainy.desc_1: Defy Villainy is a passive feature that automatically cures the wearer of a few conditions
defy_villainy.desc_2: When the wearer becomes  Blinded,  Paralysed or  Poisoned, they automatically cast  Lesser Restoration on themselves.

demonspirit_aura.name: Demonspirit Aura
demonspirit_aura.desc_1: Demonspirit Aura is a toggleable passive feature granted by the  Abyss Beckoners. They impart damage resistance to the wearer's summons at the risk of driving them  mad.
demonspirit_aura.desc_2: The wearer's summoned creatures have resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic damage. At the start of the summoned creatures turn, it must succeed a  Wisdom saving throw or be driven  Mad.

desert_i.name: Desert I
desert_i.desc_1: Desert is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels.
desert_i.desc_2: You can cast  Blur and  Silence. At higher levels You can cast  Protection from Energy and  Hypnotic Pattern. You can cast  Blight and  Wall of Fire. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Insect Plague.

desert_ii.name: Desert II
desert_ii.desc_1: Desert is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels.
desert_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Blur and  Silence. At higher levels You can cast  Protection from Energy and  Hypnotic Pattern. You can cast  Blight and  Wall of Fire. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Insect Plague.

desert_iii.name: Desert III
desert_iii.desc_1: Desert is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels.
desert_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Blur and  Silence. At higher levels You can cast  Protection from Energy and  Hypnotic Pattern. You can cast  Blight and  Wall of Fire. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Insect Plague.

desert_iv.name: Desert IV
desert_iv.desc_1: Desert is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels.
desert_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Blur and  Silence. At higher levels You can cast  Protection from Energy and  Hypnotic Pattern. You can cast  Blight and  Wall of Fire. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Insect Plague.

destroy_undead.name: Destroy Undead
destroy_undead.desc_1: Destroy Undead is a Cleric passive feature that deals 4d6⁠Radiant damage to creatures affected by  Turn Undead.
destroy_undead.desc_2: When you successfully  Turn an Undead creature, it also takes 4d6⁠Radiant.

devil_s_sight.name: Devil's Sight
devil_s_sight.desc_1: Devil's Sight is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the wearer to see through both natural and magical darkness.
devil_s_sight.desc_2: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of  24 m / 80 ft.

dextrous_evasion.name: Dextrous Evasion
dextrous_evasion.desc_1: Dextrous Evasion is a passive feature that lets the wearer force a successful dexterity saving throw.
dextrous_evasion.desc_2: When you fail a  Dexterity saving throw, you can use your  Reaction to succeed instead. Grants:

diamondsbane.name: Diamondsbane
diamondsbane.desc_1: Diamondsbane is a passive feature that makes every strike on an object deal a lot of damage.
diamondsbane.desc_2: If an adamantine weapon hits an object, the hit is always critical.

dig_deep.name: Dig Deep
dig_deep.desc_1: Dig Deep is a passive feature that adds extra 1d4⁠Piercing damage to targets previously hit by Deep Delver.
dig_deep.desc_2: Inflicts  Shattered on hit. Deep Delver deals an additional 1d4⁠Piercing against shattered targets.

disciple_of_life.name: Disciple of Life
disciple_of_life.desc_1: Disciple Of Life is a Life Domain Cleric passive feature that makes all healing spells stronger.
disciple_of_life.desc_2: Your devotion empowers your healing Spells. When casting a healing spell, the target regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level⁠hit points.

displace.name: Displace
displace.desc_1: Displace is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature deals an extra 1d8⁠Psychic damage to any creature that suffers Falling damage as a result of the character's actions.
displace.desc_2: Creatures suffering Falling damage because of your actions take an additional 1d8⁠Psychic damage.

displacement.name: Displacement
displacement.desc_1: Displacement is a passive feature that makes it difficult for enemies to hit the wearer in combat.
displacement.desc_2: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies  Disadvantage on Attack rolls that target the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer takes damage.

divine_allegiance.name: Divine Allegiance
divine_allegiance.desc_1: Divine Allegiance is a passive feature available to  Oath of the Crown paladins which allows them to redirect damage dealt to nearby allies to themselves.
divine_allegiance.desc_2: When an ally within 1.5 m / 5 ft of you takes damage, you can use your  Reaction to magically substitute your own health for your ally's, healing them by 2 × (Paladin level)⁠hit points at the cost of taking 2 × (Paladin level)⁠Radiant damage yourself.

divine_health.name: Divine Health
divine_health.desc_1: Divine Health is a Paladin passive feature that makes them immune to disease.
divine_health.desc_2: The divine magic flowing within you prevents disease from affecting you.

dolor_amarus.name: Dolor Amarus
dolor_amarus.desc_1: Dolor Amarus is a passive feature that deals extra damage when you make a critical hit.
dolor_amarus.desc_2: When you land a Critical Hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, it deals an additional 7 damage.

domain_spells.name: Domain Spells
domain_spells.desc_1: Domain Spells is a cleric passive feature.
domain_spells.desc_2: You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.

doom_lobber.name: Doom Lobber
doom_lobber.desc_1: Doom Lobber is a passive feature that boosts the user's spell attacks.
doom_lobber.desc_2: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls.

draconic_ancestry_acid.name: Draconic Ancestry (Acid)
draconic_ancestry_acid.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry is a Dragonborn passive feature; it grants them Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
draconic_ancestry_acid.desc_2: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to ⁠Acid damage.

draconic_ancestry_cold.name: Draconic Ancestry (Cold)
draconic_ancestry_cold.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry is a Dragonborn passive feature; it grants them Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
draconic_ancestry_cold.desc_2: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to ⁠Cold damage.

draconic_ancestry_fire.name: Draconic Ancestry (Fire)
draconic_ancestry_fire.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry is a Dragonborn passive feature; it grants them Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
draconic_ancestry_fire.desc_2: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to ⁠Fire damage.

draconic_ancestry_lightning.name: Draconic Ancestry (Lightning)
draconic_ancestry_lightning.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry is a Dragonborn passive feature; it grants them Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
draconic_ancestry_lightning.desc_2: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to ⁠Lightning damage.

draconic_ancestry_poison.name: Draconic Ancestry (Poison)
draconic_ancestry_poison.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry is a Dragonborn passive feature; it grants them Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
draconic_ancestry_poison.desc_2: The blood of ancient dragons flow through your veins. You are Resistant to ⁠Poison damage.

draconic_ancestry_black_acid.name: Draconic Ancestry: Black (Acid)
draconic_ancestry_black_acid.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Black (Acid) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Acid damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_black_acid.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Acid damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to acid via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_blue_lightning.name: Draconic Ancestry: Blue (Lightning)
draconic_ancestry_blue_lightning.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Blue (Lightning) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Lightning damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_blue_lightning.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Lightning damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to lightning via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_brass_fire.name: Draconic Ancestry: Brass (Fire)
draconic_ancestry_brass_fire.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Brass (Fire) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Fire damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_brass_fire.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_bronze_lightning.name: Draconic Ancestry: Bronze (Lightning)
draconic_ancestry_bronze_lightning.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Bronze (Lightning) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Lightning damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_bronze_lightning.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Lightning damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to lightning via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_copper_acid.name: Draconic Ancestry: Copper (Acid)
draconic_ancestry_copper_acid.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Copper (Acid) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Acid damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_copper_acid.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Acid damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to acid via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_gold_fire.name: Draconic Ancestry: Gold (Fire)
draconic_ancestry_gold_fire.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Gold (Fire) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Fire damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_gold_fire.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_green_poison.name: Draconic Ancestry: Green (Poison)
