draconic_ancestry_green_poison.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Green (Poison) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Poison damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_green_poison.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Poison damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to poison via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_red_fire.name: Draconic Ancestry: Red (Fire)
draconic_ancestry_red_fire.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Red (Fire) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers. The Fire damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_red_fire.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Fire damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to fire via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_silver_cold.name: Draconic Ancestry: Silver (Cold)
draconic_ancestry_silver_cold.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: Silver (Cold) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer. The Cold damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_silver_cold.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Cold damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to cold via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_ancestry_white_cold.name: Draconic Ancestry: White (Cold)
draconic_ancestry_white_cold.desc_1: Draconic Ancestry: White (Cold) is a passive feature available to Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer. The Cold damage type associated with your ancestry is used by features that you gain later.
draconic_ancestry_white_cold.desc_2: Starting at Level 6, spells that deal ⁠Cold damage deal additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier, and you can become resistant to cold via Elemental Affinity: Resistance.

draconic_resilience.name: Draconic Resilience
draconic_resilience.desc_1: Draconic Resilience is a Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer passive feature that raises the Sorcerer's base Armour Class to 13 when not wearing armour.
draconic_resilience.desc_2: Dragon-like scales cover parts of your skin. When you aren't wearing armour, your base  Armour Class is 13.

dragonfire_fists.name: Dragonfire Fists
dragonfire_fists.desc_1: Dragonfire Fists is a passive feature that adds extra fire damage to the user's unarmed attacks.
dragonfire_fists.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Fire.

dread_ambusher.name: Dread Ambusher
dread_ambusher.desc_1: Dread Ambusher is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that makes you deadly on the first turn of combat.
dread_ambusher.desc_2: You specialise in taking out foes swiftly and ruthlessly. You gain a +3 bonus to Initiative. On the first turn of combat, your Movement Speed increases by  3 m / 10 ft, and you can also make an extra weapon attack that deals an additional  1d8 damage

dread_iron_ambush.name: Dread Iron Ambush
dread_iron_ambush.desc_1: Dread Iron Ambush is a passive feature that increases the damage of your weapon while you are hidden.
dread_iron_ambush.desc_2: While its wielder is hidden, this weapon deals an extra 1d6⁠Necrotic.

dreadful_hewer.name: Dreadful Hewer
dreadful_hewer.desc_1: Dreadful Hewer is a passive feature that makes it difficult for enemies to resist your fearful abilities.
dreadful_hewer.desc_2: Your foes have  Disadvantage on Saving Throws to resist your spells or actions that inflict  Fear.

dreadful_word.name: Dreadful Word
dreadful_word.desc_1: Dreadful Word is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Confusion.
dreadful_word.desc_2: You can cast  Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.

drow_weapon_training.name: Drow Weapon Training
drow_weapon_training.desc_1: Drow Weapon Training is a passive feature that grants Drow Proficiency with the Rapier, Shortsword, and Hand Crossbow.
drow_weapon_training.desc_2: You have Proficiency with  Rapiers,  Shortswords, and  Hand Crossbows.

drunken_performance.name: Drunken Performance
drunken_performance.desc_1: Drunken Performance is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that grants Performance proficiency.

dual_wielder.name: Dual Wielder
dual_wielder.desc_1: Dual Wielder is a passive feature obtainable by the Dual Wielder Feat. It allows you to use Two-Weapon Fighting while wielding two non-Heavy weapons even if they aren't Light.
dual_wielder.desc_2: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if the weapons you are wielding aren't Light. You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.

dual_wielder_bonus_armour_class.name: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class
dual_wielder_bonus_armour_class.desc_1: Dual Wielder: Bonus Armour Class is a passive feature obtainable by the Dual Wielder Feat. If you have a melee weapon equipped in both hands, gain +1  Armour Class
dual_wielder_bonus_armour_class.desc_2: You have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.

duelling.name: Duelling
duelling.desc_1: Duelling is a fighting style passive feature.
duelling.desc_2: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon. You can carry a shield in your free hand and still gain this bonus.

duelling_gloves.name: Duelling Gloves
duelling_gloves.desc_1: Duelling Gloves is a passive feature  that grants a bonus to single handed melee weapons.
duelling_gloves.desc_2: While only holding one weapon in your main hand and nothing in your free hand, gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon Attack rolls.

duergar_resilience.name: Duergar Resilience
duergar_resilience.desc_1: Duergar Resilience is a passive feature available to all Duergar characters. It grants Advantage on Saving Throws against illusions and against being Charmed or Paralysed.
duergar_resilience.desc_2: An affected creature has  Advantage on  Saving throws  against Illusions and against being Charmed or  Paralysed.

dungeon_delver_perception.name: Dungeon Delver: Perception
dungeon_delver_perception.desc_1: Dungeon Delver: Perception is a passive feature obtainable by the Dungeon Delver Feat. It gives you a bonus to your Perception when it comes to finding hidden objects.
dungeon_delver_perception.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Perception Checks made to detect hidden objects.

dungeon_delver_resist_traps.name: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps
dungeon_delver_resist_traps.desc_1: Dungeon Delver: Resist Traps is a passive feature obtainable by the Dungeon Delver Feat. It makes the wearer more likely to avoid traps as well as resist the damage from them.
dungeon_delver_resist_traps.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws made to avoid traps and Resistance to trap damage.

durable.name: Durable
durable.desc_1: Durable is a Passive Feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. You regain full HP every time you take a Short Rest
durable.desc_2: Regain full Hit Points every time you take a Short Rest.

dwarven_armour_training.name: Dwarven Armour Training
dwarven_armour_training.desc_1: Dwarven Armour Training is a passive feature that grants Shield Dwarves Proficiency with Light Armour and Medium Armour.
dwarven_armour_training.desc_2: You have Armour Proficiency with  Light armour and  Medium armour.

dwarven_combat_training.name: Dwarven Combat Training
dwarven_combat_training.desc_1: Dwarven Combat Training is a passive feature that grants Dwarves Proficiency with the Battleaxe, Handaxe, Light Hammer, and Warhammers.
dwarven_combat_training.desc_2: You have Proficiency with  Battleaxes,  Handaxes,  Light Hammers, and  Warhammers.

dwarven_resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarven_resilience.desc_1: Dwarven Resilience is a Dwarf passive feature that grants Advantage on Saving Throws against Poison and Resistance to Poison damage.
dwarven_resilience.desc_2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Poisoned and you have Resistance against ⁠Poison damage.

dwarven_thrower.name: Dwarven Thrower
dwarven_thrower.desc_1: Dwarven Thrower is a passive feature that grants extra damage on oversized creatures, if the wielder is a Dwarf.
dwarven_thrower.desc_2: A Dwarf throwing this warhammer deals an extra 1d8⁠Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large, Huge or Gargantuan creature, the strike deals an additional 2d8⁠Bludgeoning damage.

dwarven_toughness.name: Dwarven Toughness
dwarven_toughness.desc_1: Dwarven Toughness is a passive feature that increases a creature's Hit Point maximum by 1, and again by 1 every time they gain a level. It is a Subrace Trait for all Gold Dwarf characters.
dwarven_toughness.desc_2: You have 1 extra maximum  Hit Point per level.

eagle_heart.name: Eagle Heart
eagle_heart.desc_1: Eagle Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
eagle_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, you can use  Diving Strike. Foes also have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use  Dash as a bonus action.

edge_of_terror.name: Edge of Terror
edge_of_terror.desc_1: Edge of Terror is a passive feature that applies  Bone Chilled to the target on every hit.
edge_of_terror.desc_2: Each strike fills the target with a chilling dread that prevents it from regaining hit points. Undead creatures also get  Disadvantage on Attack rolls.

effective_transmitter.name: Effective Transmitter
effective_transmitter.desc_1: Effective Transmitter is a passive feature that grants hit bonuses against constructs and enemies wearing metal armour.
effective_transmitter.desc_2: While imbued with  Lightning Charges, attacks against metal constructs and foes wearing metal armour gain  Advantage.

eight_legged_waltz.name: Eight Legged Waltz
eight_legged_waltz.desc_1: Eight Legged Waltz is a Beast Master Hunter's  Wolf Spider Companion passive feature that increases the speed of your Wolf Spider while on webs.
eight_legged_waltz.desc_2: Whenever you start your turn on a web surface, you now gain extra Movement Speed and become Resistant to ⁠Poison.

eldritch_spear.name: Eldritch Spear
eldritch_spear.desc_1: Eldritch Spear is a passive feature that gives users a range boost on their Eldritch Blast cantrip.
eldritch_spear.desc_2: The range of your  Eldritch Blast increases by half.

eldritch_strike.name: Eldritch Strike
eldritch_strike.desc_1: Eldritch Strike is an Eldritch Knight Fighter passive feature. This allows the Fighter to force a creature to have Disadvantage on its next Saving Throw by a mere weapon attack.
eldritch_strike.desc_2: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has  Disadvantage on its next  Saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

electric_blood.name: Electric Blood
electric_blood.desc_1: Electric Blood is a passive feature that that adds lightning charges when dealing damage.
electric_blood.desc_2: When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain 2  Lightning Charges.

electric_veins.name: Electric Veins
electric_veins.desc_1: Electric Veins is a passive feature that grants you a bonus when you deal damage with a spell or cantrip.
electric_veins.desc_2: When the wielder deals damage with a spell or cantrip, they gain 2  Lightning Charges.

electrify_water.name: Electrify Water
electrify_water.desc_1: Electrify Water is a passive feature that turns water surfaces into electrified water surfaces.
electrify_water.desc_2: When the wearer stands in  Water during combat, it becomes  Electrified Water.

electrocution_immunity.name: Electrocution Immunity
electrocution_immunity.desc_1: This passive protects its user from Electrocution.
electrocution_immunity.desc_2: Years of ambushing ships during lightning storms means that this creature cannot be  Electrocuted.

elegant_duellist.name: Elegant Duellist
elegant_duellist.desc_1: Elegant Duellist is a passive feature that increases your critical hit chance and reactivity.
elegant_duellist.desc_2: While your off-hand is empty, you score a Critical Hit when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional  Reaction per turn.

elemental_adept_acid.name: Elemental Adept: Acid
elemental_adept_acid.desc_1: Elemental Adept: Acid is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Acid. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
elemental_adept_acid.desc_2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental_adept_cold.name: Elemental Adept: Cold
elemental_adept_cold.desc_1: Elemental Adept: Cold is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Cold. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
elemental_adept_cold.desc_2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental_adept_fire.name: Elemental Adept: Fire
elemental_adept_fire.desc_1: Elemental Adept: Fire is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Fire. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
elemental_adept_fire.desc_2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental_adept_lightning.name: Elemental Adept: Lightning
elemental_adept_lightning.desc_1: Elemental Adept: Lightning is a passive feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Lightning. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
elemental_adept_lightning.desc_2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental_adept_thunder.name: Elemental Adept: Thunder
elemental_adept_thunder.desc_1: Elemental Adept: Thunder is a Passive Feature obtainable by the Elemental Adept Feat. Your spells ignore Resistance to ⁠Thunder. When you cast spells of that type, you cannot roll a 1.
elemental_adept_thunder.desc_2: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.

elemental_affinity_damage.name: Elemental Affinity: Damage
elemental_affinity_damage.desc_1: Elemental Affinity: Damage is a Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer passive feature that adds extra damage based on your Charisma Modifier to every spell you cast so long as it is the same type as your bloodline.
elemental_affinity_damage.desc_2: When you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you add your Charisma Modifier to the damage.

elemental_augmentation.name: Elemental Augmentation
elemental_augmentation.desc_1: Elemental Augmentation is a passive feature which adds damage to the caster's elemental cantrips.
elemental_augmentation.desc_2: When one of your cantrips deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt.

elemental_infusion.name: Elemental Infusion
elemental_infusion.desc_1: Elemental Infusion is a passive feature that adds elemental damage to the wearer's next weapon attack, after dealing elemental damage with a spell.
elemental_infusion.desc_2: When you deal ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage using a Spell or a Cantrip, that element infuses your weapon. Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional   1d4 damage of that element on your first successful weapon attack.

elemental_momentum.name: Elemental Momentum
elemental_momentum.desc_1: Elemental Momentum is a passive feature that temporarily increases the wearer's speed after casting an elemental spell.
elemental_momentum.desc_2: Whenever the wearer deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning or ⁠Thunder damage with Spells or Cantrip, they gain  Momentum for 2 turns.

elemental_resonance.name: Elemental Resonance
elemental_resonance.condition: Resistant to Acid Damage,Resistant to Fire Damage,Resistant to Lightning Damage,Resistant to Necrotic Damage,Resistant to Radiant Damage
elemental_resonance.desc_1: Elemental Resonance is a passive feature that grants you resistance to the same damage type you deal.
elemental_resonance.desc_2: If the wielder deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, ⁠Radiant, or ⁠Necrotic damage, it becomes resistant to that damage type for 2 turns.

elemental_retort.name: Elemental Retort
elemental_retort.desc_1: Elemental Retort is a special passive feature that grants a special reaction when attacked.
elemental_retort.desc_2: When attacked, the affected entity can draw on  Siphoned magic to cast  Elemental Retort.

elemental_siphon.name: Elemental Siphon
elemental_siphon.desc_1: Elemental Siphon is a passive feature lets you draw power from nearby myrmidons.
elemental_siphon.desc_2: The affected entity draws elemental power from any myrmidons within  Range: 30 m / 100 ft

elements_of_an_epoch.name: Elements of an Epoch
elements_of_an_epoch.desc_1: Elements of an Epoch is a passive feature that inflicts a condition based on the elemental damage done.
elements_of_an_epoch.desc_2: Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts:  Acid condition,  Chilled condition, or  Burning condition.

elk_heart.name: Elk Heart
elk_heart.desc_1: Elk Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
elk_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, you can use  Primal Stampede, and your movement speed increases by  4.5 m / 15 ft.

elven_agility.name: Elven Agility
elven_agility.desc_1: Elven Agility is a passive feature that enhances the user's speed and agility.
elven_agility.desc_2: The wearer has a +2 bonus to Initiative Rolls and  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving throws.

elven_chain.name: Elven Chain
elven_chain.desc_1: Elven Chain is a passive feature that lets anyone wear this armour.
elven_chain.desc_2: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

elven_weapon_training.name: Elven Weapon Training
elven_weapon_training.desc_1: Elven Weapon Training is a passive feature that grants Elves proficiency with the Longsword, Shortsword, Shortbow, and Longbow.
elven_weapon_training.desc_2: You have Proficiency with  Longswords,  Shortswords,  Longbows, and  Shortbows.

empowered_evocation.name: Empowered Evocation
empowered_evocation.desc_1: Empowered Evocation is an Evocation School Wizard passive feature which increases the damage of the caster's Evocation spells by their Intelligence modifier.
empowered_evocation.desc_2: Your grasp of Evocation magic has tightened, and you can add your Intelligence Modifier to damage rolls with any Evocation spells.

endurance_by_fire.name: Endurance by Fire
endurance_by_fire.desc_1: Endurance by Fire is a passive feature that provides resistance to fire and better protection against certain abilities.
endurance_by_fire.desc_2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage and a +2 bonus to  Saving throws.

enervating_suffusion.name: Enervating Suffusion
enervating_suffusion.desc_1: Enervating Suffusion is a passive feature that adds force damage to unarmed attacks.
enervating_suffusion.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Force damage.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.desc_1: Envenom is a passive feature that inflicts  Poisoned on targets whenever the wearer deals poison type damage.
envenom.desc_2: Whenever you deal ⁠Poison damage, the target needs to succeed a  Constitution saving throw or become  Poisoned.

escape_the_horde.name: Escape the Horde
escape_the_horde.desc_1: Escape the Horde is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that allow you to more safely escape the reach of an enemy.
escape_the_horde.desc_2: Opportunity Attacks against you have  Disadvantage.

ethel_s_twisted_blessing.name: Ethel's Twisted Blessing
ethel_s_twisted_blessing.desc_1: Ethel's Twisted Blessing is a passive feature available to Ethel's Redcap servants that gives them additional health, strength and constitution scores, and damage to their attacks.
ethel_s_twisted_blessing.desc_2: As one of Ethel's loyal servants, this redcap has an additional 40 hit points, their Strength and Constitution scores are increased +2, and their attacks deal an additional 1~12⁠Slashing damage.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.desc_1: Ethereal is a passive feature that marks this entity as a ghost.
ethereal.desc_2: Affected entity is incorporeal and can't be  Shoved,  Thrown, or used as an  Improvised Melee Weapon

ethereal_escape.name: Ethereal Escape
ethereal_escape.desc_1: Ethereal Escape is a Passive feature/Reaction that grants the creature the ability to automatically disappear when damaged. It is similar to the effect of  Blink, except this effect is guaranteed.
ethereal_escape.desc_2: When damaged, the Incubus escapes to the Ethereal Plane. He returns to the battlefield at the start of his next turn.

ethereal_form.name: Ethereal Form
ethereal_form.desc_1: Ethereal Form is a passive feature that reduces all incoming damage by 8.
ethereal_form.desc_2: All incoming damage is reduced by 8.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.desc_1: Evasion is a Monk and Rogue passive feature that lets them evade area of effect damage which require Dexterity Saving Throws[See Notes], reducing or entirely negating the damage.
evasion.desc_2: Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful  Dexterity saving throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

evasive_instinct.name: Evasive Instinct
evasive_instinct.desc_1: Evasive Instinct is a passive feature that increases your defenses so long as you're not wearing armor.
evasive_instinct.desc_2: You have a +1 bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving throws as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

ever_vigilant.name: Ever Vigilant
ever_vigilant.desc_1: Ever Vigilant is a passive feature that grants extra hit points when the user end's their rage intentionally.
ever_vigilant.desc_2: When the wearer chooses to  End their Rage, they gain  15 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

exceptional_plate.name: Exceptional Plate
exceptional_plate.desc_1: Exceptional Plate is a passive feature that reduces physical damage significantly.
exceptional_plate.desc_2: You take 2 less damage from ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing and ⁠Bludgeoning sources.

exceptional_training.name: Exceptional Training
exceptional_training.desc_1: Exceptional Training is a Beast Master Ranger passive feature that enhances your companion. They can now take several common actions as bonus actions.
exceptional_training.desc_2: Your summoned companions can now  Dash,  Disengage, and  Help as a  Bonus Action.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc_1: Executioner is a passive feature that lets the wearer critical hit the next target after getting a kill.
executioner.desc_2: When you kill a creature, your next Attack roll will be a Critical Hit. Once spent, this effect refreshes after a Long Rest.

exoskeletal_endurance.name: Exoskeletal Endurance
exoskeletal_endurance.desc_1: Exoskeletal Endurance is a passive feature that decreases the damage you take and retaliates against melee attacks.
exoskeletal_endurance.desc_2: Reduce all incoming damage by 2. When the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes Constitution modifier⁠Piercing damage.

exoskeletal_reinforcement.name: Exoskeletal Reinforcement
exoskeletal_reinforcement.desc_1: Exoskeletal Reinforcements is passive feature that grants the wearer the ability to pierce resistances to physical attacks.
exoskeletal_reinforcement.desc_2: Your attacks ignore Resistance to ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

exotic_material.name: Exotic Material
exotic_material.desc_1: Exotic Material is a passive feature that makes the armor more flexible, and prevents stealth penalties.
exotic_material.desc_2: Add your full Dexterity Modifier to your  Armour Class. Additionally, this armour does not impose  Disadvantage on Stealth Ability Checks.

experienced_and_deadly.name: Experienced And Deadly
experienced_and_deadly.desc_1: Experienced And Deadly is a passive feature that boosts the wielder's unarmed strikes by using their wisdom.
experienced_and_deadly.desc_2: The wearer deals additional damage equal to their  Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

experimental_alchemy.name: Experimental Alchemy
experimental_alchemy.desc_1: Experimental Alchemy is a Transmutation School Wizard passive feature that enhances your mastery over alchemy. Whenever you combine extracts, you can brew two solutions instead of one provided you succeed a Medicine check.
experimental_alchemy.desc_2: You brew two Alchemical Solutions instead of one when combining extracts, if you succeed a Difficulty Class 15 Medicine Check.

expert_divination.name: Expert Divination
expert_divination.desc_1: Expert Divination is a Divination School Wizard passive feature which grants an additional Portent Die and allows its user to fulfill prophecies to restore any spent Portent Dice each short rest. These prophecies typically entail casting a spell from a specific school or dealing a specific type of damage.
expert_divination.desc_2: You gain an additional Portent Die. When taking a Short Rest you receive a set of Prophecies. Complete them to regain missing Portent Dice.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.desc_1: Expertise is a passive feature that allows a character to double their Proficiency bonus on a Skill.
expertise.desc_2: Choose a Skill you are Proficient in. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any Ability Check you make in that Skill.

exploit_weakness.name: Exploit Weakness
exploit_weakness.desc_1: Exploit Weakness is a passive feature that makes targets vulnerable to being pierced.
exploit_weakness.desc_2: Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to ⁠Piercing damage.

exquisite_focus.name: Exquisite Focus
exquisite_focus.desc_1: Exquisite Focus is a passive feature that increases your AC as a precaution
exquisite_focus.desc_2: While concentrating, you add your Spellcasting Modifier to your  Saving throws and gain a +1 bonus to your  Armour Class.

external_digestion.name: External Digestion
external_digestion.desc_1: External Digestion is a passive feature that allows its user to Devour certain enemies.
external_digestion.desc_2: Can  Devour any creature that is  Restrained and steeping in its  Digestive Juices.

extinguishing_malice.name: Extinguishing Malice
extinguishing_malice.desc_1: Extinguishing Malice is a passive feature that plunges the surrounding area into darkness.
extinguishing_malice.desc_2: Nearby lights are extinguished in the presence of this creature's roiling darkness.

extra_attack.name: Extra Attack
extra_attack.desc_1: Extra Attack is a passive feature that allows you to make an additional attack when making an Attack Action.
extra_attack.desc_2: You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.

eyes_of_the_dark.name: Eyes of the Dark
eyes_of_the_dark.desc_1: Eyes of the Dark is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 24 m / 80 ft, double the distance of normal  Darkvision.
eyes_of_the_dark.desc_2: You can see in the dark up to 24 m / 80 ft.

faceless_masquerade.name: Faceless Masquerade
faceless_masquerade.desc_1: Faceless Masquerade is a passive feature that enhances the user's deception and persuasion ability.
faceless_masquerade.desc_2: You have  Advantage on  Deception Checks and  Persuasion Checks.

failsafe_protocol.name: Failsafe Protocol
failsafe_protocol.desc_1: Failsafe Protocol is a passive feature which grants a creature the ability to self-destruct in an explosion.
failsafe_protocol.desc_2: After losing a significant amount of Hit Points, this creature will begin a  Self-Detonation Protocol to eliminate all nearby threats. If it dies, it instantly  detonates.

faithwarden_s_stride.name: Faithwarden's Stride
faithwarden_s_stride.desc_1: Faithwarden's Stride is a passive feature that allows the wielder to move through vines unopposed.
faithwarden_s_stride.desc_2: Druidic vines cannot  Ensnare you and do not count as  difficult terrain.

fancy_footwork.name: Fancy Footwork
fancy_footwork.desc_1: Fancy Footwork is a passive feature available to Swashbuckler rogues which prevents the targets of their melee attacks from taking opportunity attacks against them.
fancy_footwork.desc_2: If you make a melee attack against a target, that target can't make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

fast_hands.name: Fast Hands
fast_hands.desc_1: Fast Hands is a Thief Rogue passive feature that grants an extra Bonus Action
fast_hands.desc_2: You gain an extra  Bonus Action, which you can use with any of your existing Bonus Actions.

fast_movement.name: Fast Movement
fast_movement.desc_1: Fast Movement is a Barbarian passive feature that increases your Movement Speed by 3m / 10ft while not wearing Heavy Armour.
fast_movement.desc_2: Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m / 10 ft while not wearing Heavy Armour.

favourable_beginnings.name: Favourable Beginnings
favourable_beginnings.desc_1: Favourable Beginnings is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature applies a character's Proficiency Bonus to the first Attack Roll or Ability Check made against a target.
favourable_beginnings.desc_2: The first Attack roll or  Ability check you make against any target gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

favoured_weapon.name: Favoured Weapon
favoured_weapon.desc_1: Favoured Weapon is a passive feature that boosts the wielder's chance to hit and damage.
favoured_weapon.desc_2: This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and Attack rolls.

fear_of_wolves.name: Fear of Wolves
fear_of_wolves.desc_1: Fear of Wolves is one of Shadowheart's passive features. When approaching a lupine creature, she may become Frightened.
fear_of_wolves.desc_2: Shadowheart's scalp prickles with fear when she encounters wolves. If she steps within 9 m / 30 ft of a lupine creature, she must make a DC 15 Wisdom  Saving throw or become  Frightened.

feline_fall.name: Feline Fall
feline_fall.desc_1: Feline Fall is a passive feature in Baldur's Gate 3 that grants a creature the ability to resist falling damage.
feline_fall.desc_2: Due to their natural feline grace, cats are Resistant to Falling damage.

feller_of_monsters.name: Feller of Monsters
feller_of_monsters.desc_1: Feller of Monsters is a passive feature that improves hit chance against Monstrosities.
feller_of_monsters.desc_2: You have  Advantage against Monstrosity type enemies.

feral_instinct.name: Feral Instinct
feral_instinct.desc_1: Feral Instinct is a Barbarian passive feature. The barbarian is always ready for battle and can't be caught off-guard.
feral_instinct.desc_2: You have honed your instincts to the utmost degree. You gain a +3 to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

fervent_flames.name: Fervent Flames
fervent_flames.desc_1: Fervent Flames is a passive feature that heats up the wearer whenever you take fire damage.
fervent_flames.desc_2: Whenever you take ⁠Fire damage dealt by another creature, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

fey_ancestry.name: Fey Ancestry
fey_ancestry.desc_1: Fey Ancestry is a passive feature that grants immunity to  Sleep effects and Advantage against  Charm effects.
fey_ancestry.desc_2: The Feywild casts a veil over your mind. You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Charmed, and magic can't put you to  Sleep.

fey_life.name: Fey Life
fey_life.desc_1: Fey Life is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to survive unconsciousness.
fey_life.desc_2: Makes it easier for the wearer to succeed on death saving throws.

feywild_sparks.name: Feywild Sparks
feywild_sparks.desc_1: Feywild Sparks is a passive feature that always triggers a wild magic surge if Tides of Chaos is active.
feywild_sparks.desc_2: While your sorcerous  Tides of Chaos feature is active, you will always trigger  Wild Magic when casting spells.

fiendish_blessing.name: Fiendish Blessing
fiendish_blessing.desc_1: Fiendish Blessing is a Cambion passive feature that grants them an increase to their Armour Class.
fiendish_blessing.desc_2: Protected by the blood of their fiendish ancestors, cambions have a +2 bonus to their Armour Class.

fiendish_fire.name: Fiendish Fire
fiendish_fire.desc_1: Fiendish Fire is a passive feature that can reveal enemies and make them easier to hit.
fiendish_fire.desc_2: Once per turn, a creature hit by this weapon will possibly be afflicted with  Faerie Fire.

fiendish_vigour.name: Fiendish Vigour
fiendish_vigour.desc_1: Fiendish Vigour is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the wearer protect themselves with extra Temporary Hit Points.
fiendish_vigour.desc_2: You can cast  False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a Spell Slot. False Life grants you  7 temporary hit points.

fiery_return.name: Fiery Return
fiery_return.desc_1: Fiery Return is a passive feature that grants extra bonus actions when you deal fire damage with a leveled spell.
fiery_return.desc_2: When you deal ⁠Fire damage with a levelled spell, you  Burn yourself and gain an additional  Bonus Action this round.

fire_acuity.name: Fire Acuity
fire_acuity.desc_1: Fire Acuity is a passive feature that increases your spell power after dealing fire damage.
fire_acuity.desc_2: Whenever you deal ⁠Fire damage, you gain  Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

first_blood.name: First Blood
first_blood.desc_1: First Blood is a passive feature that causes targets to bleed.
first_blood.desc_2: On a hit, inflict  Bleeding upon targets that have maximum Hit Points.

fishfolk_faithful.name: Fishfolk Faithful
fishfolk_faithful.desc_1: Fishfolk Faithful is a passive feature obtainable by the  Invigorating Fanaticism condition.
fishfolk_faithful.desc_2: Chance to apply Bleeding to targets.

fit_to_burst.name: Fit to Burst
fit_to_burst.desc_1: Fit to Burst is a Passive Feature available only to Intellect Gluttons. It uses this ability to explode when it dies.
fit_to_burst.desc_2: When the intellect glutton dies, it bursts in a  Morphic Brine Explosion.

flames_of_avernus.name: Flames of Avernus
flames_of_avernus.desc_1: Flames of Avernus is a passive feature that makes their targets vulnerable to Fire damage.
flames_of_avernus.desc_2: This merregon's attacks make a target  Flame-Feeble.

flaming_revenge.name: Flaming Revenge
flaming_revenge.desc_1: Flaming Revenge is a passive feature that raises combat abilities.
flaming_revenge.desc_2: On a successful  Saving throw against a foe's spell, deal 1d4 + proficiency bonus⁠Fire damage to them.

flaming_shroud.name: Flaming Shroud
flaming_shroud.desc_1: Flaming Shroud is a passive feature that burns enemies that damage the wearer.
flaming_shroud.desc_2: A creature that damages the wearer within  2 m / 7 ft receives  Burning.

flurry_of_moths.name: Flurry of Moths
flurry_of_moths.actions: Flurry of Moths: Attack, Flurry of Moths: Blinding Swarm, Flurry of Moths: Teleport
flurry_of_moths.desc_1: Flurry of Moths is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers. It turns the Gathered Swarm into moths that deal ⁠Psychic damage and can blind enemies. This feature can be switched out at level up.
flurry_of_moths.desc_2: You gain a swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional ⁠Psychic damage,  Blind your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location. At higher levels At level 11,  Mighty Swarm upgrades the swarm options to:

fly_trap.name: Fly Trap
fly_trap.desc_1: Fly Trap is a passive feature that attempts to prevent a target from moving.
fly_trap.desc_2: Chance to  Ensnare target if it is not a plant or a beast.

flying_strike.name: Flying Strike
flying_strike.desc_1: Flying Strike is a passive feature that enhances the user's damage when they fly, if they are a githyanki.
flying_strike.desc_2: When a githyanki casts  Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

focused_conjuration.name: Focused Conjuration
focused_conjuration.desc_1: Focused Conjuration is a Conjuration School Wizard passive feature prevents you from losing concentration on Conjuration spells.
focused_conjuration.desc_2: Damage taken while you are Concentrating on a Conjuration spell will not break your  Concentration. Conjuration Wizard Spells that require Concentrating:

focused_stride.name: Focused Stride
focused_stride.desc_1: Focused Stride is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being moved against their will, or being knocked prone.
focused_stride.desc_2: When you cast a spell that requires  Concentration, you gain  Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked  Prone or moved against your will.

fond_caress.name: Fond Caress
fond_caress.desc_1: Fond Caress is a passive feature allowing the ring wearer to receive a defensive bonus.
fond_caress.desc_2: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to receive  Warding Bond from a creature wearing the  matching ring.

font_of_inspiration.name: Font of Inspiration
font_of_inspiration.desc_1: Font of Inspiration is a Bard passive feature that causes you to regain all of your  Bardic Inspiration Charges after a Long or Short Rest.
font_of_inspiration.desc_2: You regain all of your  Bardic Inspirations after a Long or Short Rest.

forbidden_knowledge.name: Forbidden Knowledge
forbidden_knowledge.skills: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival
forbidden_knowledge.desc_1: Forbidden Knowledge is a permanent passive feature granted by the Necromancy of Thay that increases a character's Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability checks by +1.
forbidden_knowledge.desc_2: From partially deciphering the  Necromancy of Thay, you gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_strength.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Strength)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_strength.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_strength.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Strength.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_dexterity.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Dexterity)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_dexterity.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_dexterity.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Dexterity.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_constitutionh.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Constitutionh)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_constitutionh.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_constitutionh.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Constitution.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_intelligence.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Intelligence)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_intelligence.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_intelligence.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Intelligence.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_wisdom.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Wisdom)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_wisdom.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_wisdom.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Wisdom.

auntie_ethel_s_boon_charisma.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Charisma)
auntie_ethel_s_boon_charisma.desc_1: Auntie Ethel's Hair is a common item that can be used to permanently increase a character's Ability Score by 1. The player character must choose which ability score the hair will increase when receiving it.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_charisma.desc_2: Eating Ethel's airy scalp has granted you a permanent boost to Charisma.

force_absorption.name: Force Absorption
force_absorption.desc_1: Force Absorption is a passive feature that increases your defenses as you get hit.
force_absorption.desc_2: Gain 2 turns of  Force Conduit when taking ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, or ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

forest_i.name: Forest I
forest_i.desc_1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
forest_i.desc_2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

forest_ii.name: Forest II
forest_ii.desc_1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
forest_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

forest_iii.name: Forest III
forest_iii.desc_1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
forest_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

forest_iv.name: Forest IV
forest_iv.desc_1: Forest is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
forest_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Barkskin and  Hold Person. At higher levels You can cast  Call Lightning and  Plant Growth. You can cast  Conjure Minor Elemental and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Mass Cure Wounds and  Contagion.

forest_aegis.name: Forest Aegis
forest_aegis.desc_1: Forest Aegis is a passive feature that grants the user  Barkskin, setting their AC to 16. It’s not active while in  Wild Shape.
forest_aegis.desc_2: You are invested with the power of the meadows and woods of the land, and have the effect of  Barkskin, increasing your  Armour Class to 16.

forever_indebted.name: Forever Indebted
forever_indebted.desc_1: Forever Indebted is a passive feature available to various debtors in the House of Hope. When damaged the user detonates, creating a big explosion and summoning a random fiendish creature.
forever_indebted.desc_2: A debt to Raphael must be paid - even in death. Upon dying, the debtor explodes in damaging flames and is reincarnated as a fiendish creature bound to Raphael.

formless_slaughter.name: Formless Slaughter
formless_slaughter.desc_1: Formless Slaughter is a passive feature that enhances the user's combat while the user is transformed.
formless_slaughter.desc_2: You gain a +1 to Attack and Damage rolls while shapeshifting or disguised.

frantic_urgency.name: Frantic Urgency
frantic_urgency.desc_1: Frantic Urgency is a passive feature that grants increased movement when severely injured.
frantic_urgency.desc_2: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain  Momentum for 1 turn.

freecast.name: Freecast
freecast.desc_1: Freecast is a toggleable passive feature and a power available to Partial-Illithids. It allows them to bypass the normal expenditure of spell slots, charges or other similar resource costs for their next chosen  Action, once per Long Rest.
freecast.desc_2: You have discovered a marvellous adaptability within yourself. Spell slots, charges, and similar resource costs for your next action or spell are removed. Refreshes after a Long Rest.

frightened_immunity.name: Frightened Immunity
frightened_immunity.desc_1: Frightened Immunity is a passive feature that keeps the wearer brave.

fungal_resistance.name: Fungal Resistance
fungal_resistance.desc_1: Fungal Resistance is a passive feature affecting Pearlspore Bell. It provides a passive buff to Auntie Ethel when alive.
fungal_resistance.desc_2: A Pearlspore Bell grants the hag +5 bonus to all Saving Throws.

fury_in_the_marrow.name: Fury In The Marrow
fury_in_the_marrow.desc_1: Fury In The Marrow is a passive feature that damages enemies when you rage.
fury_in_the_marrow.desc_2: When you  Rage, hostile creatures in a  3 m / 10 ft radius must succeed a Weapon action DC  Wisdom saving throw or take 2d4⁠Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save.

fury_of_the_small.name: Fury of the Small
fury_of_the_small.desc_1: Fury of the Small is a racial ability of Goblins. This ability allows a goblin to deal extra damage against an enemy larger than the goblin once per combat.
fury_of_the_small.desc_2: When you damage a creature larger than you, you can choose to deal 1d6⁠Physical extra. Limited to once per combat.

galvanic_currents.name: Galvanic Currents
galvanic_currents.desc_1: Galvanic Currents is a passive feature that adds lightning damage to each attack.
galvanic_currents.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Lightning damage.

genial_strider.name: Genial Strider
genial_strider.desc_1: Genial Strider is a passive feature that makes difficult terrain easy to traverse.
genial_strider.desc_2: The wearer's Movement Speed is unimpeded by  Difficult Terrain.

giantslayer.name: Giantslayer
giantslayer.desc_1: Giantslayer is a passive feature that does extra damage and has greater accuracy against oversized creatures.
giantslayer.desc_2: On a hit, double the damage from your Strength modifier. This weapon grants you  Advantage on Attack rolls against Large, Huge or Gargantuan creatures.

githborn_psionic_resistance.name: Githborn Psionic Resistance
githborn_psionic_resistance.desc_1: Githborn Psionic Resistance is a passive feature available to githyanki that grants protection against mind based spells.
githborn_psionic_resistance.desc_2: A githyanki holding this weapon has  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed.

githborn_psionic_weapon.name: Githborn Psionic Weapon
githborn_psionic_weapon.desc_1: Githborn Psionic Weapon is a passive feature granted by certain Githyanki weapons when wielded by a githyanki.
githborn_psionic_weapon.desc_2: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

githborn_psionic_weapon_1d6.name: Githborn Psionic Weapon (1d6)
githborn_psionic_weapon_1d6.desc_1: Githborn Psionic Weapon is a passive feature granted by certain Githyanki weapons when wielded by a githyanki.
githborn_psionic_weapon_1d6.desc_2: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Psychic damage.

githyanki_parry.name: Githyanki Parry
githyanki_parry.desc_1: Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 10.
githyanki_parry.desc_2: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 10. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated, Blinded[See Notes], or Restrained.

githyanki_war_magic.name: Githyanki War Magic
githyanki_war_magic.desc_1: Githyanki War Magic is a passive feature that allows a githyanki to make a follow up weapon attack after casting a spell or cantrip.
githyanki_war_magic.desc_2: After the githyanki casts a spell or cantrip, they can make a weapon attack using a  Bonus Action.

gleamdance_dagger_glowing.name: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing
gleamdance_dagger_glowing.desc_1: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that sheds light.
gleamdance_dagger_glowing.desc_2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

gleamdancer.name: Gleamdancer
gleamdancer.desc_1: Gleamdancer is a passive feature that increases your armour while wielded in the off-hand.
gleamdancer.desc_2: When this dagger is wielded in the off-hand, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to  Armour Class.

gloom_step.name: Gloom Step
gloom_step.desc_1: Gloom Step is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed in darkness.
gloom_step.desc_2: Movement is increased by 3 m / 10 ft when starting a turn in darkness.

glorious_pointy_hat.name: Glorious Pointy Hat
glorious_pointy_hat.desc_1: Glorious Pointy Hat is a passive feature that improves the wearer's persuasion using their intelligence.
glorious_pointy_hat.desc_2: You gain a bonus to your  Persuasion checks equal to your  Intelligence Modifier.

gnome_cunning.name: Gnome Cunning
gnome_cunning.desc_1: Gnome Cunning is a passive feature that grants  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws. It is available to all Gnome characters.
gnome_cunning.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

goblin_s_undoing.name: Goblin's Undoing
goblin_s_undoing.desc_1: Goblin's Undoing is a passive feature that makes it difficult for goblin's to attack the user.
goblin_s_undoing.desc_2: Goblins have  Disadvantage on Attack rolls against the wielder.

godswill.name: Godswill
godswill.desc_1: Godswill is a passive feature that boots the user's ability to channel their god's power.
godswill.desc_2: You gain an additional use of  Channel Divinity Charge. Once used, it is restored upon taking a Long Rest[See: Bugs].

gold_plating.name: Gold Plating
gold_plating.desc_1: Gold Plating is a passive feature that grants increased Constitution, Armour Class, and Hit Points
gold_plating.desc_2: This creature has been blessed by Mammon, giving them a second skin of gold that increases their Constitution to 20 and their base  Armour Class to 15, and grants an additional 66 hit points⁠hit points.

gontr_mael_glowing.name: Gontr Mael: Glowing
gontr_mael_glowing.desc_1: Gontr Mael: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature granted by  Gontr Mael. It causes the bow to emit a light around the equipped weapon.
gontr_mael_glowing.desc_2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

grasp_of_the_forest.name: Grasp of the Forest
grasp_of_the_forest.desc_1: Grasp of the Forest is a passive feature that makes weapon attacks Entangle the target on hit.
grasp_of_the_forest.desc_2: Weapon attacks can  Entangle the target.

grassland_i.name: Grassland I
grassland_i.desc_1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
grassland_i.desc_2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

grassland_ii.name: Grassland II
grassland_ii.desc_1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
grassland_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

grassland_iii.name: Grassland III
grassland_iii.desc_1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
grassland_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

grassland_iv.name: Grassland IV
grassland_iv.desc_1: Grassland is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
grassland_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Invisibility and  Pass Without Trace. At higher levels You can cast  Daylight and  Haste. You can cast  Freedom of Movement and  Polymorph. You can cast  Greater Restoration and  Insect Plague.

grave_magic.name: Grave Magic
grave_magic.desc_1: Grave Magic is a passive feature available to Cult of the Absolute Necromancers. It gives them an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage to their spell attacks.
grave_magic.desc_2: Whenever you deal damage with a spell, deal an additional 1d8⁠Necrotic damage.

great_weapon_fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
great_weapon_fighting.desc_1: Great Weapon Fighting is a Fighting Style passive feature.
great_weapon_fighting.desc_2: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.

great_weapon_master_all_in.name: Great Weapon Master: All In
great_weapon_master_all_in.desc_1: Great Weapon Master: All In is a toggleable passive feature provided by the Great Weapon Master Feat that allows Two-Handed or Versatile weapon users to deal extra damage at the cost of reduced accuracy.
great_weapon_master_all_in.desc_2: When attacking with a melee weapon you are Proficient with and are wielding in both hands, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.

great_weapon_master_bonus_attack.name: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
great_weapon_master_bonus_attack.desc_1: Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack is a passive feature obtainable by the Great Weapon Master Feat. If you kill a target or land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make another melee weapon attack.
great_weapon_master_bonus_attack.desc_2: When you land a Critical Hit or kill a target with a melee weapon attack, you can make another melee weapon attack as a  Bonus Action that turn.

great_wyrm_s_scales.name: Great Wyrm's Scales
great_wyrm_s_scales.desc_1: Great Wyrm's Scales is a passive feature that grants a creature damage reduction against all incoming attacks
great_wyrm_s_scales.desc_2: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

greater_kushigo_counter.name: Greater Kushigo Counter
greater_kushigo_counter.desc_1: Greater Kushigo Counter is a passive feature that lets users retaliate against melee attacks that miss.
greater_kushigo_counter.desc_2: The wearer can use a  Reaction to make an  Unarmed Strike against any attacker that misses.

greater_wyrm_s_scales.name: Greater Wyrm's Scales
greater_wyrm_s_scales.desc_1: Greater Wyrm's Scales is a passive feature that grants a creature damage reduction against all incoming attacks
greater_wyrm_s_scales.desc_2: All incoming damage is reduced by 4.

green_bed_regeneration.name: Green Bed Regeneration
green_bed_regeneration.desc_1: Green Bed Regeneration is a passive feature that heals the wearer while surrounded by plants.
green_bed_regeneration.desc_2: When starting your turn on  Plant Growth or  Vines regain 1d4⁠hit points hit points.

gregarious_caster.name: Gregarious Caster
gregarious_caster.desc_1: Gregarious Caster is a passive feature that increases your cantrip damage significantly.
gregarious_caster.desc_2: Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

grievous_retribution.name: Grievous Retribution
grievous_retribution.desc_1: Grievous Retribution is a passive feature that penalizes enemies that strike you.
grievous_retribution.desc_2: When an enemy damages the wearer, the wearer gains  Wrath for 2 turns.

grim_harvest.name: Grim Harvest
grim_harvest.desc_1: Grim Harvest is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature. It allows the caster to regain hit points every time they kill a creature with a spell. The amount regained is based on the spell slot level used, and is increased if a Necromancy spell is used.
grim_harvest.desc_2: Once per turn, if you kill a creature with a spell, you regain Hit Points equal to twice the Spell Slot level used - thrice if it's a Necromancy spell. Undead and Constructs are unaffected.

grim_irony.name: Grim Irony
grim_irony.desc_1: Grim Irony is a passive feature that can incapacitate both the target and user in fits of laughter.
grim_irony.desc_2: Whenever this weapon lands a critical hit, both target and attacker must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw, or be affected by  fits of laughter.

grit.name: Grit
grit.desc_1: Grit is a passive feature that boosts the wearer's actions if they are severely injured.
grit.desc_2: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have an additional  Bonus Action.

guardian_of_faith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardian_of_faith.desc_1: Guardian of Faith is a passive feature used by the summons of the same name. It allows them to automatically attack enemies entering their range with  Strike of the Guardian. This is the inverse of how Opportunity Attacks normally work.
guardian_of_faith.desc_2: When an enemy enters your attack range, you can strike them.

halfling_luck.name: Halfling Luck
halfling_luck.desc_1: Halfling Luck is a passive feature in Baldur's Gate 3 which allows all halflings to reroll any (d20) dice once when it lands on a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.
halfling_luck.desc_2: When you roll a 1 for an Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw, you can reroll the dice and must use the new roll.

haroldish_doom.name: Haroldish Doom
haroldish_doom.desc_1: Haroldish Doom is a passive feature that diminishes a target's combat prowess whenever you deal damage to the target.
haroldish_doom.desc_2: When dealing damage to a target with a ranged weapon, the target must succeed a Charisma  Saving throw or be  Baned for 2 turns.

harrowing_presence.name: Harrowing Presence
harrowing_presence.desc_1: Harrowing Presence is a passive feature that breaks the spirit of nearby creatures.

heart_ablaze.name: Heart Ablaze
heart_ablaze.desc_1: Heart Ablaze grants Karlach Immunity to  Charmed effects.
heart_ablaze.desc_2: Infernal iron has anchored the war machine that is Karlach's heart. She can touch others without burning them, and can no longer be  Charmed.

heart_of_ice.name: Heart of Ice
heart_of_ice.desc_1: Heart of Ice is a passive feature that lets the wielder deal extra cold damage when dealing cold damage.
heart_of_ice.desc_2: When dealing ⁠Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1⁠Cold. A Frostbitten creature that takes Cold damage will take an additional 1 Cold damage per turn of Frostbite remaining.

heart_of_iron.name: Heart of Iron
heart_of_iron.desc_1: Heart of Iron grants Karlach  Advantage on Saving Throws against  Charmed effects.
heart_of_iron.desc_2: The infernal engine that is Karlach's heart is burning more evenly. She has  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Charmed.

heart_of_the_storm.name: Heart of the Storm
heart_of_the_storm.actions: Heart of the Storm: Lightning, Heart of the Storm: Thunder
heart_of_the_storm.desc_1: Heart of the Storm is a set of two Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive features that create a storm that deals half your Sorcerer level, rounded down, when you cast a lightning or thunder spell.
heart_of_the_storm.desc_2: When you cast a Spell of Level 1 or higher that deals Lightning or Thunder damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within  6 m / 20 ft take (Sorcerer Level / 2)⁠Lightning or (Sorcerer Level / 2)⁠Thunder.

heart_of_the_storm_resistance.name: Heart of the Storm: Resistance
heart_of_the_storm_resistance.desc_1: Heart of the Storm: Resistance is a Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive that gives you resistance to both Lightning and Thunder damage.
heart_of_the_storm_resistance.desc_2: You are Resistant to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Thunder damage

heat_convergence.name: Heat Convergence
heat_convergence.desc_1: Heat Convergence is a toggleable passive feature available to entities with the  Heat condition. It allows them to consume all turns of  Heat to deal extra Fire damage on their next spell or attack.
heat_convergence.desc_2: Consume your  Heat to fuel a powerful attack. The next time you deal Fire damage, you deal an additional 1⁠Fire damage for every turn of  Heat remaining.

heavily_armoured.name: Heavily Armoured
heavily_armoured.desc_1: Heavily Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armour and your Strength increases by 1.
heavily_armoured.desc_2: You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armour and your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You must have Medium Armour Proficiency before you can take this feat.

heavy_armour_master.name: Heavy Armour Master
heavy_armour_master.desc_1: Heavy Armour Master is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. Your mastery over heavy armour increases, granting you damage reduction of incoming non-magical damage by 3.
heavy_armour_master.desc_2: Your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour. Requires Proficiency with Heavy Armour

heavy_hitter.name: Heavy Hitter
heavy_hitter.desc_1: Heavy Hitter is a passive feature that sends opponents reeling on every hit.
heavy_hitter.desc_2: Your weapon hits hard enough to send your target  Reeling for 2 turns.

heightened_awareness.name: Heightened Awareness
heightened_awareness.desc_1: Heightened Awareness is a passive feature that increases the user's initiative and perception of their surroundings.
heightened_awareness.desc_2: Gain a +3 bonus to Initiative rolls and  Advantage on  Perception checks.

heightened_manoeuvre.name: Heightened Manoeuvre
heightened_manoeuvre.desc_1: Heightened Manoeuvre is a passive feature that gives enemies disadvantage against battle master manoeuvre saves.
heightened_manoeuvre.desc_2: Targets have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions.

heightened_necromancy.name: Heightened Necromancy
heightened_necromancy.desc_1: Heightened Necromancy is a passive feature that causes creatures to be more likely to fail against your necromancy spells.
heightened_necromancy.desc_2: Creatures have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your necromancy spells.

helldusk_armour.name: Helldusk Armour
helldusk_armour.desc_1: Helldusk Armour is a passive feature that enables this piece of equipment to be worn by everybody
helldusk_armour.desc_2: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.desc_1: Hellish Rebuke is a passive feature that allows using a reaction to retaliate against an enemy that damaged the user.
hellish_rebuke.desc_2: React to your next attacker with flames that deal 2d10⁠Fire. At higher levels Upcast: Deals an additional 1d10⁠Fire damage per level.

hellish_resistance.name: Hellish Resistance
hellish_resistance.desc_1: Hellish Resistance is a passive feature that grants Tieflings Resistance to ⁠Fire damage from magical and non-magical sources.
hellish_resistance.desc_2: Your blood protects you from flame, abyssal or otherwise. Gain Resistance to ⁠Fire damage, taking only half damage from it.

hellstalker.name: Hellstalker
hellstalker.desc_1: Hellstalker is a passive feature that can set your targets on fire if you are hiding.
hellstalker.desc_2: Possibly inflict  Burning when attacking while  Hiding or  Invisible.

helm_s_protection.name: Helm's Protection
helm_s_protection.desc_1: Helm's Protection is a passive feature that protects the user's targets after healing them.
helm_s_protection.desc_2: When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks for 2 turns.

hex_warrior.name: Hex Warrior
hex_warrior.weapon_proficiency: Flails, Morningstars, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, War Picks, Battleaxes, Longswords, Tridents, Warhammers, Glaives, Greataxes, Greatswords, Halberds, Mauls, Pikes, Hand Crossbows, Heavy Crossbows, Longbows
hex_warrior.desc_1: Hex Warrior is a passive feature granted to The Hexblade warlocks at level 1.
hex_warrior.desc_2: You gain proficiency with  Medium armour,  Shields, and  Martial weapons. You gain  Bind Hexed Weapon, which lets you use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity when attacking with weapons that you are proficient with.

high_spellcasting_infernal_rapier.name: High Spellcasting (Infernal Rapier)
high_spellcasting_infernal_rapier.desc_1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
high_spellcasting_infernal_rapier.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

high_spellcasting_1.name: High Spellcasting (+1)
high_spellcasting_1.desc_1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
high_spellcasting_1.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

high_spellcasting_2.name: High Spellcasting (+2)
high_spellcasting_2.desc_1: High Spellcasting is a passive feature that makes the wearers spells more potent and difficult to defend against.
high_spellcasting_2.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC.

hoarfrost_balance.name: Hoarfrost Balance
hoarfrost_balance.desc_1: Hoarfrost Balance is a passive feature that prevents the user from slipping on ice.
hoarfrost_balance.desc_2: You cannot fall  Prone while traversing  Icy terrain.

homing_weapon.name: Homing Weapon
homing_weapon.desc_1: Homing Weapon is a passive feature that sends the weapon back to its owner after being thrown.
homing_weapon.desc_2: This weapon will return to its owner when thrown.

horde_breaker.name: Horde Breaker
horde_breaker.desc_1: Horde Breaker is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that grants you the ability to target two creatures next to each other.
horde_breaker.desc_2: Target two creatures standing close to each other, attacking them in quick succession.

human_versatility.name: Human Versatility
human_versatility.desc_1: Human Versatility is a passive feature that grants Humans Proficiency in a skill of their choice and Carrying Capacity is increased by a quarter.
human_versatility.desc_2: Select an additional Skill to be Proficient in. Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

hunter_s_camouflage.name: Hunter's Camouflage
hunter_s_camouflage.desc_1: This passive increases the user's defense after they receive damage, at the expense of their reaction.
hunter_s_camouflage.desc_2: After receiving damage, the creature immediately uses their reaction to  Blur

hunter_s_eye.name: Hunter's Eye
hunter_s_eye.desc_1: Hunter's Eye is a passive feature that increases the damage against creatures marked by certain spells.
hunter_s_eye.desc_2: You gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls against creatures marked by Hunter's Mark,  True Strike,  Faerie Fire, or  Guiding Bolt.

ichorous_corrosion.name: Ichorous Corrosion
ichorous_corrosion.desc_1: Ichorous Corrosion is a passive feature that applies noxious fumes on the user's targets when the user deals acid damage to them.
ichorous_corrosion.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Acid damage, they also inflict  Noxious Fumes on the target(s).

illithid_euphoria.name: Illithid Euphoria
illithid_euphoria.desc_1: Illithid Euphoria is a passive feature that grants the user improved combat abilities after charming or frightening a creature.
illithid_euphoria.desc_2: Charm or Frighten a creature to gain a 1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws.

illithid_expertise.name: Illithid Expertise
illithid_expertise.desc_1: Illithid Expertise is a passive feature and Illithid Power available to Partial-Illithids. This feature gives a character Expertise in Persuasion, Deception and Intimidation Checks.
illithid_expertise.desc_2: You have deepened your sense of self, gaining Expertise in Persuasion, Deception, and Intimidation Checks.

illithid_persuasion.name: Illithid Persuasion
illithid_persuasion.desc_1: Illithid Persuasion is a unique illithid power which allows Origin characters, as well as  Minthara and  Minsc, to impose their will onto others with the Brand of the Absolute through conversation. This ability is unlocked automatically.
illithid_persuasion.desc_2: Impose your authority onto those with the Brand of the Absolute. Properties During certain conversations just before dialog choices come up, the Narrator states As the symbol glows

illithid_protection.name: Illithid Protection
illithid_protection.desc_1: Illithid Protection is a passive feature that provides a bit of mind protection but only if infested by a tadpole.
illithid_protection.desc_2: If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, they gain +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

illusion_quickening.name: Illusion Quickening
illusion_quickening.desc_1: Illusion Quickening is a passive feature that lets the wearer cast illusion or enchantment spells after making a weapon attack.
illusion_quickening.desc_2: After hitting a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast illusion or enchantment spells as a  Bonus Action.

immune_to_control_undead.name: Immune to Control Undead
immune_to_control_undead.desc_1: Immune To Control Undead is a passive feature that prevents this Undead creature from being magically controlled by others. Most noticeable example is the Control Undead oath paladins might have.
immune_to_control_undead.desc_2: This creature is so powerful, it simply cannot be controlled by the magical whim of others.

immutable_existence.name: Immutable Existence
immutable_existence.desc_1: Immutable Existence makes the user immune to effects like Polymorphed. Furthermore, the user cannot be removed from this plane of existence.
immutable_existence.desc_2: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it cannot be removed from this plane of existence.

immutable_form.name: Immutable Form
immutable_form.desc_1: Immutable Form makes the wearer immune to effects like Polymorphed. Furthermore, gets a +5 bonus to saving throws against  Banishment.
immutable_form.desc_2: Spells that alter someone's form have no effect on the affected entity, and it has a +5 bonus to  Saving throws against spells that would remove it from this plane.[See: Bugs]

impenetrable_shadow.name: Impenetrable Shadow
impenetrable_shadow.desc_1: Impenetrable Shadow is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
impenetrable_shadow.desc_2: If Viconia ends her turn in darkness, she receives  Sanctuary of Loss. Viconia can use  Heartwrench and still keep this protection.

imperial_retaliation.name: Imperial Retaliation
imperial_retaliation.desc_1: Imperial Retaliation is a passive feature that retaliates against an attacker by stunning them.
imperial_retaliation.desc_2: When the wielder succeeds a  Saving throw, the foe that caused the throw needs to make an  Intelligence saving throw or be  Stunned for 1 turn.

improved_abjuration.name: Improved Abjuration
improved_abjuration.desc_1: Improved Abjuration is a passive feature of the Abjuration School Wizard. When you take a Short Rest, you can boost your Arcane Ward charges by your wizard level.
improved_abjuration.desc_2: Each time you take a Short Rest, the intensity of your  Arcane Ward increases by an amount equal to your wizard level.

improved_bardic_inspiration.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration
improved_bardic_inspiration.desc_1: Improved Bardic Inspiration is a passive feature that improves the user's Bardic Inspiration.
improved_bardic_inspiration.desc_2: The bonus gained from  Bardic Inspiration increases to  +1d8. At higher levels When the Bard reaches Level 10, the bonus increases to  +1d10.

improved_bardic_inspiration_attack_roll_.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check
improved_bardic_inspiration_attack_roll_.desc_1: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Attack Roll or Ability Check is a passive feature that allows the user to improve the success of their next attack or ability roll.
improved_bardic_inspiration_attack_roll_.desc_2: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next Attack roll or Ability Check.

improved_bardic_inspiration_saving_throw.name: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw
improved_bardic_inspiration_saving_throw.desc_1: Improved Bardic Inspiration: Saving Throw is a passive feature that allows the user to improve the chance of success on their next saving throw when active.
improved_bardic_inspiration_saving_throw.desc_2: Add a +1d12 bonus to your next  Saving throw.

improved_combat_superiority.name: Improved Combat Superiority
improved_combat_superiority.desc_1: Improved Combat Superiority is a Battle Master Fighter passive feature that increases the strength of their Maneuvers.
improved_combat_superiority.desc_2: The size of your  Superiority Die increases to a   d10

improved_critical.name: Improved Critical
improved_critical.desc_1: Improved Critical is a passive feature that increases the wielder's critical hit chance.
improved_critical.desc_2: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

improved_critical_hit.name: Improved Critical Hit
improved_critical_hit.desc_1: Improved Critical Hit is a Champion Fighter passive feature that reduces the number they need to roll for a critical hit by 1.
improved_critical_hit.desc_2: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

improved_divine_smite.name: Improved Divine Smite
improved_divine_smite.desc_1: Improved Divine Smite is a passive feature available to Paladins that adds extra damage to all of their weapon strikes. This damage stacks with all other sources.
improved_divine_smite.desc_2: Your attacks are suffused with divine might.  Melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8⁠Radiant damage.

improved_elemental_casting.name: Improved Elemental Casting
improved_elemental_casting.desc_1: Improved Elemental Casting is a Way of the Four Elements Monk passive feature that improves the strength and damage of your Four Elements Spells.
improved_elemental_casting.desc_2: Your affinity with elemental ki deepens. Several of your offensive Four Elements features deal an additional dice of damage, your  Clench of the North Wind can hold an additional creature, and your  Embrace of the Inferno fires an extra ray.

improved_extra_attack.name: Improved Extra Attack
improved_extra_attack.desc_1: Improved Extra Attack is a Fighter passive feature that allows you to make 2 additional attacks when making an Attack Action.
improved_extra_attack.desc_2: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

improved_minor_illusion.name: Improved Minor Illusion
improved_minor_illusion.desc_1: Improved Minor Illusion is a passive feature granted to Illusion School Wizards. It grants them an improved version of Minor Illusion.
improved_minor_illusion.desc_2: You can cast  Minor Illusion as a bonus action.

improved_wild_strike.name: Improved Wild Strike
improved_wild_strike.desc_1: Improved Wild Strike is a Druid passive feature that lets you make further multiple unarmed attacks while Wildshaped.
improved_wild_strike.desc_2: You can make 2 additional attacks after making an unarmed or weapon strike while in wildshape.

impulse_blast.name: Impulse Blast
impulse_blast.desc_1: Impulse Blast is a passive feature that sends a shockwave when killing or landing critical hits.
impulse_blast.desc_2: Knocks nearby creatures  Prone after killing a target or landing a Critical Hit.

incorporeal_movement.name: Incorporeal Movement
incorporeal_movement.desc_1: Incorporeal Movement is a passive feature available to Poltergeists.
incorporeal_movement.desc_2: Opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage.

inescapable_destruction.name: Inescapable Destruction
inescapable_destruction.desc_1: Inescapable Destruction is a Death Domain cleric passive feature. It allows ⁠Necrotic dealt by the cleric to bypass Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.
inescapable_destruction.desc_2: Damage you deal ignores Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.

inevitable_resolve.name: Inevitable Resolve
inevitable_resolve.desc_1: Inevitable Resolve is a unique  Raphael passive feature that prevents him from being controlled or incapacitated.
inevitable_resolve.desc_2: Effects that control or incapacitate creatures only last 1 turn against this being of pure infernal ambition.

infectious_greed.name: Infectious Greed
infectious_greed.desc_1: Infectious Greed is a passive feature used by Helsik that gives the user and its allies a boost in damage as long as they remain close by.
infectious_greed.desc_2: Tempted by the riches that Mammon offers to those most faithful to him, all allies in the presence of this creature are affected by  Infectious Greed

infectious_madness.name: Infectious Madness
infectious_madness.desc_1: Infectious Madness is a passive feature available to Cranium Rats, which causes attackers to become  Confused unless they pass an Intelligence  Saving throw.
infectious_madness.desc_2: After the cranium rat takes damage, the attacker must make an Intelligence Saving Throw or become Confused.

infernal_acuity.name: Infernal Acuity
infernal_acuity.desc_1: Infernal Acuity is a passive feature that grants a bonus to your spells.
infernal_acuity.desc_2: You gain +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC.

infernal_evasion.name: Infernal Evasion
infernal_evasion.desc_1: Infernal Evasion is a passive feature that lets the user use a reaction to make a saving throw.
infernal_evasion.desc_2: When you fail a  Saving throw, you may use your  Reaction to succeed instead.

infernal_legion.name: Infernal Legion
infernal_legion.desc_1: Infernal Legion is a passive feature that makes the wearer a part of the legion.
infernal_legion.desc_2: Grants the  Infernal Legion condition while worn.

infernal_retribution.name: Infernal Retribution
infernal_retribution.desc_1: Infernal Retribution is a passive feature that burns an attacker whenever the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw.
infernal_retribution.desc_2: When you succeed a  Saving throw, the caster receives  Burning (Orthonic) for 3 turns.

infernal_sight.name: Infernal Sight
infernal_sight.desc_1: Infernal Sight is a passive feature that lets the wearer see in normal darkness, and provides immunity against blindness.
infernal_sight.desc_2: You can see in magical and ordinary darkness up to a range of  12 m / 40 ft. You cannot be  Blinded.

infernal_touch.name: Infernal Touch
infernal_touch.desc_1: Infernal Touch is a passive feature that adds fire damage to the wearer's weapon attacks or necrotic damage to unarmed attacks.
infernal_touch.desc_2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict  Bleeding.

infernal_weapon.name: Infernal Weapon
infernal_weapon.desc_1: Infernal Weapon is a passive feature that poisons your target an addition to your regular damage.
infernal_weapon.desc_2: On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3⁠Poison damage and can possibly  Poison its target.

infernal_weapon_merregon.name: Infernal Weapon (merregon)
infernal_weapon_merregon.desc_1: Infernal Weapon is a passive feature only available to Vengeful Merregons that constantly ignites their weapons in fire.
infernal_weapon_merregon.desc_2: This creature's weapon will ignite at the start of its turns, dealing an additional 1d4⁠Fire.

infested.name: Infested
