infested.desc_1: Infested is a passive feature available to ettercaps which lets them Infest nearby creatures.
infested.desc_2: Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1~4⁠Piercing and 1~4⁠Poison each turn. When hit with a melee attack, the infestation spreads to the attacker. Upon death, the infestation spreads to all nearby creatures. Removed by fire or acid. Doesn't harm ettercaps or spiders.

innate_fortitude.name: Innate Fortitude
innate_fortitude.desc_1: Innate Fortitude is a passive feature that lets you reroll attacks and saing throws.
innate_fortitude.desc_2: Once per Long Rest, you can use a  Reaction to make an Attack roll or  Saving throw with  Advantage. Grants:

innate_invisibility.name: Innate Invisibility
innate_invisibility.desc_1: Innate Invisibility is a passive feature that grants permanent invisibility.
innate_invisibility.desc_2: Invisible by nature, this creature can only be seen through magical means.

insidious_cold.name: Insidious Cold
insidious_cold.desc_1: Insidious Cold is a passive feature that chills your targets whenever you deal cold damage.
insidious_cold.desc_2: Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts  Chilled upon the target.

intense_adamantine_backlash.name: Intense Adamantine Backlash
intense_adamantine_backlash.desc_1: Intense Adamantine Backlash is a passive feature that can cause melee attackers to be sent  Reeling.
intense_adamantine_backlash.desc_2: When a melee attack hits you, the Attacker is sent  Reeling for 3 turns. Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.

interplanar_slayer.name: Interplanar Slayer
interplanar_slayer.desc_1: Interplanar Slayer is a passive feature that increases damage against otherworldly creatures.
interplanar_slayer.desc_2: This weapon grants a +1d4 bonus to damage and Attack rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends, and elementals.

intimate_embrace.name: Intimate Embrace
intimate_embrace.desc_1: Intimate Embrace is a passive feature allowing the other ring wearer to receive a defensive bonus.
intimate_embrace.desc_2: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to cast  Warding Bond once per Long Rest on a creature wearing the  matching ring.

inured_to_undeath.name: Inured to Undeath
inured_to_undeath.desc_1: Inured to Undeath is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that enhances your mastery over death. You become resistant to Necrotic damage and cannot have your maximum hit points reduced.
inured_to_undeath.desc_2: You have steeped yourself so completely in death that you are Resistant to Necrotic damage, and moreover your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.

invisible_weapon.name: Invisible Weapon
invisible_weapon.desc_1: Invisible Weapon is a passive feature that prevents the wielder from being disarmed, until it becomes visible on a missed attack.
invisible_weapon.desc_2: This weapon is  Invisible while equipped. It has  Advantage on Attack rolls. It loses this property for 2 rounds on a missed Attack roll. The weapon also scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

iron_mind.name: Iron Mind
iron_mind.desc_1: Iron Mind is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that increases your defenses against certain mental attacks.
iron_mind.desc_2: You gain Proficiency in Wisdom and Intelligence  Saving throws.

ironvine.name: Ironvine
ironvine.desc_1: Ironvine is a passive feature that automatically damages an attacker as long as you are using Shillelagh.
ironvine.desc_2: While the wielder is holding a weapon empowered with  Shillelagh, and when they are hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes ⁠Piercing Damage equal to the wielder's Wisdom modifier.

isolated_prey.name: Isolated Prey
isolated_prey.desc_1: Isolated Prey is passive feature gives a creature  Advantage on Attack Rolls against targets that do not have allies within 5m.
isolated_prey.desc_2: This creature has Advantage on Attack Rolls against targets that do not have allies within 5m.

jack_of_all_trades.name: Jack of All Trades
jack_of_all_trades.desc_1: Jack of All Trades is a Bard passive feature that makes you add half your Proficiency Bonus to Ability Checks that you aren't Proficient in.
jack_of_all_trades.desc_2: Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to Ability Checks that you are not Proficient in.

keen_attack.name: Keen Attack
keen_attack.desc_1: Keen Attack is a passive feature that greatly increases their chance to hit.
keen_attack.desc_2: The wielder doubles their Proficiency Bonus when rolling ranged attacks with this weapon, unless they have Disadvantage.

keen_senses.name: Keen Senses
keen_senses.desc_1: Keen Senses is a passive feature that grants Elves and Drow Proficiency in Perception.

keeper_of_the_veil.name: Keeper of the Veil
keeper_of_the_veil.desc_1: Keeper of the Veil is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency in Arcana and can cast the spell  Protection from Evil and Good once per long rest.
keeper_of_the_veil.desc_2: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can grant protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

ki_empowered_strikes.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
ki_empowered_strikes.desc_1: Ki-Empowered Strikes is a Monk passive feature that allows unarmed attacks to count as magical while attacking enemies with resistance to physical attacks. In effect, unarmed attacks will ignore resistance and immunity to ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, ⁠Bludgeoning non magical damage of the corresponding type.
ki_empowered_strikes.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

knockdown_jaws.name: Knockdown Jaws
knockdown_jaws.desc_1: Knockdown Jaws is a passive feature that allows the user's bite attacks to knock targets Prone.
knockdown_jaws.desc_2: Bite attacks from this creature can possibly knock the target  Prone.

kushigo_s_might.name: Kushigo's Might
kushigo_s_might.desc_1: Uninhibited Kushigo is a passive feature that increases throwing and improvised weapon damage.
kushigo_s_might.desc_2: The wearer deals an additional   1d4 damage with  Throw Attacks and attacks made with  Improvised Weapons.

land_s_stride_advantage.name: Land's Stride: Advantage
land_s_stride_advantage.desc_1: Land's Stride: Advantage is a passive feature which grants advantage when resisting some to plant-based effects. It is an unlisted component of the Land's Stride feature.
land_s_stride_advantage.desc_2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.

land_s_stride_difficult_terrain.name: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain
land_s_stride_difficult_terrain.desc_1: Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain is a passive feature that makes it so that you are not slowed when traversing Difficult Terrain. It is a component of Land's Stride.
land_s_stride_difficult_terrain.desc_2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

land_s_stride_plants.name: Land's Stride: Plants
land_s_stride_plants.desc_1: Land's Stride: Plants is a passive feature which confers immunity to many plant-based hazards. It is an unlisted component of the Land's Stride feature.
land_s_stride_plants.desc_2: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.

last_hope.name: Last Hope
last_hope.desc_1: Last Hope is a passive feature that grants Hope Death Ward at the start of combat.
last_hope.desc_2: Hope always begins combat under the effects of  Death Ward.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc_1: Last Stand is a passive feature that increases your damage when you are severely wounded.
last_stand.desc_2: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain  Wrath for 2 turns.

lathander_s_blessing.name: Lathander's Blessing
lathander_s_blessing.desc_1: Lathander's Blessing is a passive feature that protects the wielder should they fall in combat.
lathander_s_blessing.desc_2: Once per Long Rest, when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6⁠hit points. Allies within 9 m / 30 ft also regain 1d6⁠hit points.

lathander_s_light.name: Lathander's Light
lathander_s_light.desc_1: Lathander's Light is a toggleable passive feature that sheds light and blinds enemies.
lathander_s_light.desc_2: Sheds holy light in a  6 m / 20 ft radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw.

lay_bare_their_weakness.name: Lay Bare Their Weakness
lay_bare_their_weakness.desc_1: Lay Bare Their Weakness is a passive feature that increases the difficulty to resist the wearer's spells.
lay_bare_their_weakness.desc_2: After dealing damage with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to their spell save DC until the end of their turn.

leap_to_your_feet.name: Leap to Your Feet
leap_to_your_feet.desc_1: Leap to Your Feet is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that helps them get up quicker from being prone.
leap_to_your_feet.desc_2: When you are  Prone, standing up uses only 1.5 m / 5 ft of your  Movement Speed speed.

legendary_action_adamantine_reverberatio.name: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
legendary_action_adamantine_reverberatio.desc_1: Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation is a legendary action passive feature available to Grym in Honour mode. Once per turn when struck by an attack, Grym reverberates, granting  10 temporary hit points and doubled movement speed until the temporary hit points are depleted.
legendary_action_adamantine_reverberatio.desc_2: Once per round, Grym can use its Legendary Action to  Reverberate when it is struck, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points. Losing these temporary hit points triggers a shockwave that knocks targets back  4 m / 13 ft and deals 4d8⁠Thunder damage. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_beguiling_rebuke.name: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
legendary_action_beguiling_rebuke.desc_1: Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is not in his  Fiendish Ascension form. It lets him expend a legendary action to use Beguiling Rebuke, after he or his allies are attacked.
legendary_action_beguiling_rebuke.desc_2: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately  Beguile a hostile creature and its allies after being attacked. Raphael may use this Legendary Action as many times per round as there are Soul Pillars standing at the start of the round. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_bhaal_s_edict.name: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
legendary_action_bhaal_s_edict.desc_1: Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict is a passive feature available to the Boon of Bhaal during combat with Orin in Honour mode, provided she is not being duelled alone.
legendary_action_bhaal_s_edict.desc_2: If Orin has not used her Legendary Action by the end of a round, and Orin is not duelling her opponent alone, the Dread Lord places a creature under  Bhaal's Edict. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_blinding_ambush.name: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
legendary_action_blinding_ambush.desc_1: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush is a passive feature available to Yurgir in Honour mode, that lets him use Blinding Ambush and Watchful Hunt.
legendary_action_blinding_ambush.desc_2: Once per round, Yurgir can spend a Legendary Action to  Blinding Ambush a  Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_call_consort.name: Legendary Action: Call Consort
legendary_action_call_consort.desc_1: Legendary Action: Call Consort is a passive feature available to the Owlbear mother in her nest in Honour mode. It gives her access to  Call Consort to call her  mate, who has the same base stats and can use  Vengeful Father.
legendary_action_call_consort.desc_2: Once per combat, the Owlbear mother can spend a Legendary Action to  summon her mate when she is attacked. Although Legendary Actions normally restore at the start of each round, this one may only be used once.

legendary_action_devoted_galvanism.name: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
legendary_action_devoted_galvanism.desc_1: Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism is a passive feature used by Dror Ragzlin in Honour mode that lets him use  Galvanise nearby allies when they are attacked.
legendary_action_devoted_galvanism.desc_2: Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to  Galvanise Absolutists within  5 m / 17 ft, granting them  Action Surge. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_draconic_fury.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
legendary_action_draconic_fury.desc_1: This legendary action allows use of a dragon's breath weapon once per round as a free reaction.
legendary_action_draconic_fury.desc_2: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

legendary_action_draconic_wrath.name: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
legendary_action_draconic_wrath.desc_1: Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath is a passive feature available to Ansur, that lets him use a legendary action to react with his  Lightning Breath once per round after being attacked
legendary_action_draconic_wrath.desc_2: The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.

legendary_action_fanatic_retaliation.name: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
legendary_action_fanatic_retaliation.desc_1: Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation is a passive feature available to Kar'niss in Honour mode, which lets him use the legendary action  Fanatic Retaliation immediately after one of his spindleweb fanatics is killed. He will target the killer.
legendary_action_fanatic_retaliation.desc_2: Once per round when a  Spindleweb Fanatic is killed, Kar'niss can use a Legendary Action to possibly deal 6d10⁠Psychic and  Silence the attacker. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_gaze_of_the_dead.name: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
legendary_action_gaze_of_the_dead.desc_1: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead is a passive feature available to Apostle of Myrkul in Honour Mode that allows him to use a Legendary action to retaliate against an attacker.
legendary_action_gaze_of_the_dead.desc_2: Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_gossamer_tomb.name: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
legendary_action_gossamer_tomb.desc_1: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb is a passive feature available to the Phase Spider Matriarch in Honour mode, that lets her entomb in web a creature attacking one of her spiderlings.
legendary_action_gossamer_tomb.desc_2: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, the Phase Spider Matriarch can spend a Legendary Action to use  Gossamer Tomb. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_grasping_appendage.name: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
legendary_action_grasping_appendage.desc_1: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage is a legendary action passive feature available to Malus Thorm, that lets him pull an enemy towards him.
legendary_action_grasping_appendage.desc_2: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action to  Grasp a creature and pull it closer. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_heartwrench.name: Legendary Action: Heartwrench
legendary_action_heartwrench.desc_1: Legendary Action: Heartwrench is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
legendary_action_heartwrench.desc_2: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to  Heartwrench a  Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes her or her allies. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_hordestrike.name: Legendary Action: Hordestrike
legendary_action_hordestrike.desc_1: Legendary Action: Hordestrike is a passive feature available to Ketheric in Honour mode.
legendary_action_hordestrike.desc_2: Once per round, Ketheric can spend a Legendary Action to  Hordestrike an enemy when it is attacked by one of his minions following  Deadly Orders. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_leaping_static.name: Legendary Action: Leaping Static
legendary_action_leaping_static.desc_1: Legendary Action: Leaping Static is a passive feature available to Bernard in Honour mode. It lets Bernard use the legendary action Leaping Static as a reaction to being attacked.
legendary_action_leaping_static.desc_2: Once per round, Bernard can spend a Legendary Action to immediately launch  Leaping Static at a foe after being attacked. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_mind_claw_of_tu_narath.name: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
legendary_action_mind_claw_of_tu_narath.desc_1: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath is a passive feature affecting Ch'r'ai W'wargaz on Honour mode. It allows him to use a Legendary action to summons a deadly psionic blade in response to the inquisitor or an ally being attacked.
legendary_action_mind_claw_of_tu_narath.desc_2: Twice per round, Inquisitor W'wargaz can spend a Legendary Action to summon a Mind-Claw of Tu'narath after he or his allies are struck. When the claw strikes, W'wargaz may  Mindsteal Link with a target not already affected by this condition. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_murderous_retort.name: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
legendary_action_murderous_retort.desc_1: Legendary Action: Murderous Retort is a passive feature that lets its user use the Legendary Action  Murderous Retort to strike back at attackers.
legendary_action_murderous_retort.desc_2: Once per round, Orin or Sarevok can use their Legendary Action to immediately strike back at their attacker. If  Deathbringer's Legacy is active, they use  Deathbringer's Assault (Sarevok) or  Deathbringer's Assault (Orin) instead. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_ocular_nightmare.name: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
legendary_action_ocular_nightmare.desc_1: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare is a passive feature available to the Spectator, that lets it use a legendary action to attack all creatures nearby with eye beams.
legendary_action_ocular_nightmare.desc_2: After accumulating five  Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare.

legendary_action_overflowing_brew.name: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
legendary_action_overflowing_brew.desc_1: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew is a passive feature used by Thisobald Thorm in Honour Mode, which lets him use his legendary action  Overflowing Brew.
legendary_action_overflowing_brew.desc_2: Once per round, Thisobald Thorm can use his Legendary Action when his brew is changed by a foe's attack to make it overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type. The overflow also grants his allies +5 bonus to Strength or an additional +1d6 damage of the corresponding damage type. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_psionic_visage.name: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
legendary_action_psionic_visage.desc_1: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage is a legendary passive feature available to Nere in Honour mode. When attacked, Nere can cast Psionic Visage to protect himself from ⁠Physical damage with 3 psionic copies of himself.
legendary_action_psionic_visage.desc_2: Once per round, Nere can use his Legendary Action to cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked. When he is attacked, Nere's summoned visages will  Detonate. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_ptarian_dogma.name: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
legendary_action_ptarian_dogma.desc_1: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma is a passive feature available to Ptaris in Honour mode which lets him pacify a foe that strikes him.
legendary_action_ptarian_dogma.desc_2: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.

legendary_action_sanctuary_of_loss.name: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
legendary_action_sanctuary_of_loss.desc_1: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
legendary_action_sanctuary_of_loss.desc_2: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to cast  Sanctuary of Loss when an ally is struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_sanguine_lash.name: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
legendary_action_sanguine_lash.desc_1: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash is a passive feature available to Orin, that lets her use Sanguine Lash after being attacked, or places Bhaal's Edict on a creature if she does not. Although the in-game text does not mention it, Orin will only activate this attack against foes who hit her with melee attacks.
legendary_action_sanguine_lash.desc_2: Once per round, Orin can use her Legendary Action to  Sanguine Lash after being attacked. If Orin does not use her Legendary Action in a round and is not dueling her opponent alone,  Bhaal's Edict is placed on a creature. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_shredding_scales.name: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
legendary_action_shredding_scales.desc_1: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales is a passive feature available to the Bulette in Honour Mode.
legendary_action_shredding_scales.desc_2: Once per turn, the Bulette can spend a Legendary Action to use  Shredding Scales after being hit if its  Diamond Scales are active. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_soul_ascension.name: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
legendary_action_soul_ascension.desc_1: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is in his  Fiendish Ascension form. It lets him expend a legendary action to use Soul Ascension, after he or his allies are attacked.
legendary_action_soul_ascension.desc_2: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked. Raphael may use this Legendary Action as many times per round as there are Soul Pillars standing at the start of the round. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_soul_sacrifice.name: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
legendary_action_soul_sacrifice.desc_1: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice is a passive feature available to Ch'r'ai Tska'an in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Sacrifice Soul immediately after a humanoid has died.
legendary_action_soul_sacrifice.desc_2: Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to  Sacrifice its soul to  Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_spectral_aspect.name: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
legendary_action_spectral_aspect.desc_1: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect is a passive feature that can grant a special spectral form after being struck.
legendary_action_spectral_aspect.desc_2: Once per round, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to adopt a  Spectral Aspect after being struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_sublimation.name: Legendary Action: Sublimation
legendary_action_sublimation.desc_1: Legendary Action: Sublimation is a passive feature used by Gerringothe Thorm on Honour Mode. After losing a piece of armour, Gerringothe can use a Legendary action to try to  Sublimate a foe. A creature that fails its save against this effect cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.
legendary_action_sublimation.desc_2: Once per round, if she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to try and turn her enemies into gold, incapacitating them for 4 turns. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_the_dead_wastes.name: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
legendary_action_the_dead_wastes.desc_1: Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes is a passive feature used by Balthazar that lets him use  The Dead Wastes to create a rift that heals undead and damages living creatures.
legendary_action_the_dead_wastes.desc_2: Once per round when a creature dies, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4d6⁠hit points and deals 4d6⁠Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_torrential_undeath.name: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
legendary_action_torrential_undeath.desc_1: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath is a passive feature available to Mystic Carrion in Honour Mode.
legendary_action_torrential_undeath.desc_2: Once per turn, Mystic Carrion can use his Legendary Action to release  Torrential Undeath at his foes when hit. This grants Undead  Guardian Wraiths while haunting other creatures with  Wrathful Spirits. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_tu_narath_s_embrace.name: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
legendary_action_tu_narath_s_embrace.desc_1: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace is a passive feature used by Har'rak in Honour mode that lets him use  Tu'narath's Embrace on nearby allies when they are attacked with an incapacitating condition.
legendary_action_tu_narath_s_embrace.desc_2: Once per round, Ch'r'ai Har'rak can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_tyrannical_branding.name: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
legendary_action_tyrannical_branding.desc_1: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding is a passive feature available to Enver Gortash in Honour Mode that lets him use a Legendary action to retaliate against his attacker.
legendary_action_tyrannical_branding.desc_2: Once per round, Gortash can use his Legendary Action to immediately  Brand his attacker after being struck. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_vampiric_swarm.name: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
legendary_action_vampiric_swarm.desc_1: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm is a passive feature available to Cazador on Honour Mode.
legendary_action_vampiric_swarm.desc_2: Once per round, Cazador can spend a Legendary Action to conjure a  Vampiric Swarm. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_vengeful_playmate.name: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
legendary_action_vengeful_playmate.desc_1: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate is a passive feature available to Oliver in Honour Mode.
legendary_action_vengeful_playmate.desc_2: Once per round, Oliver can spend a Legendary Action to summon  The Wasting Quiet in an area after a summoned shadow is slain. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_wail_of_loss.name: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
legendary_action_wail_of_loss.desc_1: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss is a passive feature available to Malus Thorm in Honour Mode.
legendary_action_wail_of_loss.desc_2: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action after being attacked to make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_weird_magic_surge.name: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
legendary_action_weird_magic_surge.desc_1: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge is a passive feature available to Ethel in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Weird Magic Surge immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates.
legendary_action_weird_magic_surge.desc_2: Once per round, Auntie Ethel can spend a Legendary Action to summon more illusory duplicates and shuffle herself among them after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will result in more illusory duplicates being summoned. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_action_wretched_growth.name: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
legendary_action_wretched_growth.desc_1: Legendary Action: Wretched Growth is a unique passive feature available to the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound.
legendary_action_wretched_growth.desc_2: If a creature ends its turn within  5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10⁠Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly  Entangling it. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

legendary_mobility.name: Legendary Mobility
legendary_mobility.desc_1: Legendary Mobililty is a passive feature that increases the wearer's movement
legendary_mobility.desc_2: You gain  Freedom of Movement and  Longstrider.

legendary_persistence.name: Legendary Persistence
legendary_persistence.desc_1: Legendary Persistence is a passive feature that grants permanent resistance to physical damage and a bonus to saving throws.
legendary_persistence.desc_2: You gain  Resistance and  Blade Ward.

legion_of_bees.name: Legion of Bees
legion_of_bees.actions: Legion of Bees: Attack, Legion of Bees: Knockback, Legion of Bees: Teleport
legion_of_bees.desc_1: Legion of Bees is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers. It turns the Gathered Swarm into bees that deal ⁠Piercing damage and can push enemies away. This feature can be switched out at level up.
legion_of_bees.desc_2: You gain a swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional ⁠Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location. At higher levels At level 11,  Mighty Swarm upgrades the swarm options to:

lesser_infernal_retribution.name: Lesser Infernal Retribution
lesser_infernal_retribution.desc_1: Lesser Infernal Retribution is a passive feature that retaliates against enemies with a bit of fire.
lesser_infernal_retribution.desc_2: When you are hit by a foe within  2 m / 7 ft, it might take 1d4⁠Fire damage.

lesser_infernal_touch.name: Lesser Infernal Touch
lesser_infernal_touch.desc_1: Lesser Infernal Touch is a passive feature that deals extra fire damage if armed or extra necrotic damage if unarmed.
lesser_infernal_touch.desc_2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict  Bleeding.

let_the_undead_blanch_with_fear.name: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
let_the_undead_blanch_with_fear.desc_1: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear! is a passive feature that makes it difficult for undead to hit you or apply special effects on you.
let_the_undead_blanch_with_fear.desc_2: Undead have  Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have  Advantage on  Saving throws against their actions and spells.

lethal_weapon_bludgeoning.name: Lethal Weapon (Bludgeoning)
lethal_weapon_bludgeoning.desc_1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against bludgeoning damage.
lethal_weapon_bludgeoning.desc_2: This weapon ignores resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

lethal_weapon_piercing.name: Lethal Weapon (Piercing)
lethal_weapon_piercing.desc_1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against piercing damage.
lethal_weapon_piercing.desc_2: This weapon ignores Resistance to ⁠Piercing damage.

lethal_weapon_slashing.name: Lethal Weapon (Slashing)
lethal_weapon_slashing.desc_1: Lethal Weapon is a passive feature that bypasses defenses against slashing damage.
lethal_weapon_slashing.desc_2: This weapon ignores Resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.

liberated_spellcasting.name: Liberated Spellcasting
liberated_spellcasting.desc_1: Liberated Spellcasting is a toggleable passive feature that lets you cast a spell without using up a slot, after killing a creature.
liberated_spellcasting.desc_2: When you kill a creature, you can cast a Level 1 spell without expending a spell slot.

lickspittle_s_alertness.name: Lickspittle's Alertness
lickspittle_s_alertness.desc_1: Lickspittle's Alertness is a passive feature that increases the wearer's speed at the start of combat.
lickspittle_s_alertness.desc_2: At the start of combat, the wearer gains  Momentum equal to their  Charisma Modifier.

life_essence_harvest.name: Life Essence Harvest
life_essence_harvest.desc_1: Life Essence Harvest is a passive feature that causes creatures killed by spells to give the wielder Spell Slots. They can only be used for Necromancy Spells.
life_essence_harvest.desc_2: When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain  Life Essence until their next Long Rest.

life_of_the_party.name: Life of the Party
life_of_the_party.desc_1: Life of the Party is a Way of the Drunken Master monk passive feature that grants bonuses against Drunk targets.
life_of_the_party.desc_2: Every time  Intoxicating Strike hits, the monk gains  Life of the Party, which increases Armour Class and Attack Rolls against  Drunk targets.

life_stealing_critical.name: Life Stealing Critical
life_stealing_critical.desc_1: Life Stealing Critical is a passive feature that deals extra damage on a critical hit and also gives you temporary hp.
life_stealing_critical.desc_2: On a Critical Hit, the target takes an extra 10⁠NecroticDRS damage as long as it isn't a construct or an undead. You also gain  10 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

lifecharger.name: Lifecharger
lifecharger.desc_1: Lifecharger is a passive feature that gives you a bit of extra durability.
lifecharger.desc_2: When the wearer gains  Lightning Charges, they also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points. The temporary hit points disappear if the wearer runs out of Lightning Charges. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
lifedrinker.desc_1: Lifedrinker is an Eldritch Invocation passive feature from the Warlock class. It grants the user's melee attacks additional ⁠Necrotic damage equal to their Charisma modifier.
lifedrinker.desc_2: Attacks made with your melee weapon deal additional necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

light_sensitivity.name: Light Sensitivity
light_sensitivity.desc_1: Light Sensitivity is a passive feature that causes penalties while in bright light.
light_sensitivity.desc_2: While in bright light, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception Checks that rely on sight.

lightly_armoured.name: Lightly Armoured
lightly_armoured.desc_1: Lightly Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Light Armour Proficiency if you didn't have it already, and +1 to Strength or Dexterity.
lightly_armoured.desc_2: You gain Armour Proficiency with Light Armour and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

living_shadow.name: Living Shadow
living_shadow.desc_1: Living Shadow is a passive feature which gives a creature damage resistance while obscured.
living_shadow.desc_2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this character has Resistance to all damage except ⁠Force,  ⁠Psychic or ⁠Radiant.

loving_protection.name: Loving Protection
loving_protection.desc_1: Loving Protection is a passive feature that heals you a bit when your hit points get low.
loving_protection.desc_2: Once per Short Rest, if you are below 50% Hit Points and take damage, you gain  8 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

luck_of_the_far_realms.name: Luck of the Far Realms
luck_of_the_far_realms.desc_1: Luck of the Far Realms is a passive feature/reaction and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to change a successful Attack Roll into a Critical Hit once per long rest.
luck_of_the_far_realms.desc_2: Once per Long Rest, you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.actions: Lucky: Reroll with Advantage, Lucky: Reroll Attacker's Die
lucky.desc_1: Lucky is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants the user 3 Luck Points, which can be can be used to manipulate either their rolls, or an enemy's rolls.
lucky.desc_2: You gain 3  Luck Points, which you can use to gain  Advantage on Attack rolls,  Ability checks, or  Saving throws, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack rolls.

lunar_bestial_fortitude.name: Lunar Bestial Fortitude
lunar_bestial_fortitude.desc_1: Lunar Bestial Fortitude is a passive feature granted by  Armour of Moonbasking.
lunar_bestial_fortitude.desc_2: You have a +2 bonus to  Armour Class. You also have  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells. This effect persists while using your druidic  Wild Shape ability.

lunar_bestial_vitality.name: Lunar Bestial Vitality
lunar_bestial_vitality.desc_1: Lunar Bestial Vitality is a passive feature that boosts a druid's wildshape.
lunar_bestial_vitality.desc_2: You gain  22 temporary hit points after casting  Wild Shape. While those temporary hit points are active reduce all incoming damage by 1. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

mage_breaker.name: Mage Breaker
mage_breaker.desc_1: Mage Breaker is a Ranger passive effect of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency in Arcana and gain the  True Strike cantrip.
mage_breaker.desc_2: You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can cast  True Strike.

mage_hand_legerdemain.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
mage_hand_legerdemain.desc_1: Mage Hand Legerdemain is an Arcane Trickster Rogue passive feature. This ability enhances your  Mage Hand, allowing it to remain permanently and granting it invisibility.
mage_hand_legerdemain.desc_2: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.

mage_slayer_attack_caster.name: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster
mage_slayer_attack_caster.desc_1: Mage Slayer: Attack Caster is a passive feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When a creature casts a spell near you, you can attack the caster as a Reaction.
mage_slayer_attack_caster.desc_2: When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you can use a  Reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster.

mage_slayer_break_concentration.name: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration
mage_slayer_break_concentration.desc_1: Mage Slayer: Break Concentration is a Passive Feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When you attack a creature, they have Disadvantage on any Concentration Saving Throws they make that turn.
mage_slayer_break_concentration.desc_2: Enemies you hit have  Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

mage_slayer_saving_throw_advantage.name: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage
mage_slayer_saving_throw_advantage.desc_1: Mage Slayer: Saving Throw Advantage is a passive feature provided by the Mage Slayer Feat. When a creature casts a spell near you, you have  Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.
mage_slayer_saving_throw_advantage.desc_2: When a creature casts a spell within melee range of you, you have  Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.

magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
magic_arrow.desc_1: Magic Arrow is an Arcane Archer fighter passive feature that makes their arrows considered magical.
magic_arrow.desc_2: All of your ranged attacks are considered magical to overcome Resistance.

magic_club.name: Magic Club
magic_club.desc_1: Magic Club is a passive feature applied to Twisting Branches clubs carried by Wood Woads. It causes the clubs to become magical weapons and deal extra damage.
magic_club.desc_2: In the Wood Woad's hand, a common club becomes magical and deals 3d4⁠Bludgeoning damage extra.

magic_initiate_bard.name: Magic Initiate: Bard
magic_initiate_bard.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Bard is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_bard.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Bard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

magic_initiate_cleric.name: Magic Initiate: Cleric
magic_initiate_cleric.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Cleric is a Passive Feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_cleric.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Wisdom.

magic_initiate_druid.name: Magic Initiate: Druid
magic_initiate_druid.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Druid is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_druid.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Wisdom.

magic_initiate_sorcerer.name: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer
magic_initiate_sorcerer.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_sorcerer.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Sorcerer spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

magic_initiate_warlock.name: Magic Initiate: Warlock
magic_initiate_warlock.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Warlock is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_warlock.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. These spells cannot be upcast. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Charisma.

magic_initiate_wizard.name: Magic Initiate: Wizard
magic_initiate_wizard.desc_1: Magic Initiate: Wizard is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. It grants you spells and cantrips from that particular class.
magic_initiate_wizard.desc_2: You have learnt 2 cantrips and a Level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the Level 1 spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Modifier for all 3 spells is  Intelligence.

magic_resistance.name: Magic Resistance
magic_resistance.desc_1: Magic Resistance is a passive feature that grants a creature advantage on saving throws against magical effects.
magic_resistance.desc_2: Has  Advantage on Saving Throws against Spells and other magical effects.

magical_ambush.name: Magical Ambush
magical_ambush.desc_1: Magical Ambush is a togglable passive gained by Arcane Tricksters at Level 9. Magical Ambush allows the Rogue to circumvent their target's defenses when casting spells while hidden.
magical_ambush.desc_2: While you are  Hiding, your targets have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your Spells.

magical_durability_1.name: Magical Durability (+1)
magical_durability_1.desc_1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
magical_durability_1.desc_2: The wielder has a +1 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

magical_durability_sword_of_the_emperor.name: Magical Durability (Sword of the Emperor)
magical_durability_sword_of_the_emperor.desc_1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
magical_durability_sword_of_the_emperor.desc_2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

magical_durability_flawed_helldusk_helme.name: Magical Durability (Flawed Helldusk Helmet)
magical_durability_flawed_helldusk_helme.desc_1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
magical_durability_flawed_helldusk_helme.desc_2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

magical_durability_helldusk_helmet.name: Magical Durability (Helldusk Helmet)
magical_durability_helldusk_helmet.desc_1: Magical Durability is a passive feature that increases the user's defenses against spells.
magical_durability_helldusk_helmet.desc_2: The wielder has a +2 bonus to  Saving throws against spells.

magical_plate_1.name: Magical Plate (-1)
magical_plate_1.desc_1: Magical Plate is a passive feature that reduces incoming damage by 1.
magical_plate_1.desc_2: All incoming damage is reduced by 1

magical_plate_2.name: Magical Plate (-2)
magical_plate_2.desc_1: Magical Plate is a passive feature that reduces incoming damage by 2.
magical_plate_2.desc_2: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

malefic_excretion.name: Malefic Excretion
malefic_excretion.desc_1: Malefic Excretion is a passive feature that adds acid damage to the wearer's weapon attacks.
malefic_excretion.desc_2: Your weapon attacks also deal 2⁠Acid damage.

malefic_funghi.name: Malefic Funghi
malefic_funghi.desc_1: Malefic Funghi is a passive feature that boosts a druid's spells and damage.
malefic_funghi.desc_2: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and when dealing ⁠Necrotic damage, they deal an additional 1⁠Necrotic Damage.

man_s_best_friend.name: Man's Best Friend
man_s_best_friend.desc_1: Man's Best Friend is a passive feature which boosts the offence and defence of a hunting dog, according to the proficiency bonus of their master.
man_s_best_friend.desc_2: This hunting dog's Armour Class and damage increase by an amount equal to the Proficiency Bonus of its houndmaster.

manifestation_of_body.name: Manifestation of Body
manifestation_of_body.desc_1: Manifestation of Body is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Necrotic damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
manifestation_of_body.desc_2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Necrotic damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Mind or  Manifestation of Soul.

manifestation_of_mind.name: Manifestation of Mind
manifestation_of_mind.desc_1: Manifestation of Mind is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Psychic damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
manifestation_of_mind.desc_2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Psychic damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Body or  Manifestation of Soul.

manifestation_of_soul.name: Manifestation of Soul
manifestation_of_soul.desc_1: Manifestation of Soul is a togglable passive feature unique to Way of the Open Hand Monks at Level 6, that adds extra ⁠Radiant damage based on your Wisdom Modifier to unarmed attacks.
manifestation_of_soul.desc_2: Your hands sap the ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠Radiant damage. Can't be used at the same time as  Manifestation of Body or  Manifestation of Mind.

marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
marksmanship.desc_1: Marksmanship is a passive feature that increases the hit chance of ranged attacks.
marksmanship.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Ranged Attack rolls and Thrown Attack Rolls.

martial_adept.name: Martial Adept
martial_adept.desc_1: Martial Adept is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You learn two manoeuvres and gain a Superiority Die to use them.
martial_adept.desc_2: Learn two manoeuvres from the Battle Master Fighter subclass and receive 1 (additional)  Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest.

martial_advantage.name: Martial Advantage
martial_advantage.desc_1: Martial Advantage is a passive feature available to Hobgoblins.
martial_advantage.desc_2: Once per turn, the Hobgoblin can deal an extra 2d6⁠Physical damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack. The hobgoblin must have an ally who is within 2 m / 7 ft of the target and isn't  Incapacitated.

martial_arts_bonus_unarmed_strike.name: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike
martial_arts_bonus_unarmed_strike.desc_1: Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike is a Monk passive feature that grants a single follow-up  Unarmed Strike (Monk) using a  Bonus Action. The initial attack must be unarmed or use a Monk Weapon.
martial_arts_bonus_unarmed_strike.desc_2: After making an attack with a Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

martial_arts_deft_strikes.name: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes
martial_arts_deft_strikes.desc_1: Martial Arts: Deft Strikes is a Monk passive feature that raises the minimum damage dealt with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks to 1d4⁠Bludgeoning.
martial_arts_deft_strikes.desc_2: Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher. At Monk Level 3, the damage increases to 1d6⁠ Bludgeoning. At Monk Level 9, the damage increases to 1d8⁠ Bludgeoning.

martial_arts_dextrous_attacks.name: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks
martial_arts_dextrous_attacks.desc_1: Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks is a Monk passive which makes attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks scale with Dexterity instead of Strength, if the user's  Dexterity is higher.
martial_arts_dextrous_attacks.desc_2: Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

martial_bravery.name: Martial Bravery
martial_bravery.desc_1: Martial Bravery is a passive feature that grants the wearer increased damage when surrounded by 2 or more enemies.
martial_bravery.desc_2: Your weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

martial_prodigy.name: Martial Prodigy
martial_prodigy.desc_1: Martial Prodigy is a passive feature that grants Githyanki Proficiency with the Light Armour, Medium Armour, Shortswords, Longswords, and Greatswords.
martial_prodigy.desc_2: A lifetime of relentless training gave you Armour proficiency with  Light armour and  Medium armour, as well as Proficiency with  Shortswords,  Longswords, and  Greatswords.

mask_of_many_faces.name: Mask of Many Faces
mask_of_many_faces.desc_1: Mask of Many Faces is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the wearer to repeatedly disguise themselves at will.
mask_of_many_faces.desc_2: You can cast  Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.

medium_armour_master.name: Medium Armour Master
medium_armour_master.desc_1: Medium Armour Master is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. Your mastery over Medium Armour increases, granting you increased  Armour Class and the ability to Stealth without  Disadvantage from the Medium Armour.
medium_armour_master.desc_2: When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose  Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to  Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2. You must have Proficiency in Medium Armour to take this feat

melee_caster.name: Melee Caster
melee_caster.desc_1: Melee Caster is a passive feature that allows a magic user to use its casting ability to attack targets more accurately.
melee_caster.desc_2: Instead of its Dexterity Modifier, the affected entity add its Spellcasting Ability Modifier to Attack rolls.

mental_inhibition.name: Mental Inhibition
mental_inhibition.desc_1: Mental Inhibition is a passive feature that tires out the wearer's target's mind.
mental_inhibition.desc_2: When a foe fails a  Saving throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

mental_interference.name: Mental Interference
mental_interference.desc_1: Mental Interference is a passive feature that tires out the user's targets when dealing psychic damage to them.
mental_interference.desc_2: When you deal ⁠Psychic damage, you also inflict  Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

merry_revelry.name: Merry Revelry
merry_revelry.desc_1: Merry Revelry is a passive feature available to Ethel's Redcap servants, that reduces the effect of their  Bloodlust when attacking characters with  Alcohol in their blood.
merry_revelry.desc_2: This Redcap's Bloodlust is subdued when there are traces of alcohol in a target's blood, which means they will primarily target creatures who are sober.

metamagic_careful_spell.name: Metamagic: Careful Spell
metamagic_careful_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Careful Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to prevent harmful Spell effects affecting their allies.
metamagic_careful_spell.desc_2: Allies automatically succeed Saving Throws against spells that required them.

metamagic_distant_spell.name: Metamagic: Distant Spell
metamagic_distant_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Distant Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to increase the range of their Spells.
metamagic_distant_spell.desc_2: Increases the range of the spell by 50%. Melee spells are increased to  Range: 9 m / 30 ft.

metamagic_extended_spell.name: Metamagic: Extended Spell
metamagic_extended_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Extended Spell  is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to extend the duration of magical effects caused by their Spells.
metamagic_extended_spell.desc_2: Double the duration of conditions, summons, and surfaces caused by spells.

metamagic_heightened_spell.name: Metamagic: Heightened Spell
metamagic_heightened_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Heightened Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to empower the magical effects of their Spells, making it harder for targeted creatures to resist the spell.
metamagic_heightened_spell.desc_2: Targets of spells that require Saving Throws have  Disadvantage on their first Saving Throw.

metamagic_quickened_spell.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell
metamagic_quickened_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Quickened Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to cast multiple Spells in a turn.
metamagic_quickened_spell.desc_2: Spells that take an  Action take a  Bonus Action instead.

metamagic_subtle_spell.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell
metamagic_subtle_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Subtle Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This Metamagic ability allows Sorcerers to cast Spells without chanting or hand movements and allows them to ignore the  Silenced condition. However, spells cast with Subtle Spell can still be countered by enemy casters using Counterspell.
metamagic_subtle_spell.desc_2: You can cast spells while  Silenced.

metamagic_twinned_spell.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell
metamagic_twinned_spell.desc_1: Metamagic: Twinned Spell is a toggleable passive feature used by Sorcerers. This ability allows Sorcerers to target two creatures with certain Spells.
metamagic_twinned_spell.desc_2: Spells that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature. Costs 1  Sorcery Point per Spell Slot level used. Cantrips also cost 1  Sorcery Point. For spells that don't shoot a projectile, the targets need to be close enough together.

mighty_swarm.name: Mighty Swarm
mighty_swarm.desc_1: Mighty Swarm is a Swarmkeeper ranger passive feature that increases the power of their swarm.
mighty_swarm.desc_2: Your swarm has grown stronger. The swarm's regular attack now deals 1d8 damage, its special attack has one additional feature, and teleporting with your swarm now also increases your  Armour Class for the rest of the round.

mindless_rage.name: Mindless Rage
mindless_rage.desc_1: Mindless Rage is a Berserker Barbarian passive feature. While raging, these barbarians cannot be Charmed or Frightened.
mindless_rage.desc_2: Your rage becomes all-consuming, repelling outside influence. While  Frenzied, you can't be  Charmed or  Frightened, and  Calm Emotions no longer ends your rage.

mindreader.name: Mindreader
mindreader.desc_1: Mindreader is a passive feature that gives Ranged Attacks against the creature  Disadvantage.
mindreader.desc_2: Ranged attacks have  Disadvantage against this creature.

minions_of_chaos.name: Minions of Chaos
minions_of_chaos.desc_1: Minions of Chaos is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Conjure Elemental.
minions_of_chaos.desc_2: You can cast  Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.

mire_the_mind.name: Mire the Mind
mire_the_mind.desc_1: Mire the Mind is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Slow on enemies.
mire_the_mind.desc_2: You can cast  Slow with a Warlock spell slot.

misty_presence.name: Misty Presence
misty_presence.desc_1: Misty Presence is a passive feature that protects the user by turning invisible.
misty_presence.desc_2: After taking damage this character may turn  Invisible.

mobile.name: Mobile
mobile.desc_1: Mobile is a passive feature given by the feat of the same name, which grants an additional 3m of Movement Speed.

mobile_evade_difficult_terrain.name: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain
mobile_evade_difficult_terrain.desc_1: Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain is a passive feature that allows a character to ignore Difficult Terrain after Dashing.
mobile_evade_difficult_terrain.desc_2: When you Dash,  Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.

mobile_evade_opportunity_attack.name: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack
mobile_evade_opportunity_attack.desc_1: Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack is a passive feature that lets a creature move away from a target without provoking Opportunity Attacks, after they have made a melee attack.
mobile_evade_opportunity_attack.desc_2: If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from your target. The effect still works if your attack misses.

moderately_armoured.name: Moderately Armoured
moderately_armoured.desc_1: Moderately Armoured is a passive feature provided by the Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency with Medium Armour and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.
moderately_armoured.desc_2: You gain Proficiency with Medium Armour and Shields, and your  Strength or  Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You must have Light Armour Proficiency before you can take this feat.

monsterslayer.name: Monsterslayer
monsterslayer.desc_1: Monsterslayer is a passive feature that increases attack rolls and your weapon's damage against monsters.
monsterslayer.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional   1d4 damage against Monstrosity type foes.

moonlight_glaive_glowing.name: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing
moonlight_glaive_glowing.desc_1: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that causes this object to glow.
moonlight_glaive_glowing.desc_2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

morphic_ambush.name: Morphic Ambush
morphic_ambush.desc_1: Morphic Ambush is a passive feature available to Dolor, which gives him automatic critical hits against  Ambushed enemies.
morphic_ambush.desc_2: Any successful Attack Roll against a creature that has been Ambushed by a Doppelganger is a Critical Hit.

morphic_evasion.name: Morphic Evasion
morphic_evasion.desc_1: Morphic Evasion is a passive feature that significantly prevents attacks and damage from ambushes.
morphic_evasion.desc_2: Whenever you fail a  Saving throw against an attack from a non-hostile creature, you may succeed instead. If any damage is inflicted from succeeding a Dexterity  Saving throw, the damage is nullified.

mortal_reminder.name: Mortal Reminder
mortal_reminder.desc_1: Mortal Reminder is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that Frightens creatures upon a critical hit.
mortal_reminder.desc_2: When you land a Critical Hit against a creature, that creature and any nearby enemies must succeed a  Wisdom saving throw or become  Frightened until the end of their next turn.

mountain_i.name: Mountain I
mountain_i.desc_1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
mountain_i.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

mountain_ii.name: Mountain II
mountain_ii.desc_1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
mountain_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

mountain_iii.name: Mountain III
mountain_iii.desc_1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
mountain_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

mountain_iv.name: Mountain IV
mountain_iv.desc_1: Mountain is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
mountain_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Mirror Image and  Spike Growth. At higher levels You can cast  Lightning Bolt and  Grant Flight. You can cast  Stoneskin and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Wall of Stone and  Conjure Elemental.

mountainous_poise.name: Mountainous Poise
mountainous_poise.desc_1: Mountainous Poise is a passive feature that increases a monk's defenses
mountainous_poise.desc_2: While using  Patient Defence, you also benefit from the effect of  Blade Ward.

multiattack_cloaker.name: Multiattack (Cloaker)
multiattack_cloaker.desc_1: Multiattack is a passive feature of the Cloaker that lets them attack multiple times if the target is Frightened.
multiattack_cloaker.desc_2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Frightened.

multiattack_giant_eagle.name: Multiattack (Giant Eagle)
multiattack_giant_eagle.desc_1: Multiattack is a passive feature of the Giant Eagle's that lets them attack a target multiple times if it is Prone or Restrained.
multiattack_giant_eagle.desc_2: The giant eagle can  Multiattack if its target is  Prone or  Restrained.

multiattack_defence.name: Multiattack Defence
multiattack_defence.desc_1: Multiattack Defence is a Hunter Ranger passive feature which strengthens its user's defenses against enemies that attack them more than once per turn.
multiattack_defence.desc_2: When a enemy attacks you, they suffer -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until the start of their next turn.

multiattack_bloodlust.name: Multiattack: Bloodlust
multiattack_bloodlust.desc_1: Multiattack: Bloodlust is a passive feature of Redcap's that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if affected by the Bloodlust condition.
multiattack_bloodlust.desc_2: The redcap can make a  Multiattack while under the effects of  Bloodlust.

multiattack_enraged.name: Multiattack: Enraged
multiattack_enraged.desc_1: Multiattack: Enraged is a passive feature of Owlbears that lets them attack multiple times while raging.
multiattack_enraged.desc_2: The owlbear can make a  Multiattack while under the effects of  Owlbear's Rage

multiattack_enwebbed.name: Multiattack: Enwebbed
multiattack_enwebbed.desc_1: Multiattack: Enwebbed is a passive feature that lets creatures Multiattack an  Enwebbed enemy.
multiattack_enwebbed.desc_2: The ettercap can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Enwebbed.

multiattack_frightened.name: Multiattack: Frightened
multiattack_frightened.desc_1: Multiattack: Frightened is a passive feature that lets them attack a Frightened enemy.
multiattack_frightened.desc_2: The Mummy can  Multiattack if the target is  Frightened.

multiattack_last_resort.name: Multiattack: Last Resort
multiattack_last_resort.desc_1: Multiattack: Last Resort is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is  ascended.
multiattack_last_resort.desc_2: Raphael can Multiattack in his Ascended Fiend form if all of his Soul Pillars have been destroyed and he has no Soul Charges.

multiattack_lured.name: Multiattack: Lured
multiattack_lured.desc_1: Multiattack: Lured is a passive feature of the Harpy that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if their targets are  Lured.
multiattack_lured.desc_2: The harpy can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Lured.

multiattack_morphic_ambush.name: Multiattack: Morphic Ambush
multiattack_morphic_ambush.desc_1: Multiattack: Morphic Ambush is a passive feature of Doppelgangers that lets them attack multiple times with one  Action if a target is Ambushed.
multiattack_morphic_ambush.desc_2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Ambushed.

multiattack_muddy.name: Multiattack: Muddy
multiattack_muddy.desc_1: Multiattack: Muddy is a passive feature that allows an Earth Elemental to attack more than once when using their attack action against a muddy enemy.
multiattack_muddy.desc_2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Muddy or is standing in Mud.

multiattack_prone_glut.name: Multiattack: Prone (Glut)
multiattack_prone_glut.desc_1: Multiattack: Prone is a passive feature that allows a creature to attack more than once when attacking an enemy that is Prone.
multiattack_prone_glut.desc_2: Sovereign Glut can use  Multiattack against a target that's  Prone.

multiattack_prone_hook_horror.name: Multiattack: Prone (Hook Horror)
multiattack_prone_hook_horror.desc_1: Multiattack: Prone is a passive feature that allows a Hook Horror to make two attacks against a prone target with a single action.
multiattack_prone_hook_horror.desc_2: The hook horror can make a  Multiattack if the target is  Prone.

multiattack_prone_restrained_or_maimed.name: Multiattack: Prone Restrained or Maimed
multiattack_prone_restrained_or_maimed.desc_1: Multiattack: Prone, Restrained, or Maimed is a passive feature of the Steel Watcher Titan that lets them attack a target multiple times if they have the Prone, Restrained, or Maimed conditions.
multiattack_prone_restrained_or_maimed.desc_2: This Steel Watcher can  Multiattack any  Prone,  Maimed, or  Restrained creature.

multiattack_spores.name: Multiattack: Spores
multiattack_spores.desc_1: Multiattack: Spores is a passive feature that allows a Sovereign Spaw to attack more than once when attacking an enemy that is Prone.
multiattack_spores.desc_2: The sovereign myconid can use  Multiattack against a target that's  Befuddled or under the influence of either  Noxious Fumes or  Haste Spores.

multiattack_static_discharge.name: Multiattack: Static Discharge
multiattack_static_discharge.desc_1: Multiattack: Static Discharge is a passive feature that lets creatures Multiattack a creature that's under a  Static Discharge Aura.
multiattack_static_discharge.desc_2: Benard can  Multiattack while under the effects of his  Static Discharge Aura.

multiattack_wounded_malus_thorm.name: Multiattack: Wounded (Malus Thorm)
multiattack_wounded_malus_thorm.desc_1: Multiattack: Wounded is a passive feature of Malus Thorm that lets him attack twice with a single  Action once he drops to 40% hit points or below.
multiattack_wounded_malus_thorm.desc_2: Malus Thorm can  Multiattack if his hit points are at 40% or less.[Needs Verification]

multiattack_wounded_werewolf.name: Multiattack: Wounded (Werewolf)
multiattack_wounded_werewolf.desc_1: Multiattack: Wounded is a passive feature of a Werewolf that lets them attack multiple times if its target is Prone or hit points are less than 60%.
multiattack_wounded_werewolf.desc_2: Can  Multiattack if the target is  Prone or if its hit points are at 60% or less.

multiattack_wounded_target.name: Multiattack: Wounded Target
multiattack_wounded_target.desc_1: Multiattack: Wounded Target is a passive feature that allows a Drider to attack more than once when using their attack action against a wounded enemy.
multiattack_wounded_target.desc_2: The drider can  Multiattack if its target has fewer than all of its hit points.

multitasking.name: Multitasking
multitasking.desc_1: Multitasking is a passive feature that improves the wearer's ability to hold onto concentrating on a spell.
multitasking.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on  Concentration  Saving throws.

murder_hungry.name: Murder Hungry
murder_hungry.desc_1: Murder Hungry is a passive feature related to the condition  Unstoppable. Each time a creature with this feature kills another creature, they gain another charge of Unstoppable.
murder_hungry.desc_2: Each time you kill a creature, gain 1 charge of Unstoppable.

murderous_sight.name: Murderous Sight
murderous_sight.desc_1: Murderous Sight is a passive feature that lets the wearer see in the dark and move earlier during combat.
murderous_sight.desc_2: You can see in the dark up to  3 m / 10 ft. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to  Initiative.

muscular.name: Muscular
muscular.desc_1: Muscular is a passive feature that grants Advantage when using Athletics.
muscular.desc_2: This creature is very strong. It has  Advantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Athletics.

mystra_s_blessing.name: Mystra's Blessing
mystra_s_blessing.desc_1: Mystra's Blessing is a passive feature which boosts the wielder's  Bless spell.
mystra_s_blessing.desc_2: Creatures you  Bless also gain Mystra's Blessing for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls.

natural_pugilist.name: Natural Pugilist
natural_pugilist.desc_1: Natural Pugilist is a passive feature that increases the user's Unarmed Attack Rolls and damage.
natural_pugilist.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Unarmed Attack rolls and damage.

naturally_stealthy.name: Naturally Stealthy
naturally_stealthy.desc_1: Naturally Stealthy is a passive feature available to all Lightfoot Halflings.
naturally_stealthy.desc_2: Your nimble nature makes you skilled at concealment. You have  Advantage on  Stealth Checks.

nature_s_embrace.name: Nature's Embrace
nature_s_embrace.desc_1: Nature's Embrace is a passive feature that increase's a druid's ability to wild shape.
nature_s_embrace.desc_2: Increase your  Wild Shape Charge by 1. This additional charge is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

nature_s_step.name: Nature's Step
nature_s_step.desc_1: Nature's Step is a Dryad toggleable passive feature. You and your allies near the Dryad are protected from Difficult Terrain and Poison, and can't be Restrained or Paralysed.
nature_s_step.desc_2: Alter the terrain around you, allowing nearby allies in the area to travel with ease. You and your allies within 4 m / 13 ft of range aren't affected by  Difficult Terrain, can't be  Restrained or  Paralysed, and gain Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

nature_s_vengeance.name: Nature's Vengeance
nature_s_vengeance.desc_1: Nature's Vengeance is a passive feature that inflicts extra conditions based on the type of surface the wearer is standing on.
nature_s_vengeance.desc_2: When the wearer stands in certain surfaces and casts a spell that deals damage, the target also suffers the surface's effects. Affected surfaces are  Fire,  Acid,  Caustic Brine, and  Simple Toxin.

nature_s_ward.name: Nature's Ward
nature_s_ward.desc_1: Nature's Ward is a Circle of the Land Druid passive feature that grants immunity to Charm and Frighten effects from elementals and fey creatures. The Druid also becomes immune to Disease and Poison.
nature_s_ward.desc_2: You can't be  Charmed or  Frightened by elementals and fey. Disease and poison also no longer affect you.

necrotic_claws.name: Necrotic Claws
necrotic_claws.desc_1: Necrotic Claws is a passive feature available to Crawling Claws. It allows their attacks to deal an additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage.
necrotic_claws.desc_2: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠Necrotic damage.

needle_burst.name: Needle Burst
needle_burst.desc_1: Needle Burst is a Passive Feature that makes a creature explode on death.
needle_burst.desc_2: Explode in a  Needle Burst upon dying.

night_walker.name: Night Walker
night_walker.desc_1: Night Walker is a passive feature that allows the user freedom of movement without any common restrictions.
night_walker.desc_2: The affected creature cannot be  Enwebbed,  Entangled, or  Ensnared and cannot slip on  Grease or  Ice.

nightsinger_s_reply.name: Nightsinger's Reply
nightsinger_s_reply.desc_1: Nightsinger's Reply is a passive feature that retaliates against enemies that hit the user with a melee attack.
nightsinger_s_reply.desc_2: While Obscured by shadow, the wearer deals 1d4⁠Necrotic to attackers that hit them with a melee attack.

nimble_alchemist.name: Nimble Alchemist
nimble_alchemist.desc_1: Nimble Alchemist is a passive feature only found on Dolor
nimble_alchemist.desc_2: A potions master, Dolor can throw or drink potions as a free action.

nimble_as_a_cat.name: Nimble As a Cat
nimble_as_a_cat.desc_1: Nimble as a Cat is a passive feature that enhances your dexteriy as well as your jump distance.
nimble_as_a_cat.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity  Saving throws and also increase your  Jump distance by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

nimble_attack.name: Nimble Attack
nimble_attack.desc_1: Nimble Attack is a passive feature that increases the movement speed of the user after hitting a target.
nimble_attack.desc_2: When the wielder hits an enemy with this weapon, they gain  Momentum for 2 turns.

nimblefinger.name: Nimblefinger
nimblefinger.desc_1: Nimblefinger is a passive feature that grants bonuses to small size races.
nimblefinger.desc_2: Gnomes are granted +2 to Dexterity. Halflings and Dwarves gain +1 Dexterity.

nyrulna_glowing.name: Nyrulna: Glowing
nyrulna_glowing.desc_1: Nyrulna: Glowing is a toggleable passive feature that controls whether or not this weapon glows with light.
nyrulna_glowing.desc_2: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of  6 m / 20 ft. Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

oath_of_devotion_tenets.name: Oath of Devotion Tenets
oath_of_devotion_tenets.desc_1: Oath of Devotion Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of Devotion paladins must adhere to.
oath_of_devotion_tenets.desc_2: Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets: Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

oath_of_the_ancients_tenets.name: Oath of the Ancients Tenets
oath_of_the_ancients_tenets.desc_1: Oath of the Ancients Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of the Ancients paladins must adhere to.
oath_of_the_ancients_tenets.desc_2: Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets: Shelter the Light. Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren. Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can’t preserve it in the world.  Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

oath_of_the_crown_tenets.name: Oath of the Crown Tenets
oath_of_the_crown_tenets.desc_1: Oath of the Crown Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of the Crown paladins must adhere to.
oath_of_the_crown_tenets.desc_2: Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets: Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

oath_of_vengeance_tenets.name: Oath of Vengeance Tenets
oath_of_vengeance_tenets.desc_1: Oath of Vengeance Tenets is a passive feature that describes the tenets that Oath of Vengeance paladins must adhere to.
oath_of_vengeance_tenets.desc_2: Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets: Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it. No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever. Failure to abide by their tenets will result in a paladin forsaking their Oath, and becoming something very different.

odd_gift.name: Odd Gift
odd_gift.desc_1: Odd Gift is a passive feature that prevents Jaheira from being cursed.
odd_gift.desc_2: While wearing Khalid's Gift, Jaheira cannot be Cursed.

ogre_s_mark.name: Ogre's Mark
ogre_s_mark.desc_1: Ogre's Mark is a passive feature available to Ogres that grants an additional 1d6⁠Bludgeoning damage.

one_with_shadows.name: One with Shadows
one_with_shadows.desc_1: One with Shadows is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to vanish into the darkness and become  Invisible.
one_with_shadows.desc_2: You learn how to cast  One with Shadows.

opportune_predator.name: Opportune Predator
opportune_predator.desc_1: Opportune Predator is a passive feature that allows a displacer beast illusion to pre-emptively attack enemies that move near them.
opportune_predator.desc_2: When an entity enters your attack range, you can strike them.

opportunity_attack.name: Opportunity Attack
opportunity_attack.desc_1: Opportunity Attack or Attack of Opportunity is a common Passive feature /  Reaction. This ability allows a creature to make a melee Attack roll against enemies when they move out of the creature's melee range.
opportunity_attack.desc_2: Automatically attack an enemy moving out of your reach.

order_of_nature.name: Order of Nature
order_of_nature.desc_1: Order of Nature is a passive feature that retaliates against undead and beast creatures that hit the wearer.
order_of_nature.desc_2: Undead creatures that hit the wearer receive 1d6⁠Radiant. Beasts that hit the wearer deal an additional 1d6⁠Radiant.

organ_rearranger.name: Organ Rearranger
organ_rearranger.desc_1: Organ Rearranger is a passive feature that makes its wielder more deadly.
organ_rearranger.desc_2: Reduce the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result.

otherworldly_leap.name: Otherworldly Leap
otherworldly_leap.desc_1: Otherworldly Leap is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows a character to cast the Enhance Leap spell without expending a warlock spell slot. [note 1]
otherworldly_leap.desc_2: You can cast the  Enhance Leap spell without expending a spell slot.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.desc_1: Overcharge is a passive feature that is intended to be used by a construct.
overcharge.desc_2: Chance to  Stun the wielder, unless it is a Construct.

pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack_tactics.desc_1: Pack Tactics is a passive feature that grants Advantage to attacks when an ally is close to the target.
pack_tactics.desc_2: When an ally is within 3 m / 10 ft of your target and is not  Incapacitated, your Attack rolls against the target have  Advantage.

pact_boon.name: Pact Boon
