pact_boon.desc_1: Pact Boon is a passive feature that grants you abilities depending on your choice of Boon.
pact_boon.desc_2: Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. You gain one of the following features of your choice: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form you choose. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit. You can Summon a pact weapon, or Bind the one you are wielding, making it magical. Pact weapons use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity. Your patron grants you a grimoire called 'The Book of Shadows', which allows you to cast several spells.

pact_of_the_blade.name: Pact of the Blade
pact_of_the_blade.actions: Pact of the Blade, Bind Pact Weapon
pact_of_the_blade.desc_1: Pact of the Blade is a Pact Boon granted by the Warlock class. It allows a Warlock to specialise in melee combat by using a special Pact Weapon, granting two actions for this purpose.
pact_of_the_blade.desc_2: You can  Summon a pact weapon, or  Bind the one you are wielding as one, making it magical. Pact weapons use the wielder's Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity. At higher levels At level 5, Warlocks gain  Deepened Pact which grants an  Extra Attack with your pact weapon.

pact_of_the_chain.name: Pact of the Chain
pact_of_the_chain.spells: Find Familiar, Find Familiar: Imp, Find Familiar: Quasit
pact_of_the_chain.desc_1: Pact of the Chain is a Pact Boon from the Warlock class.
pact_of_the_chain.desc_2: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit. At higher levels At level 5, Warlocks gain  Deepened Pact which grants an  Extra Attack to your familiars.

pact_of_the_tome.name: Pact of the Tome
pact_of_the_tome.desc_1: Pact of the Tome is a Pact Boon from the Warlock class. You receive a book that allows you to cast several spells.
pact_of_the_tome.desc_2: Your patron grants you a grimoire called The Book of Shadows"

paragon_of_charisma.name: Paragon of Charisma
paragon_of_charisma.desc_1: Paragon of Charisma is a passive feature unique to the Charismatic Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Charisma Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
paragon_of_charisma.desc_2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Charisma, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Charisma saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

paragon_of_intelligence.name: Paragon of Intelligence
paragon_of_intelligence.desc_1: Paragon of Intelligence is a passive feature unique to the Intelligent Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Intelligence Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
paragon_of_intelligence.desc_2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Intelligence, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Intelligence saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

paragon_of_wisdom.name: Paragon of Wisdom
paragon_of_wisdom.desc_1: Paragon of Wisdom is a passive feature unique to the Wise Sentinel which gives them boosts to their Wisdom Saving Throws and Spell Attack Rolls.
paragon_of_wisdom.desc_2: This Dark Justiciar was anointed by Shar as a sentinel of Wisdom, representing one of her most valued attributes in a follower. They have  Advantage on all  Wisdom saving throws and Spell Attack rolls.

parry.name: Parry
parry.desc_1: Parry is a toggleable passive feature that lets you automatically reduce the damage of the next melee attack.
parry.desc_2: Parry the next melee attack that hits you by 1d8+Dexterity Modifier.

part_of_the_flock.name: Part of the Flock
part_of_the_flock.desc_1: Part of the Flock is a passive feature granted while wearing a Whispering Mask that can turn the wearer into Auntie Ethel's Pawn.

partial_ceremorphosis.name: Partial Ceremorphosis
partial_ceremorphosis.desc_1: Partial Ceremorphosis is a special passive feature gained after consuming the  Astral-Touched Tadpole.
partial_ceremorphosis.desc_2: You are in the early stages of transformation - gaining access to more aberrant powers as you evolve your illithid potential.

perfect_sentry.name: Perfect Sentry
perfect_sentry.desc_1: Perfect Sentry is a passive feature that makes it impossible to be surprised.

performer.name: Performer
performer.desc_1: Performer is a passive feature that grants proficiency with musical instruments.
performer.desc_2: You gain Musical Instrument Proficiency, and your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

permanent_mind_sanctuary.name: Permanent Mind Sanctuary
permanent_mind_sanctuary.desc_1: Permanent Mind Sanctuary is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This passive lets the creature use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.
permanent_mind_sanctuary.desc_2: You can use actions and bonus actions interchangeably.

permanently_armed.name: Permanently Armed
permanently_armed.desc_1: Permanently Armed is a passive feature that prevents the user from being disarmed.

personal_space.name: Personal Space
personal_space.desc_1: Personal Space is a passive feature that improves the wearer's Armor Class after shoving.
personal_space.desc_2: After shoving an enemy, the wearer gains a +1 to their  Armour Class until their next turn.

phalanx_formation.name: Phalanx Formation
phalanx_formation.desc_1: Phalanx Formation is a passive feature that grants bonuses if next to a Shield using ally.
phalanx_formation.desc_2: Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls if within  3 m / 10 ft of an ally that carries a shield and isn't Incapacitated.

poison_trails.name: Poison Trails
poison_trails.desc_1: Poison Trails is a passive feature that boosts the damage of your poison spells.
poison_trails.desc_2: When the wearer casts a spell that deals ⁠Poison damage, it deals an additional 1d4⁠Poison damage.

poisonous_synergy.name: Poisonous Synergy
poisonous_synergy.desc_1: Poisonous Synergy is a passive feature that increases your damage while focusing on a spell.
poisonous_synergy.desc_2: While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Poison.

polearm_master_bonus_attack.name: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack
polearm_master_bonus_attack.desc_1: Polearm Master: Bonus Attack is a passive feature provided by the Polearm Master Feat. When attacking with a polearm, you can make an additional weaker attack with the butt of the polearm using a  Bonus Action.
polearm_master_bonus_attack.desc_2: When attacking with a  Glaive,  Halberd,  Pike,  Quarterstaff, or  Spear, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.

polearm_master_opportunity_attack.name: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack
polearm_master_opportunity_attack.desc_1: Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack is a passive feature provided by the Polearm Master Feat. When an enemy approaches your melee range, you can spend a  Reaction to make an attack.
polearm_master_opportunity_attack.desc_2: When wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can make an  Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range. Prerequisite: Must be wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear.

portent.name: Portent
portent.desc_1: Portent is a Divination School Wizard passive feature which offers the user glimpses into the future. They gain two random Portent Dice which they can use as a  Reaction to substitute into Attack Rolls and Saving Throws rolled in range.
portent.desc_2: Your dreams grant you glimpses that let you influence the future. After each Long Rest, the user gains two random Portent Dice. During the day, they can use their reaction to change the die of an Attack Roll or Saving Throw rolled near them to one of their Portent Dice. Each Portent Die can only be used once; unused Portent Dice are lost at the end of the day.

potent_cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
potent_cantrip.desc_1: Potent Cantrip is an Evocation School Wizard passive feature increases the reliability of your damaging Cantrips such that even a miss hurts your target.
potent_cantrip.desc_2: Your cantrips become harder to evade entirely. When a creature succeeds its  Saving throw against one of your cantrips, it still takes half the cantrip's damage, but suffers no additional effects.

potent_healing.name: Potent Healing
potent_healing.desc_1: Potent Healing is a passive feature that maximises healing.
potent_healing.desc_2: Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum number of possible hit points.

potent_spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
potent_spellcasting.desc_1: Potent Spellcasting is a Light Domain and Knowledge Domain Cleric passive feature that adds the Cleric's Wisdom Modifier to the damage of Cleric Cantrips.
potent_spellcasting.desc_2: Your god grants you even more intense power. You can add your Wisdom Modifier to the damage you deal with Cleric cantrips.

prey_decelerator.name: Prey Decelerator
prey_decelerator.desc_1: Prey Decelerator is a passive feature that slows down targets you critically hit.
prey_decelerator.desc_2: When this weapon lands a Critical Hit, it also  Slows the target creature.

prey_upon_the_weak.name: Prey Upon the Weak
prey_upon_the_weak.desc_1: Prey Upon the Weak is a passive feature that deals more damage to severely injured targets.
prey_upon_the_weak.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Piercing damage against targets with 50% of their hit points or fewer.

prey_s_scent.name: Prey's Scent
prey_s_scent.desc_1: Prey's Scent is a passive feature only found on Beast Master Hunter's  Summon Companion.
prey_s_scent.desc_2: You deal an additional 1d6⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.

prey_s_scent_swarmkeeper.name: Prey's Scent (Swarmkeeper)
prey_s_scent_swarmkeeper.desc_1: Prey's Scent is passive feature available to Swarmkeepers which lets their swarms benefit from  Hunter's Mark.
prey_s_scent_swarmkeeper.desc_2: Your swarm deals additional damage to creatures marked by  Hunter's Mark

primal_strike.name: Primal Strike
primal_strike.desc_1: Primal Strike is a Circle of the Moon Druid passive feature that makes their beast form attacks count as magical damage.
primal_strike.desc_2: While in beast form, your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

prime_aegis_of_fire.name: Prime Aegis of Fire
prime_aegis_of_fire.desc_1: Prime Aegis of Fire is a passive feature that raises your resistances and prevents you from burning.
prime_aegis_of_fire.desc_2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage and cannot be  Burned. You take 3 less damage from all sources.

promised_victory.name: Promised Victory
promised_victory.desc_1: Promised Victory is a passive feature that highlights enemies you hit.
promised_victory.desc_2: On a hit, possibly inflict  Guiding Bolt upon the target.

propelling_strike.name: Propelling Strike
propelling_strike.desc_1: Propelling Strike is a passive feature which pushes targets  4.5 m / 15 ft away on a hit.
propelling_strike.desc_2: On a hit, push the target  4.5 m / 15 ft away from you.

protection.name: Protection
protection.desc_1: Protection is a Fighting Style reaction/passive feature. Users can interfere with an enemy targetting one of your nearby allies.
protection.desc_2: When you have a Shield, impose  Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within  1.5 m / 5 ft. You must be able to see the enemy.

psionic_backlash.name: Psionic Backlash
psionic_backlash.desc_1: Psionic Backlash is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to, when a nearby enemy casts a spell, use their  Reaction to deal 1d4⁠Psychic damage for every level of that spell.
psionic_backlash.desc_2: When a nearby enemy casts a spell, you use your reaction to deal 1d4⁠Psychic damage for every level of that spell.

psionic_dominance.name: Psionic Dominance
psionic_dominance.desc_1: Psionic Dominance is a passive feature and Illithid Power. This feature allows a character to use a reaction to nullify a spell of lower or equal level to their Proficiency Bonus when targeted by an enemy within 18m.
psionic_dominance.desc_2: When an enemy within  18 m / 60 ft targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you can use your reaction to nullify the spell.

psionic_empowerment.name: Psionic Empowerment
psionic_empowerment.desc_1: Psionic Empowerment is a passive feature that grants an extra 1d6 Psychic damage on attacks.
psionic_empowerment.desc_2: Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

psionic_retribution.name: Psionic Retribution
psionic_retribution.desc_1: Psionic Retribution is a toggleable passive feature available to the Netherbrain that lets it release a  Retributive Brainquake as a reaction to taking damage.
psionic_retribution.desc_2: The Netherbrain permits no interference - as a reaction to taking damage, it releases Brainquakes.

psionic_revenge.name: Psionic Revenge
psionic_revenge.desc_1: Psionic Revenge is a passive feature that retaliates against an enemy that made the wearer make a saving throw.
psionic_revenge.desc_2: When you succeed a  Saving throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4⁠Psychic. Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

psionic_skin.name: Psionic Skin
psionic_skin.desc_1: Psionic Skin is a passive feature that automatically removes all conditions.
psionic_skin.desc_2: Removes all conditions at the start of its turns.

psionic_ward.name: Psionic Ward
psionic_ward.desc_1: Psionic Ward is a passive feature that protects its user by dealing psychic damage and healing.
psionic_ward.desc_2: If the item detects that the wearer is gith, they have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage. Whenever the wearer succeeds on a  Saving throw against a spell, they regain 1d4⁠hit points.

psychic_leech.name: Psychic Leech
psychic_leech.desc_1: Psychic Leech is a passive feature that heals the wearer whenever an enemy succumbs to one of your spells targetting their mind.
psychic_leech.desc_2: When an enemy fails a  Charisma,  Intelligence, or  Wisdom  Saving throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4⁠hit points.

psychic_missiles.name: Psychic Missiles
psychic_missiles.desc_1: Psychic Missiles is a passive feature that enhances magic missile.
psychic_missiles.desc_2: Shoot an additional dart whenever you cast  Magic Missile.

psychic_steel_virtuoso.name: Psychic Steel Virtuoso
psychic_steel_virtuoso.desc_1: Psychic Steel Virtuoso is a passive feature that increases damage if you attack with advantage.
psychic_steel_virtuoso.desc_2: When the wielder attacks with  Advantage, they deal an additional 1d8⁠Psychic.

purity_of_body.name: Purity of Body
purity_of_body.desc_1: Purity of Body is a Monk passive feature that gives immunity to ⁠Poison damage and to being  Poisoned, and makes disease have no effect.
purity_of_body.desc_2: You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

quickened_mage_hand.name: Quickened Mage Hand
quickened_mage_hand.desc_1: Quickened Mage Hand is a passive feature that modifies the cantrip Mage Hand to cost a bonus action instead of a regular action.
quickened_mage_hand.desc_2: You can cast  Mage Hand as a  Bonus Action.

quickspell_flinger.name: Quickspell Flinger
quickspell_flinger.desc_1: Quickspell Flinger is a toggleable passive feature that allows the wearer to cast a cantrip as a bonus action.
quickspell_flinger.desc_2: Cantrips that cost an  Action cost a  Bonus Action instead. This effect can be used once per Short Rest.

radiant_strike.name: Radiant Strike
radiant_strike.desc_1: Radiant Strike is a passive feature that lights up enemies struck with this weapon.
radiant_strike.desc_2: On a hit, inflict 1 turn of  Radiating Orb upon the target.

radiating_orb_gloves.name: Radiating Orb Gloves
radiating_orb_gloves.desc_1: Radiating Orb Gloves is a passive feature that surrounds targets with globes of light every time the user deals radiant damage to them.
radiating_orb_gloves.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Radiant damage, the target receives 2 turn of  Radiating Orb.

radiating_shockwave.name: Radiating Shockwave
radiating_shockwave.desc_1: Radiating Shockwave is a passive feature that causes small explosions when dealing radiant damage.
radiating_shockwave.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Radiant damage, they cause a  Radiant Shockwave.

rage_becomes_frenzy.name: Rage Becomes Frenzy
rage_becomes_frenzy.actions: Frenzy, Frenzied Strike, Enraged Throw, Improvised Melee Weapon (Bonus Action)
rage_becomes_frenzy.desc_1: Rage Becomes Frenzy is a passive feature that changes Rage into Frenzy.
rage_becomes_frenzy.desc_2: Your bloodthirst transforms your rage, making it stronger.

rakish_audacity.name: Rakish Audacity
rakish_audacity.desc_1: Rakish Audacity is a passive feature available to Swashbuckler rogues which grants a scaling bonus to initiative and relaxes some of the requirements for triggering Sneak Attack.
rakish_audacity.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls. This scales with your rogue level. You no longer need  Advantage to trigger Sneak Attack as long as you are within 1.5 m / 5 ft of the target and don't have  Disadvantage.[See: Bugs] At higher levels

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc_1: Rampage is a passive feature available to some Gnolls that gives them the ability to quickly move and bite a foe after downing a creature.
rampage.desc_2: When a Gnoll  Downs a creature with a melee attack, the gnoll can use a Bonus Action to move up to half its Movement Speed and make a bite attack.

ranger_knight.name: Ranger Knight
ranger_knight.desc_1: Ranger Knight is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency with History and Heavy Armour as a result of your history with nations.
ranger_knight.desc_2: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain Proficiency with History and Proficiency with Heavy Armour.

rapid_caster.name: Rapid Caster
rapid_caster.desc_1: Rapid Caster is a passive feature that grants bonuses to spellcasting every time the wearer dashes.
rapid_caster.desc_2: Each time they  Dash, the wearer gains  Arcane Charge for 2 turns.

rat_catcher.name: Rat Catcher
rat_catcher.desc_1: Rat Catcher is a passive feature that makes this weapon adept at killing beasts.
rat_catcher.desc_2: Attack Rolls against beasts have  Advantage.

raven_sight.name: Raven Sight
raven_sight.desc_1: Raven Sight is a passive feature gained by the  Dire Raven Companion at level 11 that makes them immune to being blinded.

reaper.name: Reaper
reaper.desc_1: Reaper is a Death Domain cleric passive feature that allows the cleric to target two creatures with Necromancy cantrips.
reaper.desc_2: Your Necromancy cantrips that only target 1 creature can target an additional creature.

reaper_s_rigidity.name: Reaper's Rigidity
reaper_s_rigidity.desc_1: Reaper's Rigidity is a toggleable passive feature that controls whether or not you can be moved against your will by any spell or action.
reaper_s_rigidity.desc_2: When activated, you can't be moved against your will by any spell or action, but have  Disadvantage on Dexterity  Saving throws.

rebuke_of_the_mighty.name: Rebuke of the Mighty
rebuke_of_the_mighty.desc_1: Rebuke of the Mighty is a passive feature that allows you to strike back at an enemy that hits you, dealing ⁠Force damage and knocking them  Prone.
rebuke_of_the_mighty.desc_2: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction, dealing 2d4⁠Force damage and knock it  Prone unless they succeed a  Dexterity saving throw.

redirect_attack.name: Redirect Attack
redirect_attack.desc_1: Redirect Attack is a Way of the Drunken Master monk reaction/passive feature that allows the monk to make an unarmed attack against the attacker.
redirect_attack.desc_2: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can spend 1  Ki Point as a reaction to make an unarmed attack against the attacker.

redvein_savagery.name: Redvein Savagery
redvein_savagery.desc_1: Redvein Savagery is a passive feature that deals more damage to targets.
redvein_savagery.desc_2: When you make an attack with  Advantage, the target takes an additional 7⁠PiercingDRS damage.

refined_vaulting_monster_slayer_glaive.name: Refined Vaulting (Monster Slayer Glaive)
refined_vaulting_monster_slayer_glaive.desc_1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
refined_vaulting_monster_slayer_glaive.desc_2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

refined_vaulting_bonespike_boots.name: Refined Vaulting (Bonespike Boots)
refined_vaulting_bonespike_boots.desc_1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
refined_vaulting_bonespike_boots.desc_2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

refined_vaulting_swiresy_shoes.name: Refined Vaulting (Swiresy Shoes)
refined_vaulting_swiresy_shoes.desc_1: Refined Vaulting is a passive feature that increases your jump distance.
refined_vaulting_swiresy_shoes.desc_2: Jump distance is increased by  1.5 m / 5 ft.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.desc_1: Regeneration is a toggleable passive feature that helps the Wood Woad regain HP.
regeneration.desc_2: The wood woad regains 10 hit points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.

relentless_avenger.name: Relentless Avenger
relentless_avenger.desc_1: Relentless Avenger is an Oath of Vengeance Paladin passive feature. This ability allows a Paladin to pursue fleeing enemies.
relentless_avenger.desc_2: If you hit an enemy with an Opportunity Attack, your movement speed increases by 4.5 m / 15 ft on your next turn.

relentless_endurance.name: Relentless Endurance
relentless_endurance.desc_1: Relentless Endurance is a passive feature available to Half-Orc characters. Once per Long Rest, when they are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, they can drop to 1 Hit Point instead.
relentless_endurance.desc_2: If you reach 0 hit points, you regain 1⁠hit points instead of becoming  Downed.

relentless_rage.name: Relentless Rage
relentless_rage.desc_1: Relentless Rage is a Barbarian passive feature. While raging, the barbarian is harder to defeat.
relentless_rage.desc_2: Once per Short Rest, if you drop to 0 hit points while  Enraged, you regain 1⁠hit points instead of being  Downed.

relentless_revenge.name: Relentless Revenge
relentless_revenge.desc_1: Relentless Revenge is a passive feature that increases the wielder's damage whenever they are severely injured.
relentless_revenge.desc_2: When the wielder has 50%  hit points or less, they deal an additional 1d4⁠Slashing damage.

reliable_talent.name: Reliable Talent
reliable_talent.desc_1: Reliable Talent is a passive feature gained by Rogues at level 11. It treats any roll under 10 as a 10.
reliable_talent.desc_2: When you make an Ability Check with a Skill you are Proficient with, the lowest result you can roll on the die is 10.

remarkable_athlete_jump.name: Remarkable Athlete: Jump
remarkable_athlete_jump.desc_1: Remarkable Athlete: Jump is a Champion Fighter passive feature that increases their jump distance by  3 m / 10 ft.
remarkable_athlete_jump.desc_2: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. Your Jump distance is increased by  3 m / 10 ft.

remarkable_athlete_proficiency.name: Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency
remarkable_athlete_proficiency.desc_1: Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency is a Champion Fighter passive feature that adds half of their Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks they are not Proficient in.
remarkable_athlete_proficiency.desc_2: You're a master of your own body, your athletic prowess extended beyond the usual. You can add half of your Proficiency Bonus to any Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Checks that you are not Proficient in.

remedial_rhymes.name: Remedial Rhymes
remedial_rhymes.desc_1: Remedial Rhymes is a passive feature that grants a bit of extra health when you inspire an ally.
remedial_rhymes.desc_2: When you inspire an ally using  Bardic Inspiration, you gain  4 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

rend_with_white_lightning.name: Rend With White Lightning
rend_with_white_lightning.desc_1: This passive feature empowers its user with extra lightning damage.
rend_with_white_lightning.desc_2: Successful weapon attacks deal an additional 1d8⁠Lightning.

repelling_blast.name: Repelling Blast
repelling_blast.desc_1: Repelling Blast is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to push creatures around with Eldritch Blast
repelling_blast.desc_2: When you hit a creature with  Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to  4.5 m / 15 ft away from you.

resilient_charisma.name: Resilient: Charisma
resilient_charisma.desc_1: Resilient: Charisma is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Charisma and can add your proficiency bonus to your Charisma Saving Throws.

resilient_constitution.name: Resilient: Constitution
resilient_constitution.desc_1: Resilient: Constitution is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Constitution and can add your proficiency bonus to your Constitution Saving Throws.

resilient_dexterity.name: Resilient: Dexterity
resilient_dexterity.desc_1: Resilient: Dexterity is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Dexterity and can add your proficiency bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws.

resilient_intelligence.name: Resilient: Intelligence
resilient_intelligence.desc_1: Resilient: Intelligence is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Intelligence and can add your proficiency bonus to your Intelligence Saving Throws.

resilient_strength.name: Resilient: Strength
resilient_strength.desc_1: Resilient: Strength is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Strength and can add your proficiency bonus to your Strength Saving Throws.

resilient_wisdom.name: Resilient: Wisdom
resilient_wisdom.desc_1: Resilient: Wisdom is a passive feature provided by the Resilient Feat. You gain a +1 to your Wisdom and can add your proficiency bonus to your Wisdom Saving Throws.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.desc_1: Retaliation is a passive feature that allows the creature being attacked to immediately strike back.
retaliation.desc_2: Strike back at the next enemy that attacks you.

revenant_scourge.name: Revenant Scourge
revenant_scourge.desc_1: Revenant Scourge is a passive feature that grants a bonus to attacks and damage on undead creatures.
revenant_scourge.desc_2: When used against undead creatures this weapon has +1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

revenant_s_ire.name: Revenant's Ire
revenant_s_ire.desc_1: Revenant's Ire is a passive feature that increases the damage of their weapon attacks.
revenant_s_ire.desc_2: This profane entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 4d8⁠Necrotic damage.

ring_of_veracity.name: Ring of Veracity
ring_of_veracity.desc_1: Ring of Veracity is a passive feature that helps the wearer discern lies.
ring_of_veracity.desc_2: You gain an  Advantage on Insight Checks.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc_1: Riposte is a Battle Master Fighter passive feature and reaction. This ability allows the Battle Master to counterattack with their melee weapon when an enemy misses them with a melee attack.
riposte.desc_2: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional  Superiority Die damage.

risky_attack.name: Risky Attack
risky_attack.desc_1: Risky Attack is a passive feature that trades disadvantage on saving throws for advantage on attack rolls.
risky_attack.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on Attack rolls and receive  Disadvantage on  Saving throws.

ritual_caster_free_spells.name: Ritual Caster: Free Spells
ritual_caster_free_spells.desc_1: Ritual Caster: Free Spells is a passive feature provided by the Ritual Caster Feat. You learn 2 Ritual spells, which you can cast at any time outside of combat.
ritual_caster_free_spells.desc_2: You learn two  Ritual Spells of your choice from the following:

ruintamer_heart.name: Ruintamer Heart
ruintamer_heart.desc_1: Ruintamer Heart is a passive feature that enhances your rage.
ruintamer_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, the wearer generates 2 turns of  Wrath.[See: Bugs]

running_jump.name: Running Jump
running_jump.desc_1: Running Jump is a passive feature that lets the user jump for free after they dash.
running_jump.desc_2: Once per turn, after the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action, they can  Jump without using a  Bonus Action.

rupturing.name: Rupturing
rupturing.desc_1: Rupturing is a passive feature that causes a target to take damage whenever they move.
rupturing.desc_2: On a hit, the target becomes  Ruptured for 3 turns.

sanctified_stalker.name: Sanctified Stalker
sanctified_stalker.desc_1: Sanctified Stalker is a Ranger passive feature of Favoured Enemy. You gain proficiency with Religion and can cast  Sacred Flame as a result of your religious training.
sanctified_stalker.desc_2: You swore to hunt the enemies of a holy or druidic order. You gain Proficiency in Religion and can cast  Sacred Flame.

sanctified_weapon.name: Sanctified Weapon
sanctified_weapon.desc_1: Sanctified Weapon is a passive feature that causes undead creatures to flee.
sanctified_weapon.desc_2: Undead creatures struck by this weapon are possibly  Turned.

savage_attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage_attacker.desc_1: Savage Attacker is a passive feature provided by the feat of the same name. Your attacks become more fierce, and you deal damage at a higher level than usual when dealing melee weapon damage.
savage_attacker.desc_2: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.

savage_attacks.name: Savage Attacks
savage_attacks.desc_1: Savage Attacks is a passive feature available to half-orcs. When they score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, they can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
savage_attacks.desc_2: When you land a Critical Hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal an extra dice of weapon damage.

saviour_s_allure.name: Saviour's Allure
saviour_s_allure.desc_1: Saviour's Allure is a passive feature that increases the wearer's healing.
saviour_s_allure.desc_2: You restore an additional 2⁠hit points every time you heal another creature.

scar_of_dark_thirst.name: Scar of Dark Thirst
scar_of_dark_thirst.desc_1: Scar of Dark Thirst is a passive feature that applies bleeding on hit if character is below %90 HP.
scar_of_dark_thirst.desc_2: This character's attacks may apply Bleeding if its HP are less than 90%.

scar_of_fury.name: Scar of Fury
scar_of_fury.desc_1: Scar of Fury is a passive feature that grants a creature a Critical Hit when their health is below 40%.
scar_of_fury.desc_2: Score a Critical Hit when you health is lower than 40%.

scar_of_mirages.name: Scar of Mirages
scar_of_mirages.desc_1: Scar of Mirages is a passive feature that may apply  Confused to their attacks.
scar_of_mirages.desc_2: This character's attacks may apply Confused if its hit points are less than 90%.

scar_of_the_agave.name: Scar of the Agave
scar_of_the_agave.desc_1: Scar of the Agave is a passive feature found only on Gur clerics.
scar_of_the_agave.desc_2: When this character is struck by a melee attack while at less than 60% of their hit points, the attacker takes 2d8⁠Piercing damage.

scar_of_the_dunes.name: Scar of the Dunes
scar_of_the_dunes.desc_1: Scar of the Dunes is a passive feature found only on Tactician difficulty.
scar_of_the_dunes.desc_2: This character's movement speed is doubled and it cannot be targeted by attacks of opportunity, if its hit points are lower than 90%.

scar_of_the_sand_eclipse.name: Scar of the Sand Eclipse
scar_of_the_sand_eclipse.desc_1: Scar of the Sand Eclipse is a passive feature that grants attacks an extra 4d8 slashing damage when a creatures Hit Points are at 20% or lower.
scar_of_the_sand_eclipse.desc_2: Your attacks deal an additional 4d8⁠Slashing damage when your hit points are at 20% or lower.

scar_of_the_sirocco.name: Scar of the Sirocco
scar_of_the_sirocco.desc_1: Scar of the Sirocco is a passive feature grants a character's attack the potential to apply Prone when their Hit Points are less than 90%.
scar_of_the_sirocco.desc_2: This character's attacks may apply Prone if its hit points are less that 90%.

scarlet_remittance.name: Scarlet Remittance
scarlet_remittance.desc_1: Scarlet Remittance is a passive feature that increases your attack potency.
scarlet_remittance.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe you slay, up to a maximum of +3.

scenting_blood.name: Scenting Blood
scenting_blood.desc_1: Scenting Blood is a Sahuagin passive feature. This ability triggers the sahuagin to become Blood Frenzied when it sees blood.
scenting_blood.desc_2: If the sahuagin sees a wounded creature, it becomes  Blood Frenzied.

scintillating.name: Scintillating
scintillating.desc_1: Scintillating is a passive feature that grants bonuses to Charisma abilities.
scintillating.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma  Ability checks and  Saving throws.

scourge_of_pests.name: Scourge of Pests
scourge_of_pests.desc_1: Scourge of Pests is a passive feature found on the  Exterminator's Axe.
scourge_of_pests.desc_2: Deals an additional 1d6⁠Fire damage to Plants, Myconids[See: Bugs], and Small creatures.

sculpt_spells.name: Sculpt Spells
sculpt_spells.desc_1: Sculpt Spells is an Evocation School passive feature prevents your allies from taking damage from some of your spells.
sculpt_spells.desc_2: Create pockets of safety within your Evocation spells. Allies automatically succeed their  Saving throws against these spells and take no damage from them.

sculptor_of_flesh.name: Sculptor of Flesh
sculptor_of_flesh.desc_1: Sculptor of Flesh is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Polymorph.
sculptor_of_flesh.desc_2: You can cast  Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.

second_story_work.name: Second-Story Work
second_story_work.desc_1: Second-Story Work is a Thief Rogue passive feature that grants Resistance against falling damage.
second_story_work.desc_2: You've mastered the art of falling and gain Resistance to Falling damage.

seeking_blood.name: Seeking Blood
seeking_blood.desc_1: Seeking Blood is a passive feature that makes the wearer more likely to hit a damaged target.
seeking_blood.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

seeking_spell.name: Seeking Spell
seeking_spell.desc_1: Seeking Spell is a toggleable passive feature that grants the ability to use a sorcery point to get advantage on a spell attack roll.
seeking_spell.desc_2: When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you can spend a  Sorcery Point to gain  Advantage. This costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot Level. Cantrips cost 1 Sorcery Point.

seldom_caught_unawares_bow_of_awareness.name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Bow of Awareness)
seldom_caught_unawares_bow_of_awareness.desc_1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
seldom_caught_unawares_bow_of_awareness.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

seldom_caught_unawares_fistbreaker_helm.name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Fistbreaker Helm)
seldom_caught_unawares_fistbreaker_helm.desc_1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
seldom_caught_unawares_fistbreaker_helm.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

seldom_caught_unawares_stalker_gloves.name: Seldom Caught Unawares (Stalker Gloves)
seldom_caught_unawares_stalker_gloves.desc_1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
seldom_caught_unawares_stalker_gloves.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

seldom_caught_unawares_2.name: Seldom Caught Unawares (+2)
seldom_caught_unawares_2.desc_1: Seldom Caught Unawares is a passive feature that grants a bonus to initiative rolls.
seldom_caught_unawares_2.desc_2: You gain a +2 bonus to  Initiative rolls.

sel_ne_s_blessing.name: Selûne's Blessing
sel_ne_s_blessing.desc_1: Selûne's Blessing is a passive feature that grants the wielder enhanced wisdom and eyesight.
sel_ne_s_blessing.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on Wisdom  Saving throws and Perception Checks.

sel_ne_s_ire.name: Selûne's Ire
sel_ne_s_ire.desc_1: Selûne's Ire is a passive feature available to Moonlight Slivers, that lets them immediately deal Radiant damage to an attacker with  Selûne's Ire.
sel_ne_s_ire.desc_2: The Sliver can immediately deal 12d12⁠Radiant damage to an attacker. It can use Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.

sel_ne_s_protection.name: Selûne's Protection
sel_ne_s_protection.desc_1: Selûne's Protection is a passive feature that increases your defenses against spells.
sel_ne_s_protection.desc_2: While the wearer has  Mage Armour, each successful  Saving throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1-4⁠Radiant damage.

semblance_of_fey.name: Semblance of Fey
semblance_of_fey.desc_1: Semblance of Fey is a passive feature that increases the wearer's defenses against attacks against their mind.
semblance_of_fey.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma  Saving throws.

sentinel_weapon.name: Sentinel Weapon
sentinel_weapon.desc_1: Sentinel Weapon is a passive feature that lets the wielder move earlier and pay closer attention to their surroundings.
sentinel_weapon.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls and  Advantage on Perception Ability Checks.

sentinel_opportunity_advantage.name: Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage
sentinel_opportunity_advantage.desc_1: Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature gain  Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
sentinel_opportunity_advantage.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.

sentinel_snare.name: Sentinel: Snare
sentinel_snare.desc_1: Sentinel: Snare is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature are able to stop enemies in their tracks if you hit them with an Opportunity Attack.
sentinel_snare.desc_2: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.

sentinel_vengeance.name: Sentinel: Vengeance
sentinel_vengeance.desc_1: Sentintel: Vengeance is a passive feature obtainable by the Sentinel Feat. Users of this feature can attack enemies who attacks an ally within your melee range.
sentinel_vengeance.desc_2: When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.

shadeclinger.name: Shadeclinger
shadeclinger.desc_1: Shadeclinger is a passive feature that improves survivability while in shadow.
shadeclinger.desc_2: While Obscured, the wearer has  Advantage on  Saving throws.

shadespell.name: Shadespell
shadespell.desc_1: Shadespell is a passive feature that enhances your spells while in shadow.
shadespell.desc_2: While the wearer is obscured in shadow, their spells gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC, making them more likely to succeed.

shadow_ambush.name: Shadow Ambush
shadow_ambush.desc_1: Shadow Ambush is a passive feature that allows this creature to deal 4d8⁠Necrotic damage when attacking from the shadows.
shadow_ambush.desc_2: This creature deals an additional 4d8⁠Necrotic damage when attacking from the shadows.

shadow_blade.name: Shadow Blade
shadow_blade.desc_1: Shadow Blade is a passive feature that makes it easier to hit a target in shadow.
shadow_blade.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Attack rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade.

shadow_stealth.name: Shadow Stealth
shadow_stealth.desc_1: Shadow Stealth is a passive feature that allows its user to avoid  Opportunity Attacks when obscured.
shadow_stealth.desc_2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature does not provoke opportunity attacks when they move away from a foe.

shadow_veil.name: Shadow Veil
shadow_veil.desc_1: Shadow Veil is a Shadow Mastiff passive feature granting  Shadow Veil while obscured.
shadow_veil.desc_2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, the shadow mastiff is Resistant to non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.

shadow_blinding.name: Shadow-Blinding
shadow_blinding.desc_1: Shadow-Blinding is a passive feature that lets you blind your target.
shadow_blinding.desc_2: If you attack with  Advantage, you have a chance to  Blind your target.[See: Bugs]

shadowblend.name: Shadowblend
shadowblend.desc_1: Shadowblend is a passive feature that allows the user to automatically become Invisible while obscured by darkness.
shadowblend.desc_2: While Lightly or Heavily Obscured, this creature gains the ability to blend with shadows and become  Invisible.

shadowthief.name: Shadowthief
shadowthief.desc_1: Shadowthief is a passive feature that grants extra damage against obscured targets.
shadowthief.desc_2: The wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional   1d4 damage against  Lightly or  Heavily Obscured creatures, and creatures made of shadow.

shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
shapechanger.desc_1: Shapechanger lets a Transmutation wizard transform into a Blue Jay at will.
shapechanger.desc_2: You can cast the  Polymorph spell without expending a spell slot.

shapeshifter_slayer.name: Shapeshifter Slayer
shapeshifter_slayer.desc_1: Shapeshifter Slayer is a passive feature that increases damage against shapeshifted creatures.
shapeshifter_slayer.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional   1d4 damage against shapeshifters or polymorphed creatures.

shapeshifter_s_boon.name: Shapeshifter's Boon
shapeshifter_s_boon.desc_1: Shapeshifter's Boon is a passive feature granted by  Shapeshifter's Boon Ring.
shapeshifter_s_boon.desc_2: While shapeshifting or disguising yourself, gain a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability checks.

shar_s_blessing.name: Shar's Blessing
shar_s_blessing.desc_1: Shar's Blessing is a special passive feature granted to this weapon.
shar_s_blessing.desc_2: If Shar allows it, use this spear to kill Nightsong.

shar_s_blessing_shar_s_spear_of_evening.name: Shar's Blessing (Shar's Spear of Evening)
shar_s_blessing_shar_s_spear_of_evening.desc_1: Shar's Blessing is a passive feature that protects the wielder from all harmful effects while obscured.
shar_s_blessing_shar_s_spear_of_evening.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws while Lightly or Heavily Obscured. This weapon deals an additional 1d6 damage to creatures that are Lightly or Heavily Obscured.

shar_s_protection.name: Shar's Protection
shar_s_protection.desc_1: Shar's Protection is a passive feature that further enhances Shield of Faith.
shar_s_protection.desc_2: While the wearer has  Shield of Faith active, reduce all incoming damage by 2 and reflect damage received back at the attacker, who takes 1d4⁠Necrotic.

shar_s_rules.name: Shar's Rules
shar_s_rules.desc_1: Shar's Rules is a passive feature that reduces Ability Scores by 1 if player attacks different reflection.
shar_s_rules.desc_2: Damaging a Reflection that is not your own causes Shar to intervene, reducing all Ability Scores by 1 until your next Long Rest. This reduction can stack up to 4 times.

shar_s_sight.name: Shar's Sight
shar_s_sight.desc_1: Shar's Sight is a passive feature that grants immunity to Blinded.

shar_s_umbrae.name: Shar's Umbrae
shar_s_umbrae.desc_1: Shar's Umbrae is a passive feature that helps the wearer stay undetected.
shar_s_umbrae.desc_2: While obscured, the wearer has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

sharp_caster.name: Sharp Caster
sharp_caster.desc_1: Sharp Caster is a passive feature that rerolls low damage die, once.
sharp_caster.desc_2: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die(s) for a Spell Attack, that die(s) is rerolled once.

sharpened_snare.name: Sharpened Snare
sharpened_snare.desc_1: Sharpened Snare is a passive feature that makes enemies more susceptible to damage.
sharpened_snare.desc_2: Creatures have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws when resisting your attacks and spells that inflict  Restrained.

sharpshooter_all_in.name: Sharpshooter: All In
sharpshooter_all_in.desc_1: Sharpshooter: All In is a toggleable passive feature obtainable by the Sharpshooter Feat. Users of this feature are able to deal great damage at the cost of accuracy.
sharpshooter_all_in.desc_2: Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.

sharpshooter_low_ground.name: Sharpshooter: Low Ground
sharpshooter_low_ground.desc_1: Sharpshooter: Low Ground is a passive feature obtainable by the Sharpshooter Feat. Users of this feature don't receive any penalty when attacking from below their target.
sharpshooter_low_ground.desc_2: Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.

sharran_veil.name: Sharran Veil
sharran_veil.desc_1: Sharran Veil is a passive feature that enhances one of your existing spells.
sharran_veil.desc_2: Shield of Faith also grants you a +2 to all  Saving throws.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.desc_1: Shelter is a passive feature that increases defenses against being charmed.
shelter.desc_2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against  Charmed.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.desc_1: Shield Bash is a passive feature granted by many Shields that allows you to strike back at an enemy that hits you, knocking them  Prone.
shield_bash.desc_2: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it  Prone unless they succeed a  Dexterity saving throw.

shield_conduit.name: Shield Conduit
shield_conduit.desc_1: Shield Conduit is a passive feature that reduces physical damage taken.
shield_conduit.desc_2: The shield shrouds the wearer with  Force Conduit at the start of its turn in combat.

shield_master.name: Shield Master
shield_master.desc_1: Shield Master is a passive feature obtainable by the Shield Master Feat. Users of this feature gain bonuses to their  Dexterity saving throw while wielding a Shield.
shield_master.desc_2: Gain a +2 bonus to  Dexterity  Saving throws when wielding a Shield.

shield_master_block.name: Shield Master: Block
shield_master_block.desc_2: If a spell forces you to make a  Dexterity saving throw, you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage. Properties Technical details

shocking_sting.name: Shocking Sting
shocking_sting.desc_1: Shocking Sting is a passive feature that lets the weapon shock your target.
shocking_sting.desc_2: On a hit, possibly  Shock[See: Bugs] your target.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc_1: Shockwave is a toggleable passive feature that causes a shockwave after you jump.
shockwave.desc_2: When the wearer  Jumps, they deal 1d4⁠Thunder damage in a  3 m / 10 ft radius upon landing.

shoe_slinger.name: Shoe Slinger
shoe_slinger.desc_1: Shoe Slinger is a passive feature that allows the shoes to be thrown at an enemy.
shoe_slinger.desc_2: Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4⁠Psychic damage.

shortened_stride.name: Shortened Stride
shortened_stride.desc_1: Shortened Stride is a passive feature that shortens a creature's movement speed.
shortened_stride.desc_2: Your movement speed is  7.5 m / 25 ft.

shunt_through_space.name: Shunt Through Space
shunt_through_space.desc_1: Shunt Through Space is a passive feature unique to Ptaris that lets him teleport after being damaged.
shunt_through_space.desc_2: Using a  Reaction after being damaged, Ptaris teleports as far as he can from the attacker.

sign_of_ill_omen.name: Sign of Ill Omen
sign_of_ill_omen.desc_1: Sign of Ill Omen is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You learn how to cast Bestow Curse.
sign_of_ill_omen.desc_2: You can cast  Bestow Curse with a Warlock Spell Slot.

silent.name: Silent
silent.desc_1: Silent is a Passive Feature that prevent a creature from casting spells.
silent.desc_2: This creature can't speak or cast spells that have a verbal component

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.desc_1: Skilled is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.
skilled.desc_2: You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.

skinburster_force.name: Skinburster Force
skinburster_force.desc_1: Skinburster Force is a passive feature.
skinburster_force.desc_2: When the wielder deals melee damage with this weapon, they gain 2 turns of  Force Conduit.

skittish.name: Skittish
skittish.desc_1: Skittish is a passive feature of Owlbear Cubs that lets them flee for 2 turns when badly injured
skittish.desc_2: Will flee for 2 turns when badly hurt.

skullduggery_attack.name: Skullduggery Attack
skullduggery_attack.desc_1: Skullduggery Attack is a passive feature that adds force damage to a rogue's sneak attack.
skullduggery_attack.desc_2: Your  Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d4⁠ForceDRS damage.

slabjaw_determination.name: Slabjaw Determination
slabjaw_determination.desc_1: Slabjaw Determination is a passive feature that increases your health while you rage.
slabjaw_determination.desc_2: You gain  15 temporary hit points whenever you  Rage.

slay_the_wicked.name: Slay the Wicked
slay_the_wicked.desc_1: Slay the Wicked is a passive feature that increases damage against Fiends and Undead.
slay_the_wicked.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead.

slay_the_wicked_bludgeoning.name: Slay the Wicked (Bludgeoning)
slay_the_wicked_bludgeoning.desc_1: Slay the Wicked is a passive feature that increases damage against Fiends and Undead.
slay_the_wicked_bludgeoning.desc_2: This weapon deals an additional 1d6⁠Bludgeoning damage against Fiends and Undead.

slayer_knowledge.name: Slayer Knowledge
slayer_knowledge.desc_1: Slayer Knowledge is a special passive feature granted to you by a book from Volo.
slayer_knowledge.desc_2: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Frightened by a Bhaalspawn Slayer - the tome Volo found was very informative.

slayer_s_extra_attack.name: Slayer's Extra Attack
slayer_s_extra_attack.desc_1: Slayer's Extra Attack is a passive feature available to the Slayer, granting it two additional attacks.
slayer_s_extra_attack.desc_2: You can make one additional attack after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

slayer_s_improved_extra_attack.name: Slayer's Improved Extra Attack
slayer_s_improved_extra_attack.desc_1: Slayer's Improved Extra Attack is a passive feature available to the Slayer, granting it two additional attacks.
slayer_s_improved_extra_attack.desc_2: You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon.

slow_fall.name: Slow Fall
slow_fall.desc_1: Slow Fall is a toggleable passive feature gained by Monks at Level 4. Slow Fall allows the Monk to gain Resistance to falling damage.
slow_fall.desc_2: When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

slow_actions.name: Slow: Actions
slow_actions.desc_1: Slow: Actions is a passive feature applied to a target afflicted with  Slowed and is a component of the Slow effect.
slow_actions.desc_2: You can't take both an action and a bonus action. If you take an action, you lose a bonus action, and vice versa. You also can't make more than 1 attack per turn.

slow_casting.name: Slow: Casting
slow_casting.desc_1: Slow: Casting is a passive feature applied to a target afflicted with  Slowed and is a component of the Slow effect.
slow_casting.desc_2: If you cast a spell that costs 1  Action, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you hang in prepare phase and skip turn. On your next turn you must spend an action point and finish casting. If you don't have an action point, the spell is cancelled.

smite_the_graceless.name: Smite the Graceless
smite_the_graceless.desc_1: Smite the Graceless is a passive feature that retaliates against attackers with radiant damage.
smite_the_graceless.desc_2: Creatures who miss their Attack rolls against the wearer must make a DC 14  Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4⁠Radiant damage.

smooth_start.name: Smooth Start
smooth_start.desc_1: Smooth Start is a passive feature that allows the wearer to move quickly at the start of combat.
smooth_start.desc_2: At the start of combat, the wearer gains  Momentum for 3 turns.

sneaky_riposte.name: Sneaky Riposte
sneaky_riposte.desc_1: Sneaky Riposte is a passive feature that lets a character make a reaction which deals Sneak Attack damage if they have  Advantage
sneaky_riposte.desc_2: Strike a foe that just missed you with an attack, inflicting Sneak Attack damage if you have Advantage.

snowburst.name: Snowburst
snowburst.desc_1: Snowburst is a passive feature that creates ice surfaces wherever the wearer deals cold damage.
snowburst.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Cold damage, they also create a  4.5 m / 15 ft circle of  Ice around the target(s).

snowy_liver.name: Snowy Liver
snowy_liver.desc_1: Snowy Liver is a passive feature that grants enahnced constitution damage and resistance.
snowy_liver.desc_2: While  Drunk you have  Advantage on Constitution  Saving throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution Modifier at the start of your turn.

song_of_defence.name: Song of Defence
song_of_defence.desc_1: Song of Defence is a passive feature/reaction available to Bladesinging wizards which lets them expend spell slots to reduce incoming damage.
song_of_defence.desc_2: When you take damage during your  Bladesong, you can expend a spell slot to subtract 5 damage per spell slot.

soothing_songs.name: Soothing Songs
soothing_songs.desc_1: Soothing Songs is a passive feature that adds healing every time they inspire an ally.
soothing_songs.desc_2: When you inspire an ally using  Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6⁠hit points.

soul_catching.name: Soul Catching
soul_catching.actions: Soul Catching Boon, Soul Catching Prowess, Soul Snare: Heal
soul_catching.desc_1: Soul Catching is a passive feature granted to the wearer of the  Gloves of Soul Catching. After landing an unarmed or throwing attack, the wearer can heal 10 hit points or gain a +5 bonus to a single attack roll or saving throw. Only one of these options can be used each turn.
soul_catching.desc_2: Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain 10⁠hit points. Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an Attack roll or  Saving throw until the end of your next turn.[See: Bugs]

soul_fist.name: Soul Fist
soul_fist.desc_1: Soul Fist is a passive feature that adds force damage to their wearer's arsenal.
soul_fist.desc_2: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10⁠Force damage.

soul_perception.name: Soul Perception
soul_perception.desc_1: Soul Perception is a passive feature that gives the wearer bonuses to their hit chance, initiative and perception.
soul_perception.desc_2: Gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls,  Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks.

soul_pillar_proximity.name: Soul Pillar Proximity
soul_pillar_proximity.desc_1: Soul Pillar Proximity is a unique Raphael passive feature that grants him bonuses for being close to his Soul Pillars.
soul_pillar_proximity.desc_2: For each remaining Soul Pillar, Raphael's attacks deal an additional 1d12⁠Fire damage and he has a +3 bonus to his Dexterity Checks and Saving Throws.

soul_reaper.name: Soul Reaper
soul_reaper.desc_1: Soul Reaper is a unique Raphael passive feature makes him extra deadly when he Downs a creature.
soul_reaper.desc_2: When Raphael reduces an enemy's hit points to 0, he  Severs the soul from their body.

spark_blocker.name: Spark Blocker
spark_blocker.desc_1: Spark Blocker is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being electrocutted.

sparkswall_armour.name: Sparkswall Armour
sparkswall_armour.desc_1: Sparkswall Armour is a passive feature that boosts the benefits of having lightning charges.
sparkswall_armour.desc_2: The wearer has +1 to  Armour Class and  Saving throws as long as they have  Lightning Charges.

speedy_sparks.name: Speedy Sparks
speedy_sparks.desc_1: Speedy Sparks is a passive feature that grants lightning charges to the wearer when they dash.
speedy_sparks.desc_2: When the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action in combat, they gain 3  Lightning Charges

spell_amplification.name: Spell Amplification
spell_amplification.desc_1: Spell Amplification is a passive feature that grants extra spells.
spell_amplification.desc_2: You gain an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot.

spell_resistance.name: Spell Resistance
spell_resistance.desc_1: Spell Resistance is a passive feature that grants the wielder resistance against magical spells.
spell_resistance.desc_2: You have  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells.

spell_sniper.name: Spell Sniper
spell_sniper.desc_1: Spell Sniper is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. Users with this feature have learned an additional cantrip, and are more likely to critical hit with a spell.
spell_sniper.desc_2: You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. The cantrip must be one of:

spellguard.name: Spellguard
spellguard.desc_1: Spellguard is a passive feature that offers excellent protection against spells.
spellguard.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws against spells. Spell Attack Rolls against you have  Disadvantage.

spellmight.name: Spellmight
spellmight.desc_1: Spellmight is a toggleable passive feature that allows a caster to steady their hand, dealing excellent damage if it hits,
spellmight.desc_2: When casting a spell that requires an Attack roll, you can take a -5 penalty to the roll to deal an additional   1d8 damage.

spider_fall.name: Spider Fall
spider_fall.desc_1: Spider Fall is a passive feature available to druids using the  Giant Spider wild shape.
spider_fall.desc_2: A network of spider silk slows the spider's fall, making it Resistant to Falling damage.

spider_step.name: Spider Step
spider_step.desc_1: Spider Step is a passive feature that prevents the user from being affected by web surfaces.
spider_step.desc_2: Immune to being  Enwebbed. Your Movement Speed is not affected by  Web surfaces.

spiteful_thunder.name: Spiteful Thunder
spiteful_thunder.desc_1: Spiteful Thunder is a passive feature that can daze the wearer's reverberating targets.
spiteful_thunder.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage to a  Reverberating creature, it becomes  Dazed unless it succeeds a  Constitution saving throw.

splinters_of_a_giant_s_might.name: Splinters of a Giant's Might
splinters_of_a_giant_s_might.desc_1: Splinters of a Giant's Might is a passive feature that increases the user's Strength, up to a minimum of 19.

split_enchantment.name: Split Enchantment
split_enchantment.desc_1: Split Enchantment is an Enchantment School Wizard toggleable passive feature that enables you to target 2 creatures when casting an Enchantment school spell that normally only targets 1.
split_enchantment.desc_2: You know your enchantments inside and out. You can target 2 creatures with Enchantment spells that would normally only target 1 creature. Single target Enchantment Wizard Spells:

spore_sacks.name: Spore Sacks
spore_sacks.desc_1: Spore Sacks is a passive feature that grants extra spore druid abilities.
spore_sacks.desc_2: While imbued with  Symbiotic Entity, you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.

spreading_spores.name: Spreading Spores
spreading_spores.desc_1: Spreading Spores is a Circle of the Spores Druid passive feature that allows you to attack an area with a cloud of Spreading Spores
spreading_spores.desc_2: While  Symbiotic Entity is active, you can create a cloud of  Spreading Spores.

sprouting_necrosis.name: Sprouting Necrosis
sprouting_necrosis.desc_1: Sprouting Necrosis is a passive feature found on a couple Shadow-Cursed Blight creatures.
sprouting_necrosis.desc_2: At the end of its turns, Shadow-Cursed Vines will sprout at this creature's feet.

staff_of_the_ram.name: Staff of the Ram
staff_of_the_ram.desc_1: Staff of the Ram is a passive feature that knocks back and stuns targets.
staff_of_the_ram.desc_2: Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back  2 m / 7 ft and  Stuns them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.

stalker_s_flurry.name: Stalker's Flurry
stalker_s_flurry.desc_1: Stalker's Flurry is a Gloom Stalker Ranger passive feature that lets you continue attacking when you miss.
stalker_s_flurry.desc_2: When you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another one for free.

starry_form.name: Starry Form
starry_form.actions: Starry Form: Archer, Starry Form: Chalice, Starry Form: Dragon
starry_form.desc_1: Starry Form is a passive feature that grants starry forms to Circle of the Stars druids.
starry_form.desc_2: You can expend a  Wild Shape Charge to take on a Starry Form rather than transforming into a beast. You can take on  Starry Form: Archer,  Starry Form: Chalice, or  Starry Form: Dragon.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc_1: Steadfast is a passive feature that prevents the wearer from being forcibly moved. Also ignores difficult terrain.
steadfast.desc_2: You cannot be forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions, and you ignore the effects of  Difficult Terrain.

stealthier.name: Stealthier
stealthier.desc_1: Stealthier is a passive feature that helps the wearer hide and move undetected while in shadow.
stealthier.desc_2: While Obscured, the wearer gains +3 bonus to Stealth Checks

stealthy.name: Stealthy
stealthy.desc_1: Stealthy is a passive feature that improves the wielders ability to sneak around undetected.
stealthy.desc_2: Gain a +1 bonus to Stealth Checks.

stealthy_critical.name: Stealthy Critical
stealthy_critical.desc_1: Stealthy Critical is a passive feature that increases the wearer's critical chance when hiding.
stealthy_critical.desc_2: While  Hiding, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

steel_physiology.name: Steel Physiology
steel_physiology.desc_1: Steel Physiology is a passive feature that reduces incoming physical damage

steel_will.name: Steel Will
steel_will.desc_1: Steel Will is a Hunter Ranger passive feature that strengthens your mind against fear.
steel_will.desc_2: Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Frightened.

steeped_in_slaughter.name: Steeped in Slaughter
steeped_in_slaughter.desc_1: Steeped in Slaughter is a passive feature of Redcap's that lets them attacks at advantage against Bleeding foes.
steeped_in_slaughter.desc_2: Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls made against  Bleeding foes.

stillness_of_mind.name: Stillness of Mind
stillness_of_mind.desc_1: Stillness of Mind is a Monk passive feature that automatically calms the user if they are Charmed or Frightened.
stillness_of_mind.desc_2: If you are  Charmed or  Frightened, you automatically cast  Stillness of Mind to remove the condition.

sting_the_helpless.name: Sting The Helpless
sting_the_helpless.desc_1: Sting The Helpless is a passive feature that allows a creature to inflict additional poison damage to a restrained enemy.
sting_the_helpless.desc_2: A Drow wielding this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠Poison against  Restrained targets.

stirring_execution.name: Stirring Execution
stirring_execution.desc_1: Stirring Execution is a passive feature which grants allies temporary hit points based on their respective Charisma modifiers when the wielder of  Duke Ravengard's Longsword kills an enemy.
stirring_execution.desc_2: When you kill an enemy, allies within  9 m / 30 ft gain temporary hit points equal to your[See: Bugs] Charisma Modifier (minimum 1).

stone_camouflage.name: Stone Camouflage
stone_camouflage.desc_1: Stone Camouflage is a passive feature available to Deep Gnome characters that grants them Advantage on Stealth checks.
stone_camouflage.desc_2: You have  Advantage on  Stealth checks.

strange_conduit.name: Strange Conduit
strange_conduit.desc_1: Strange Conduit Ring is a passive feature that adds psychic damage to weapon attacks while concentrating on a spell.
strange_conduit.desc_2: When Concentrating on a spell, the wearer's weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Psychic damage.

strength_of_the_grave.name: Strength of the Grave
strength_of_the_grave.desc_1: Strength of the Grave is a passive feature that prevents the first death.
strength_of_the_grave.desc_2: After reaching 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 instead of becoming downed.

strider_movement.name: Strider Movement
strider_movement.desc_1: Strider Movement is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed.

strongheart_resilience.name: Strongheart Resilience
strongheart_resilience.desc_1: Strongheart Resilience is a passive feature available to all Strongheart Halflings. It grants them Advantage against poison saving throws and Resistance against poison damage.
strongheart_resilience.desc_2: You have  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Poisoned and Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

stun_immunity.name: Stun Immunity
stun_immunity.desc_1: Stun Immunity is a passive feature that prevents the wielder from being stunned.

stygian_empowerment.name: Stygian Empowerment
stygian_empowerment.desc_1: Stygian Empowerment is a passive feature available to Vengeful Cambions, that lets them deal additional damage while in proximity of Raphael.
stygian_empowerment.desc_2: Affected entity's weapon attacks deal an additional 3~18 ⁠Piercing damage while within 18m of Raphael

subtle_swap.name: Subtle Swap
subtle_swap.desc_1: Subtle Swap is a passive feature that improves throwing ability and potentially swaps position with the target.
subtle_swap.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to Attack rolls when throwing, and may swap positions with the target if they fail a  Dexterity saving throw.

sun_sickness.name: Sun Sickness
sun_sickness.desc_1: Sun Sickness is a passive feature available to certain myconid creatures.
sun_sickness.desc_2: While in sunlight, has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks, Attack Rolls, and Saving Throws.

sunlight_hypersensitivity.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
sunlight_hypersensitivity.desc_1: Sunlight Hypersensitivity is a passive feature that causes a creature to take ⁠Radiant damage, and have attack roll and ability check disadvantage while in sunlight.
sunlight_hypersensitivity.desc_2: This creature takes 20⁠Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has  Disadvantage on Attack rolls and  Ability checks.

sunlight_sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
sunlight_sensitivity.desc_1: Sunlight Sensitivity is a passive feature that imposes penalties when in sunlight.
sunlight_sensitivity.desc_2: While in sunlight, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Perception checks that rely on sight.

sunlight_weakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
sunlight_weakness.desc_1: Sunlight Weakness is a passive feature that imposes strong penalties when in sunlight.
sunlight_weakness.desc_2: While in sunlight, this creature has  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

sunwalker_s_gift.name: Sunwalker's Gift
sunwalker_s_gift.desc_1: Sunwalker's Gift is a passive feature that grants darkvision.
sunwalker_s_gift.desc_2: The wearer can see in the dark up to  12 m / 40 ft.

superior_darkvision.name: Superior Darkvision
superior_darkvision.desc_1: Superior Darkvision is a passive feature that prevents  Disadvantage when attacking creatures in the dark within 24 m / 80 ft, double the distance of normal  Darkvision.
superior_darkvision.desc_2: Can see in the dark up to 24 m / 80 ft.

superior_material_1.name: Superior Material (-1)
superior_material_1.desc_1: Superior Material is a passive feature that reduces damage from slashing attacks.

superior_material_2.name: Superior Material (-2)
superior_material_2.desc_1: Superior Material is a passive feature that provides some damage reduction.

superior_padding_1.name: Superior Padding (-1)
superior_padding_1.desc_1: Superior Padding is a passive feature that lets the owner take less bludgeoning damage.

superior_padding_2.name: Superior Padding (-2)
superior_padding_2.desc_1: Superior Padding is a passive feature that lets the owner take less bludgeoning damage.

superior_plate_1.name: Superior Plate (-1)
superior_plate_1.desc_1: Superior Plate is a passive feature that lets the owner take less piercing damage.

superior_plate_2.name: Superior Plate (-2)
superior_plate_2.desc_1: Superior Plate is a passive feature that lets the owner take less piercing damage.

supreme_githyanki_parry.name: Supreme Githyanki Parry
supreme_githyanki_parry.desc_1: Supreme Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 20.
supreme_githyanki_parry.desc_2: Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 20. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated, Blinded[See Notes], or Restrained.

surge_accuracy.name: Surge Accuracy
surge_accuracy.desc_1: Surge Accuracy is a passive feature that makes you more likely to hit after you action surge.
surge_accuracy.desc_2: When you use  Action Surge, gain a   +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls for the rest of your turn.

swamp_i.name: Swamp I
swamp_i.desc_1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
swamp_i.desc_2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

swamp_ii.name: Swamp II
swamp_ii.desc_1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
swamp_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

swamp_iii.name: Swamp III
swamp_iii.desc_1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
swamp_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

swamp_iv.name: Swamp IV
swamp_iv.desc_1: Swamp is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
swamp_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Darkness. At higher levels You can cast  Stinking Cloud and  Vampiric Touch. You can cast  Blight and  Grasping Vine. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

swathed_in_shadow.name: Swathed in Shadow
swathed_in_shadow.desc_1: Swathed in Shadow is a passive feature that allows the wearer to resist spells better, while in shadow.
swathed_in_shadow.desc_2: While Obscured by shadow, the wearer gains +1 to  Saving throws when attacked.[See: Bugs]

sweet_bloodletting.name: Sweet Bloodletting
sweet_bloodletting.desc_1: Sweet Bloodletting is a passive feature that causes targets to bleed when attacked while hidden.
sweet_bloodletting.desc_2: Possibly inflict  Bleeding when hitting a creature with this weapon while  Hiding or  Invisible.

swift_strides.name: Swift Strides
swift_strides.desc_1: Swift Strides is a passive feature that increases the user's movement speed whenever they dash.
swift_strides.desc_2: When the wearer  Dashes or takes a similar action during combat, they gain  Momentum for 3 turns.

sword_mastery.name: Sword Mastery
sword_mastery.desc_1: Sword Mastery is a passive feature that grants the wearer proficiency in a number of swords.
sword_mastery.desc_2: You gain Proficiency with  shortswords,  longswords, and  greatswords. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to melee Attack rolls.

synergetic_cantrips.name: Synergetic Cantrips
synergetic_cantrips.desc_1: Synergetic Cantrips is a passive feature that applies when dealing damage with a cantrip.
synergetic_cantrips.desc_2: When you deal damage with a Cantrip, you gain  Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

synergetic_moments.name: Synergetic Moments
synergetic_moments.desc_1: Synergetic Moments is a passive feature that adds damage equal to your spellcasting ability after inflicting a condition.
synergetic_moments.desc_2: When you inflict a condition, gain  Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.[See: Bugs]

tactical_discipline.name: Tactical Discipline
tactical_discipline.desc_1: Tactical Discipline is a passive feature that grants the user advantage on all ability checks and saving throws during combat.
tactical_discipline.desc_2: You are an expert in mustering self-control to gain an edge over your foes. You gain  Advantage on all Ability Checks and  Saving throws during combat.

talkative.name: Talkative
talkative.desc_1: Talkative is a Passive Feature that allows a creature to cast spells.
talkative.desc_2: Despite its lack of lips this creature can cast spells that have a verbal component.

tanglevine_form.name: Tanglevine Form
tanglevine_form.desc_1: Tanglevine Form is a passive feature that allows its user to defend itself by entangling enemies.
tanglevine_form.desc_2: Any creature making a melee attack against this mess of writhing vines may become  Entangled

tavern_brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavern_brawler.desc_1: Tavern Brawler is a passive feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. Users of this feature excel at improvised and unarmed fighting and deal more damage more often.
tavern_brawler.desc_2: Increase your  Strength or  Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your Strength Modifier is added to the damage and Attack rolls an additional time.

temperature_adjustment.name: Temperature Adjustment
temperature_adjustment.desc_1: Temperature Adjustment is a passive feature that lets the user resist fire and cold damage.
temperature_adjustment.desc_2: You have Resistance to ⁠Fire and ⁠Cold Damage.

tempestuous_magic.name: Tempestuous Magic
tempestuous_magic.desc_1: Tempestuous Magic is a Storm Sorcery Sorcerer passive feature that enables you to safely disengage from enemies after casting a leveled spell.
tempestuous_magic.desc_2: After you cast a Level 1 Spell or higher you can  Fly as a Bonus Action up to  9 m / 30 ft until the end of your turn without receiving Opportunity Attacks.

tenacity.name: Tenacity
tenacity.desc_1: Tenacity is a feature that allows the user to apply damage, even on a miss.
tenacity.desc_2: When you miss an attack, you deal Strength Modifier⁠Bludgeoning damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.desc_1: Territorial is a passive feature available to Bulette creatures.
territorial.desc_2: The Bulette will attack other monstrosities before going after smaller prey.

the_blade_of_frontiers.name: The Blade of Frontiers
the_blade_of_frontiers.desc_1: The Blade of Frontiers is a passive feature that grants Wyll proficiency with Rapiers.
the_blade_of_frontiers.desc_2: The Champion of the Sword Coast, renowned for his heroic deeds and unusual stone eye.

the_comeback.name: The Comeback
the_comeback.desc_1: The Comeback is a passive feature that grants a creature temporary HP when you heal them.
the_comeback.desc_2: When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional  3 temporary hit points. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

the_pain_maiden_s_blessing.name: The Pain Maiden's Blessing
the_pain_maiden_s_blessing.desc_1: The Pain Maiden's Blessing is a passive feature that blesses the wielder after a successful attack.
the_pain_maiden_s_blessing.desc_2: After a successful attack with this dagger, the wielder receives a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the end of their next turn[See: Bugs].

the_scourge_mistress_bane.name: The Scourge Mistress' Bane
the_scourge_mistress_bane.desc_1: The Scourge Mistress' Bane is a passive feature that can apply  Bane but will hurt the wielder if they are too healthy.
the_scourge_mistress_bane.desc_2: Chance to inflict upon the target a 1d4 penalty to Attack rolls and  Saving throws. If the attacker still has 50% or more hit points, they take 1d6⁠Piercing themselves. A Baned creature receives a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

the_shadow_itself.name: The Shadow Itself
the_shadow_itself.desc_1: The Shadow Itself is a passive feature that cloaks the wearer in invisibility whenever they kill an enemy.
the_shadow_itself.desc_2: Once per turn when you kill an enemy, shroud yourself in primeval darkness to become  Invisible for 2 turns.

the_tharchiate_codex_blessing.name: The Tharchiate Codex: Blessing
the_tharchiate_codex_blessing.desc_1: The Tharciate Codex: Blessing is a passive feature granted after lifting the  Tharchiate Withering curse.
the_tharchiate_codex_blessing.desc_2: Once per Long Rest, gain  20 temporary hit points.

the_water_caller.name: The Water Caller
the_water_caller.desc_1: The Water Caller is a passive feature that produces water on hit with this weapon, soaking the target.
the_water_caller.desc_2: On a hit, inflict  Wet and create a  2 m / 7 ft  Water surface centred around the target.

thermodynamo.name: Thermodynamo
thermodynamo.desc_1: Thermodynamo is a passive feature that grants Heat when you deal damage.
thermodynamo.desc_2: Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of  Heat.

thief_of_five_fates.name: Thief of Five Fates
thief_of_five_fates.desc_1: Thief of Five Fates is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows you to cast Bane (spell) once per Long Rest.
thief_of_five_fates.desc_2: Once per Long Rest, you can cast  Bane using a Warlock Spell Slot. Bane targets up to 3 creatures. They receive a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

thought_shield_psychic_reflection.name: Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection
thought_shield_psychic_reflection.desc_1: Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that damages attackers with the same damage when damaged with Psychic damage.
thought_shield_psychic_reflection.desc_2: Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take ⁠Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.

thought_shield_psychic_resistance.name: Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance
thought_shield_psychic_resistance.desc_1: Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance is a passive feature unique to The Great Old One Warlock subclass that grants Resistance to Psychic damage.
thought_shield_psychic_resistance.desc_2: An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.

throw_damage_immunity.name: Throw Damage Immunity
throw_damage_immunity.desc_1: Throw Damage Immunity is a passive feature exclusive to  Boo which prevents him from receiving any damage when thrown.
throw_damage_immunity.desc_2: Creature is immune to being damaged by being thrown.

throwing_boost.name: Throwing Boost
throwing_boost.desc_1: Throwing Boost is a passive feature that increases the wearer's throwing damage.
throwing_boost.desc_2: The wearer gains a   1d4 bonus to  Throw damage.

throwing_lightning_damage.name: Throwing: Lightning Damage
throwing_lightning_damage.desc_1: Throwing: Lightning Damage is a passive feature that increases the damage dealt when thrown.
