throwing_lightning_damage.desc_2: When launched at a target, deal an additional 1d4⁠Lightning damage.

thunderbolt_strike.name: Thunderbolt Strike
thunderbolt_strike.desc_1: Thunderbolt Strike is a Tempest Domain cleric passive feature that pushes Large or smaller creatures 3 m / 10 ft that are dealt ⁠Thunder or ⁠Lightning damage from the cleric.
thunderbolt_strike.desc_2: When you deal ⁠Thunder or ⁠Lightning damage to a creature that is Large or smaller, you can also push it up to 3 m / 10 ft.

thunderous_acuity.name: Thunderous Acuity
thunderous_acuity.desc_1: Thunderous Acuity is a passive feature that improves the wearer's spell power after dealing thunder damage.
thunderous_acuity.desc_2: Whenever the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage, they gain  Arcane Acuity.

thunderous_conversion.name: Thunderous Conversion
thunderous_conversion.desc_1: Thunderous Conversion is a passive feature that disorients the user's target whenever they deal thunder, lightning or radiant damage.
thunderous_conversion.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Thunder, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target(s).

tides_of_chaos.name: Tides of Chaos
tides_of_chaos.desc_1: Tides of Chaos is a toggleable passive feature which grants Advantage on the user's next Ability Check and increases their chance of a Wild Magic surge afterwards to 50% (normally 5%).
tides_of_chaos.desc_2: Activate to gain  Advantage on your next Attack roll,  Ability check, or  Saving throw. Increased chance of  Wild Magic surge afterwards.

tiger_heart.name: Tiger Heart
tiger_heart.desc_1: Tiger Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
tiger_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, you can use  Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by  4.5 m / 15 ft.

time_thoroughly_bided.name: Time Thoroughly Bided
time_thoroughly_bided.desc_1: Time Thoroughly Bided is a passive feature that enhances the user's damage.
time_thoroughly_bided.desc_2: The wearer gains  Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

tippler_s_rage.name: Tippler's Rage
tippler_s_rage.desc_1: Tippler's Rage is a passive feature that enhances your chance to hit and causes a blast with extra damage but only while drunk.
tippler_s_rage.desc_2: While you are  Drunk, you have  Advantage on Attack rolls. You also create a blast with each attack, dealing 1d4⁠Thunder for  3 m / 10 ft.

titan_weapon.name: Titan Weapon
titan_weapon.desc_1: Titan Weapon is a passive feature that adds your Strength modifier to your ranged weapon attacks.
titan_weapon.desc_2: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier. The weapon only adds the modifier if it improves your chance to hit.

toggle_non_lethal_attacks.name: Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks
toggle_non_lethal_attacks.desc_1: Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks is a common toggleable passive feature that allows users to knock targets out instead of killing them. Toggling on/off will apply to the entire party of playable characters, but not to summons such as familiars. While this passive is turned on, when an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack reduces a creatures hit points to zero or one, it becomes  Knocked Out or  Knocked Out (Temporary).
toggle_non_lethal_attacks.desc_2: Knock someone  Unconscious instead of killing them. Must be unarmed or using a melee weapon. Doesn't work on undead or constructs.

torturous_edges.name: Torturous Edges
torturous_edges.desc_1: Torturous Edges is a passive feature that tortures its targets.
torturous_edges.desc_2: Tortured creatures may receive  Disadvantage on Constitution  Saving throws.

tough.name: Tough
tough.desc_1: Tough is a passive feature obtainable by a Feat of the same name. Users of this feature have extra Hit Points per character level.
tough.desc_2: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 2 for every level you have gained.

toxic_secretions.name: Toxic Secretions
toxic_secretions.desc_1: Toxic Secretions is a passive feature which can cause Madness in an enemy making a melee attack against the user.
toxic_secretions.desc_2: When an enemy makes a melee attack against the frog, they need to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw, or succumb to  Madness for two turns. Mad creatures lose control of themselves and become hostile to everyone around them.

training_in_war_and_song.name: Training in War and Song
training_in_war_and_song.weapon_proficiency: Daggers, Longswords, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, Sickles
training_in_war_and_song.desc_1: Training in War and Song is a passive feature of Bladesinging Wizards which grants them proficiencies in light armour and one-handed blade weapons.
training_in_war_and_song.desc_2: You gain proficiency with  Light armour and in the Performance skill. You also gain proficiency with  Daggers,  Longswords,  Rapiers,  Scimitars,  Shortswords, and  Sickles.

tranquillity.name: Tranquillity
tranquillity.desc_1: Tranquillity is a Way of the Open Hand Monk passive feature that prevents enemies from directly harming the monk until the first time they attack each day (effectively a free use of Sanctuary).
tranquillity.desc_2: Long Rests surround you with an aura of peace, granting you  Sanctuary permanently until you attack.

transmuter_s_stone.name: Transmuter's Stone
transmuter_s_stone.desc_1: Transmuter's Stone lets a Transmutation wizard create Transmuter Stones.
transmuter_s_stone.desc_2: You can create  Transmuter's Stones. Once you have created a stone, you need to cast a Transmutation spell of Level 1 or higher or take a Long Rest before you can create another one.

treader_by_twilight.name: Treader by Twilight
treader_by_twilight.desc_1: Treader by Twilight is a passive feature that increases your armour while obscured.
treader_by_twilight.desc_2: You gain a +1 bonus to  Armour Class while obscured.

troubadour_s_wonder.name: Troubadour's Wonder
troubadour_s_wonder.desc_1: Troubadour's Wonder is a passive feature that boosts a bard's ability to inspire.
troubadour_s_wonder.desc_2: Your  Armour Class increases by 1. In addition, if you have  Bardic Inspiration, you gain 1 more use of it.

true_strike_riposte.name: True Strike Riposte
true_strike_riposte.desc_1: True Strike Riposte is a passive feature that lets the wielder retaliate against a missed attack.
true_strike_riposte.desc_2: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain  True Strike.

turn_resistance.name: Turn Resistance
turn_resistance.desc_1: Turn Resistance gives Advantage on Saving Throws against any effect that turns undead.
turn_resistance.desc_2: Turn Resistance gives  Advantage on  Saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

twinkling_constellations.name: Twinkling Constellations
twinkling_constellations.desc_1: Twinkling Constellations is a passive feature that improves the starry forms of Circle of the Stars druids.
twinkling_constellations.desc_2: Your Starry Forms are improved. The Archer's damage and the Chalice's healing are each increased by 1d8, and the Dragon gains the ability to hover and to  Fly at a movement speed of 6 m / 20 ft. Once per turn, you can switch to a different Starry Form as a free action.

twist_of_fortune.name: Twist of Fortune
twist_of_fortune.desc_1: Twist of Fortune is a passive feature that increases the consistency of your weapon's damage.
twist_of_fortune.desc_2: When you roll 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, reroll it and take the new result.

two_weapon_fighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
two_weapon_fighting.desc_1: Two-Weapon Fighting is a Fighting style passive feature.
two_weapon_fighting.desc_2: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.

umbral_attack.name: Umbral Attack
umbral_attack.desc_1: Umbral Attack is a passive feature that adds necrotic damage to the user's weapon attacks.
umbral_attack.desc_2: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠Necrotic damage.

unarmoured_defence_barbarian.name: Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian)
unarmoured_defence_barbarian.desc_1: Unarmoured Defence is a Barbarian passive feature that adds your Constitution modifier to your Armour Class in addition to your Dexterity modifier when not wearing armour.
unarmoured_defence_barbarian.desc_2: Your body is as resilient as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Constitution Modifier to your  Armour Class. Wearing Heavy Armour impedes all positive effects of your Rage. This effect does not stack with Mage Armour.

unarmoured_defence_monk.name: Unarmoured Defence (Monk)
unarmoured_defence_monk.desc_1: Unarmoured Defence is a Monk passive feature that adds your Wisdom modifier to your  Armour Class when not wearing armour or shields.
unarmoured_defence_monk.desc_2: Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class. This effect does not stack with Mage Armour.

unarmoured_movement.name: Unarmoured Movement
unarmoured_movement.desc_1: Unarmoured Movement is a Monk passive feature that increases movement distance by  3 m / 10 ft while not wearing armour or using a shield.
unarmoured_movement.desc_2: Your movement speed increases by  3 m / 10 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.desc_1: Uncanny Dodge is a togglable passive gained by Rogues at Level 5. Uncanny Dodge allows the Rogue to reduce incoming damage once per round.
uncanny_dodge.desc_2: Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage.

undead_bane.name: Undead Bane
undead_bane.desc_1: Undead Bane is a passive feature that enhances combat against undead creatures.
undead_bane.desc_2: Attack rolls with this weapon have  Advantage against Undead.

undead_fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
undead_fortitude.desc_1: Undead Fortitude is a passive feature that prevents the user from being killed, unless hit with a Critical Hit or ⁠Radiant damage.
undead_fortitude.desc_2: If the killing blow wasn't a critical hit and wasn't radiant damage, this undead comes back to life with 1 hit point.

undead_thralls_additional_undead.name: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead
undead_thralls_additional_undead.desc_1: Undead Thralls: Additional Undead is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that allows you to raise additional undead when you cast the Animate Dead spell.
undead_thralls_additional_undead.desc_2: When you use  Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.

undead_thralls_animate_dead.name: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead
undead_thralls_animate_dead.desc_1: Undead Thralls: Animate Dead is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that grants you the spell  Animate Dead.
undead_thralls_animate_dead.desc_2: You gain the  Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already

undead_thralls_better_summons.name: Undead Thralls: Better Summons
undead_thralls_better_summons.desc_1: Undead Thralls: Better Summons is a Necromancy School Wizard passive feature that enhances the undead you raise with Animate Dead. They gain additional hit points and extra damage.
undead_thralls_better_summons.desc_2: Creatures created with  Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.

undead_ward.name: Undead Ward
undead_ward.desc_1: Undead Ward is a passive feature that makes the wearer's allied undead resistant to physical damage.
undead_ward.desc_2: Allied undead within  6 m / 20 ft are Resistant to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, and ⁠Piercing damage.[See: Bugs]

underdark_i.name: Underdark I
underdark_i.desc_1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
underdark_i.desc_2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

underdark_ii.name: Underdark II
underdark_ii.desc_1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
underdark_ii.desc_2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

underdark_iii.name: Underdark III
underdark_iii.desc_1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
underdark_iii.desc_2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

underdark_iv.name: Underdark IV
underdark_iv.desc_1: Underdark is a passive feature available to Circle of the Land Druids that pick this as their Land. It grants a couple extra spells every two levels
underdark_iv.desc_2: You can cast  Web and  Misty Step. At higher levels You can cast  Gaseous Form and  Stinking Cloud. You can cast  Greater Invisibility and  Dominate Beast. You can cast  Contagion and  Cloudkill.

underdog_s_bravery.name: Underdog's Bravery
underdog_s_bravery.desc_1: Underdog's Bravery is a passive feature that improves the user's attacks while surrounded.
underdog_s_bravery.desc_2: The wearer gains  Advantage on melee Attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

unearthly.name: Unearthly
unearthly.desc_1: Unearthly is a passive feature available to Poltergeists that protects them from falling damage.
unearthly.desc_2: This creature is Immune to Falling damage.

unflinching_protection.name: Unflinching Protection
unflinching_protection.desc_1: Unflinching Protection is a passive feature/reaction granted by the  Unflinching Protector Amulet. The wearer can use this reaction to cause an attack targeting an ally to miss. This cannot be used against attacks targetting the wearer, only allies.
unflinching_protection.desc_2: When a nearby ally is targeted by an attack of any kind, you can use your  Reaction to make that attack automatically miss. This effect can only be used once per Short Rest.

unhampered_resistance.name: Unhampered Resistance
unhampered_resistance.desc_1: Unhampered Resistance is a passive feature that increases the user's Saving Throws while not wearing armour.
unhampered_resistance.desc_2: While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to  Saving throw.

unnatural_growth.name: Unnatural Growth
unnatural_growth.desc_1: Unnatural Growth is a passive feature unique to Ptaris that lets him act quickly.

unstable_blood.name: Unstable Blood
unstable_blood.desc_1: Unstable Blood is a permanent passive feature which causes a creature's blood to explode when in contact with fire.
unstable_blood.desc_2: Your blood is now highly flammable and will explode when in contact with fire.

unwavering.name: Unwavering
unwavering.desc_1: Unwavering is a passive feature that prevents the wearer's movement speed from being affected.
unwavering.desc_2: You ignore the effects of  Difficult Terrain, and cannot be  Paralysed or  Restrained.

unwavering_bull.name: Unwavering Bull
unwavering_bull.desc_1: Unwavering Bull is a passive feature that makes the wielder difficult to move or restrain.
unwavering_bull.desc_2: You cannot be pushed against your will and you have an  Advantage on  Saving throws against being  Restrained.

urban_tracker.name: Urban Tracker
urban_tracker.desc_1: Urban Tracker is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. Grants you proficiency in Sleight of Hand, as you are an expert in navigating cities.
urban_tracker.desc_2: An expert at navigating the wild within the city, you gain Sleight of Hand Proficiency.

valiant_roll.name: Valiant Roll
valiant_roll.desc_1: Valiant Roll is a toggleable passive feature granted by having a Combat Inspiration.
valiant_roll.desc_2: Add a   +1d6 bonus to your next Ability Check. You expend your  Combat Inspiration when the effect triggers.

vampire_ascendant.name: Vampire Ascendant
vampire_ascendant.desc_1: Vampire Ascendant is a passive feature available to Astarion if he completed his quest by ascending. It gives Astarion the two class actions Ascendant Bite and Misty Escape (Vampire Ascendant), as well as a bonus 1d10⁠Necrotic damage to weapon and unarmed attacks.
vampire_ascendant.desc_2: Behold, the Vampire Ascendant! Thousands of souls have bought you power, granting you  Ascendant Bite and  Gaseous Form. You also have a +1d10⁠Necrotic damage bonus to weapon and unarmed attacks.

vampire_regeneration.name: Vampire Regeneration
vampire_regeneration.desc_1: Vampire Regeneration is a passive feature that allows a Vampire to regenerate 10 hit points at the start of its turn.
vampire_regeneration.desc_2: The vampire regains 10⁠hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken ⁠Radiant damage or damage from Holy Water, in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn.

vaprak_s_greed.name: Vaprak's Greed
vaprak_s_greed.desc_1: Vaprak's Greed is a Giant barbarian passive feature that increases carry weight.
vaprak_s_greed.desc_2: Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.

veil_of_the_wind.name: Veil of the Wind
veil_of_the_wind.desc_1: Veil of the Wind is a passive feature that makes you immune to falling damage and increases your movement.
veil_of_the_wind.desc_2: You gain a + 3 m / 10 ft bonus to movement speed and jump distance. Equipping this weapon gives you Immunity to falling damage.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.desc_1: Vengeful is a passive feature that grants an extra reaction and allows use of the  Vengeful Strike reaction attack.
vengeful.desc_2: Creature gains an extra reaction. When attacked, the creature can use a reaction to counterattack with Vengeful Strike, dealing Weapon Damage and 4-14 Psychic Damage.

vengeful_father.name: Vengeful Father
vengeful_father.desc_1: Vengeful Father is a passive feature available to the Owlbear Mate summoned by  Call Consort in Honour mode.
vengeful_father.desc_2: At low health or the death of a family member, this Owlbear becomes  Enraged.

vengeful_guardian.name: Vengeful Guardian
vengeful_guardian.desc_1: Vengeful Guardian is a passive feature of Grym, which causes it to always attack the last creature that struck it.
vengeful_guardian.desc_2: Grym always attacks the last creature that hit it if possible.

venomous_revenge.name: Venomous Revenge
venomous_revenge.desc_1: Venomous Revenge is a passive feature that coats the wearer's weapons[note 1] in poison whenever the wearer is healed.
venomous_revenge.desc_2: Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6⁠Poison  damage.

vicious_dragon_breath.name: Vicious Dragon Breath
vicious_dragon_breath.desc_1: Vicious Dragon Breath is a passive feature that improves the success rate of your breath weapon.
vicious_dragon_breath.desc_2: Enemies have  Disadvantage on  Saving throws against your dragonborn breath weapon.

vital_conduit.name: Vital Conduit
vital_conduit.desc_1: Vital Conduit is a passive feature that provides bonus healing when casting a concentration spell.
vital_conduit.desc_2: Grants the wearer  8 temporary hit points when they cast a Spell that requires  Concentration. Can only have temporary hit points from one source.

volatile_fungus.name: Volatile Fungus
volatile_fungus.desc_1: Fungal Resistance is a passive feature affecting Pearlspore Bell. It creates an explosion and lingering cloud of poison upon the affected entity's death.
volatile_fungus.desc_2: This Pearlspore Bell will explode when destroyed, dealing damage and leaving a poisonous surface behind.

volo_s_ersatz_eye.name: Volo's Ersatz Eye
volo_s_ersatz_eye.desc_1: Volo's Ersatz Eye is a passive feature which gives a character the condition See Invisibility, after they have undergone surgery from Volo.
volo_s_ersatz_eye.desc_2: The damage wrought upon your ocular nerve during Volo's experiment is undone, allowing you to see  Invisible creatures.

war_caster_concentration.name: War Caster: Concentration
war_caster_concentration.desc_1: War Caster Concentration is a passive feature obtainable by the War Caster Feat. Users of this feature have Advantage maintaining a spell with Concentration.
war_caster_concentration.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws to maintain  Concentration on a Spell.

war_caster_opportunity_spell.name: War Caster: Opportunity Spell
war_caster_opportunity_spell.desc_1: War Caster Opportunity Spell is a Passive feature/Reaction obtainable by the War Caster Feat. Users of this feature are adept at casting  Shocking Grasp at an enemy when they leave your melee range. This can be done instead of the usual Opportunity Attack.
war_caster_opportunity_spell.desc_2: You can also use a Reaction to cast  Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.

war_magic.name: War Magic
war_magic.desc_1: War Magic is an Eldritch Knight Fighter passive feature. This allows the Fighter to make an attack after using a Cantrip by using a Bonus Action.
war_magic.desc_2: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a cantrip, you can make a weapon attack using a  Bonus Action.

war_priest.name: War Priest
war_priest.desc_1: War Priest is a War Domain cleric passive feature which allows the cleric to make a limited number of bonus action attacks using War Priest Charges that recharge after a long rest.
war_priest.desc_2: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack, you can spend a  War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a  Bonus Action. At higher levels A War Domain Cleric begins with three  War Priest Charges per long rest. This increases to:

warding_flare.name: Warding Flare
warding_flare.desc_1: Warding Flare is a Light Domain Cleric passive feature that allows the cleric to briefly flash an enemy, potentially causing the attack to miss.
warding_flare.desc_2: Shield yourself with divine light. Use your reaction to impose  Disadvantage on an attacker, possibly causing their attack to miss. An attacker that can't be Blinded is immune to this effect. At higher levels At level 6 Light Domain Clerics get  Improved Warding Flare which enables them to use Warding Flare on allies

warding_hands.name: Warding Hands
warding_hands.desc_1: Warding Hands is a passive feature that automatically grants heroism when channeling your oath.
warding_hands.desc_2: When you use your Channel Oath Charge spells, you gain  Heroism.

wasteland_wanderer_cold.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold
wasteland_wanderer_cold.desc_1: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. As an explorer of the cold winterlands, you gain resistance to Cold.
wasteland_wanderer_cold.desc_2: You have spent endless days surviving desolate tundras. Gain resistance to ⁠Cold damage, taking only half damage from it.

wasteland_wanderer_fire.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire
wasteland_wanderer_fire.desc_1: Wasteland Wanderer: Fire is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer.You are well versed in traveling in hot environments, you gain resistance to Fire.
wasteland_wanderer_fire.desc_2: You have spent endless days surviving forbidding deserts. Gain resistance to ⁠Fire, taking only half damage from it.

wasteland_wanderer_poison.name: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison
wasteland_wanderer_poison.desc_1: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison is a Ranger passive feature of Natural Explorer. Swamps are like a second home to you, you gain resistance to Poison.
wasteland_wanderer_poison.desc_2: You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. Gain resistance to ⁠Poison, taking only half damage from it.

watersparks.name: Watersparks
watersparks.desc_1: Watersparks is a passive feature that grants lightning charges when standing on an electrified surface.
watersparks.desc_2: If the wearer starts their turn on an  Electrified Water surface, they gain 3  Lightning Charges.

watery_guidance.name: Watery Guidance
watery_guidance.desc_1: Watery Guidance is a passive feature that makes you more likely to hit wet targets.
watery_guidance.desc_2: This weapon has  Advantage against  Wet creatures.

watery_rejuvenation.name: Watery Rejuvenation
watery_rejuvenation.desc_1: Watery Rejuvenation is a passive feature that heals the user when standing in water.
watery_rejuvenation.desc_2: If the wearer is standing in a  Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4⁠hit points.

weakened.name: Weakened
weakened.desc_1: Weakened is a passive feature found on some Intellect Devourers that lowers many of its stats.
weakened.desc_2: Its journey through hell has severely weakened this creature's defences.

weakened_constitution.name: Weakened Constitution
weakened_constitution.desc_1: Weakened Constitution is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk.
weakened_constitution.desc_2: Your Constitution has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weakened_intelligence.name: Weakened Intelligence
weakened_intelligence.desc_1: Weakened Intelligence is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk. It decreases your intelligence by 2 permanently, until this feature is removed.
weakened_intelligence.desc_2: Your Intelligence has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weakened_wisdom.name: Weakened Wisdom
weakened_wisdom.desc_1: Weakened Wisdom is a special passive feature gained when failing a particular saving throw while in the Zaith'isk. It decreases your wisdom by 2 permanently, until this feature is removed.
weakened_wisdom.desc_2: Your Wisdom has been reduced by 2 by the Zaith'isk. The githyanki device failed to harm your illithid parasite - perhaps consuming more would mend your broken mind.

weapon_master.name: Weapon Master
weapon_master.desc_1: Weapon Master is a passive feature obtainable by the Feat of the same name. Users of this feature are Proficient with additional types of weapons.
weapon_master.desc_2: Increase your  Strength or  Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Gain Proficiency with four Weapon types of your choice.

weave_eater.name: Weave Eater
weave_eater.desc_1: Weave Eater is a passive feature that heals the user whenever they successfully resist a spell.
weave_eater.desc_2: Whenever the wearer succeeds a  Saving throw against a spell, they regain 1d6⁠hit points.

web_sense.name: Web Sense
web_sense.desc_1: Web Sense is a passive feature available to Ettercaps that allows them to instantly detect any creature touching its webs.
web_sense.desc_2: Knows the exact location of anything that touches its webs.

web_walker.name: Web Walker
web_walker.desc_1: Web Walker is a passive feature inherent to a number of spider-like creatures in Baldur's Gate 3.
web_walker.desc_2: Isn't slowed down by  Web surfaces, and can't be  Enwebbed by them.

well_liked_and_well_fortified.name: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
well_liked_and_well_fortified.desc_1: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified is a passive feature that continuously grants temporary hp.
well_liked_and_well_fortified.desc_2: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

whispers_of_the_grave.name: Whispers of the Grave
whispers_of_the_grave.desc_1: Whispers of the Grave is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.
whispers_of_the_grave.desc_2: You can cast  Speak with Dead without expending a Warlock spell slot.

wild_magic.name: Wild Magic
wild_magic.desc_1: Wild Magic is a passive feature which can trigger a random magical effect when casting a Level 1 or higher Spell. An effect is triggered when rolling a 20 on a  d20 (i.e., a 5% chance).
wild_magic.desc_2: Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins. Each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.

wild_magic_surge.name: Wild Magic Surge
wild_magic_surge.desc_1: Wild Magic Surge is a passive feature granted to Wild Magic Barbarians that produces a random magical effect when raging.
wild_magic_surge.desc_2: A magical energy roils inside of you, ready to erupt. When you enter a  Rage, you trigger a random magical effect.

wild_strike.name: Wild Strike
wild_strike.desc_1: Wild Strike is a Druid passive feature that lets you make multiple unarmed attacks while Wildshaped.
wild_strike.desc_2: You can make an additional attack after making an unarmed strike while in wildshape.

willing_whip.name: Willing Whip
willing_whip.desc_1: Willing Whip is a passive feature that grants resistance to Necrotic damage but deals Necrotic damage to every creature nearby.
willing_whip.desc_2: Grants Resistance to ⁠Necrotic, and deals additional 1d6⁠Necrotic damage to everyone nearby including the wielder.

winter_s_clutches.name: Winter's Clutches
winter_s_clutches.desc_1: Winter's Clutches is a passive feature that encrusts targets in frost whenever the user attacks and deals cold damage.
winter_s_clutches.desc_2: When the wearer deals ⁠Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of  Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

witchbreaker.name: Witchbreaker
witchbreaker.desc_1: Witchbreaker is a passive feature that grants advantage against creatures concentrating on spells.
witchbreaker.desc_2: You gain  Advantage on Attack rolls against concentrating creatures.

withering_cut.name: Withering Cut
withering_cut.desc_1: Withering Cut is a passive feature that lets the wielder deal extra damage using a reaction.
withering_cut.desc_2: On a hit with a melee weapon, use a  Reaction to deal additional ⁠Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

wolf_heart.name: Wolf Heart
wolf_heart.desc_1: Wolf Heart is a passive feature that grants a Wildheart Barbarian a special version of Rage and another ability.
wolf_heart.desc_2: While  Raging, you can use  Inciting Howl, and your allies have  Advantage on melee Attack rolls against enemies within  2 m / 7 ft of you.

wound_closure.name: Wound Closure
wound_closure.desc_1: Wound Closure is a passive feature that automatically stabilises the wearer
wound_closure.desc_2: When  Downed, automatically stabilise at the start of the turn.

wrath_of_the_storm.name: Wrath of the Storm
wrath_of_the_storm.actions: Wrath of the Storm: Lightning, Wrath of the Storm: Thunder
wrath_of_the_storm.desc_1: Wrath of the Storm is a Tempest Domain Cleric passive feature. It grants the cleric two reactions,  Wrath of the Storm: Lightning and  Wrath of the Storm: Thunder, that can be triggered to retaliate against an attacking creature with ⁠Lightning or ⁠Thunder damage.
wrath_of_the_storm.desc_2: As a  Reaction, strike back at an attacking creature, dealing 2d8⁠Lightning or 2d8⁠Thunder damage. The target takes half damage on a successful  Saving throw.

writhing_dance.name: Writhing Dance
writhing_dance.desc_1: Writhing Dance is a passive feature that allows the wearer to avoid opportunity attacks when below half their hit points.
writhing_dance.desc_2: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less, they don't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

xyanyde_s_fire.name: Xyanyde's Fire
xyanyde_s_fire.desc_1: Xyanyde's Fire is a passive feature that lights up the wearer's target if they miss, making them easier to hit next turn.
xyanyde_s_fire.desc_2: Once per Short Rest, you can encase a target in  Faerie Fire for 2 turns if you miss an attack against it.

yeenoghu_s_gift.name: Yeenoghu's Gift
yeenoghu_s_gift.desc_1: Yeenoghu's Gift is a passive feature which requires the wielder continue attacking or go mad.
yeenoghu_s_gift.desc_2: Hitting an enemy with this weapon heals the wielder for 1d6⁠hit points - but they can go  Mad if they don't continue hitting an enemy each turn. Healing through this item doesn't trigger other passives that react to healing.

yeenoghu_s_hunger.name: Yeenoghu's Hunger
yeenoghu_s_hunger.desc_1: Yeenoghu's Hunger is a passive feature that identifies a creature as harboring Gnoll spawn.
yeenoghu_s_hunger.desc_2: Bloated with the spoils of slaughter, but still hungry - a new gnoll is growing in the hyena's belly.

zephyr_connection.name: Zephyr Connection
zephyr_connection.desc_1: Zephyr Connection is a passive feature that binds the weapon to the wielder and creates a thunder explosion when thrown.
zephyr_connection.desc_2: This weapon will return to your hand when thrown. You cannot be forced to drop the trident. When thrown, the weapon creates an explosion that deals 3d4⁠Thunder damage in a  6 m / 20 ft blast centered on the target.

giant_killer.name: Giant Killer
giant_killer.desc_1: Giant Killer is a Hunter ranger passive feature and reaction. This ability allows rangers to retaliate with a melee attack using their reactions when attacked by a large creature.
giant_killer.desc_2: If a Large or bigger creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to retaliate with a melee attack. You must be able to see the creature, and it must be within 2 m / 7 ft of you.
